gzhan yang lung rtogs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa la mnga' mnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po zhig ste/ dam pa de nyid kyi drung du mnga' ris pa dpal ldan rgyal pos dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos bskor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa gsan pa yin la/ dam pa 'di yang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur cing / rnam 'dren mchog gi mgon gyis bzung ba la brten/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa'i bshad bsgrub kyi sgo nas nam lang pa la nyi ma shar ba bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi rtsa lag dam par gyur pa zhig yin no/ /rje btsun de nyid kyi drung du 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rnams ma lus zhing lus pa med pa'i tshul gyis mkhas grub chen po chos rje bzang po dpal bas gsan pa yin te/ dam pa 'di yang gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas zhing / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rgyud phyug pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la gang thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyis spyan rab tu gsal bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po sus kyang 'gran par mi bzod cing / lhag par brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi rnams thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar bzhugs pas/ de nyid yi ger btab pa'i gsung rab kyang mang du mdzad de/ mdor na snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rgya mtsho'i glegs bam gcig pu lta bur gyur pa yin no/ /rje btsun de nyid kyi drung du 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos bskor rnams paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug nyid kyis gsan pa yin te/ skyes chen 'di ni mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang por gyur cing / gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad nyan rlabs po che'i sgo nas dbus gtsang gi sa gang du yang sa skya'i pa'i bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rgyas su mdzad de/

mthar gling kha bde ba can gyi bla brang du gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma gsal 'debs par mdzad de mkha' spyod du thogs pa med par gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i mkhas grub gnyis su 'joms pa'i skyes bu 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa zhig go /'dren pa de nyid kyi drung du rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug nyid kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor rnams rdzogs par gsan te/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod cing nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas rtogs pa mchog rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la dbang 'byor ste/ tha mar snang ba'i snod bcud 'di lhag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du mnyam rjes med par 'char ba de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i rgyas thebs pa'i mnyam nyid khyab rdal chen po'i ngang nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dang dbyer med kyi tshul du gtso bor dben pa kho nar bsgom bsgrub la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang nas 'gro ba mtha' dag smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di ni nges par rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can zhig yin no/ /rje btsun chos dbang phyug de nyid kyi drung du rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nyid kyi spyir zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul bgrangs ba las 'das pa zhig dang / lhag par zab mo'i yang rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rnams zhib cing rgyas pa mtha' chod pa gsan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang brgyud pa lugs cig ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi bde mchog chos skor rnams mnga' ris pa paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang / des mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub la gnang / des sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la gnang /

des sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la gnang / des thugs sras dam pa 'jam dbyangs sku mched sogs la gnang ba las/ sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can drung du rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nyid kyis 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang bskur ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du legs par gsan no zhes kyang gsungs shing / gzhan yang brgyud pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang / 'dir yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris la/ rtogs par 'dod na bla ma gong ma'i gsan yig rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po nas/ rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi bar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par ni/ bla ma so so'i rnam thar las khongs su chud par gyis shig de rnams kyi rje btsun bla ma mchog gi gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ kha ba'i dung dkris dkris pa ltar dkar dkar po'i mdangs 'od tsher tsher 'phro ba'i tshem dkar ze'u 'brur gsal po yi/ /bim pa ltar dmar dmar ba'i mdangs mdzes mdzes pas spras pa'i mchu yi 'dab lham lham pa'i dpal gyis lha mer mdzad/ /de slad rab dga' dga' ba'i rlung 'jam 'jam bu'i ser bus ro 'dzin snying po dal bu'i dal bu'i bskyod pa las/ /snyan pa'i dri bsung bsung gzhan dpal 'phrog 'phrog byed do/ /ngo mtshar mtshar ba de yis rkang drug bdag gi yid rab 'phrog /ji snyed ji bzhin gsal bar mdzad khyod mtha' dag 'gro ba kun gyi mig /mig stong pa sogs ral pa'i khrod na khyod kyi zhabs sen rnam par mdzes/ /mdzes sdug sku 'dis dwangs par mi bgyid 'gro ba'i nang na su zhig yod/ /yod med mtha' bral chos dbyings thugs su chud pa gang de rgyal gyur cig /de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pu/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i yongs 'dzin rje/

/khyod ni bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /mgon po gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rgya mtsho che las chu yi thigs pa tsam/ /rang gzhan don du legs par bkod pa 'di/ /skal bzang rnams kyis 'bad de len par rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa don tshan 'di rnams mkhas pa gong ma de dag gi gsung rab so so nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ sgra ji bzhin du glegs bam 'dir bkod pa'i dgos pa ni gong du mchan bur bris zin pa de nyid dang / gzhan yang ding sang dus bskal gyi dbang gi blo gsal rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing gong ma'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can rnams la mthong rgya dang rtogs dpyod 'dod pa'i bskal bzang las 'phro can brgya zhig na re re tsam du snang zhing / cung zad srid kyang 'dir bkod pa'i mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab mtha' dag ni/ ding sang gi skye bo dpe tshogs can sus kyang lag tu 'dzom pa ni shin du dka' bar mthong nas rgyu mtshan des na skyes bu blo gros dang rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i las 'phro can gsung rab rgya chen po mthong 'dod can rnams la gcig tu phan pa'i bsam pa kho na'i dbang byas te/ gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad rin chen rnams/ /gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam ni/ /blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston yin/ /'di la slob par 'dod rnams kyis/ /rang rang blo gros dang sbyar te/ /'dir bshad don tshan gcig bzung nas/ /gzhan rnams bklags pas bde blags rtogs/ /zhes bya bar rtogs par gyis la/ blo chung log lta can rnams kyi ma go ba'i gtam ma smras shig kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rab tu yangs pa'i blo gros rab tu gsal gyur cing / /rab tu rgya che'i yon tan rab tu rgyas gyur nas/ /rab tu bkra ba'i legs bshad rab tu ngo mtshar tshogs/ /rab tu 'chad rtsod rtsom la rab tu mkhas de rgyal/

/zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa shar mdo khams kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag 'chad pa thams cad kyi thog mar sbyar rgyu'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos 'byung chen mo las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i lo rgyus brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang bcas pa la don drug ste/ spyir rgyud sde sgo drug tu dbye ba/ sgo drug po de'i rtsa bshad kyi bzhugs tshul/ sgo drug par 'jog pa'i 'thad pa/ de la rgya bod du srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lugs ngos bzung ba/ de nyid kyi bla ma brgyud par rnam thar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun bir+wa pa yab sras kyis kyai rdo rje'i rgyud la brten nas rgyud sde bzhir mdzad pa dang / rje 'gos kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su rgyud sde lngar mdzad pa ni rang rang gi rgyud la brten nas skabs der rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa yin pas shin tu legs pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir yang rtsa rgyud le'u bcu rtsa gcig pa nas/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i dbye ba yis/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud de rgyud sde sgo drug du mdzad/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rgod dang blta ba lag bcang dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud la sogs pa'i bdag /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs te/ /de nyid bsdus pa 'khor sdom mam/ /gsang ba'am rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog 'di ni/

/ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan te/ rgod pa dag pa bya rgyud/ blta ba dag pa spyod rgyud/ lag bcang dag pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa dag pa bla med gzhan las kyang ma gsungs pa'i don gcig 'dir bstan pas gsang ba'i mtha' zhes bla med spyi las zab par grub la/ de yang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi de nyid bsdus pa dang / ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi 'khor lo sdom pa ni sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs yin la/ pha rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed las kyang ma gsungs zhes pa'o/ /de la dang po rtogs pa'i rgyud ni bya rgyud kyi nang tshan las tshogs gtso bor ston pa rnams so/ /bya ba'i rgyud ni/ bdag nyid tha mal gnas nas mdun du ras bris la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la dka' thub dang gtsang sbra sogs kyi sgo nas dngos grub bsgrub pa ste/ legs grub dang dpung bzang la sogs pa'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ bdag nyid kyang lhar bskyed/ mdun du ye shes pa spyan drangs te bdag la mi bstim par grogs po lta bu'i sgo nas dngos grub bsgrub pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni bdag nyid kyang lhar bskyed/ de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab ste/ cho ga tshar nas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rkyang pa'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i sgo nas dngos grub bsgrub pa ste/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i rgyud la/ rnal 'byor chen po pha'i rgyud dang / ma'i rgyud gnyis las/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par la rje 'gos kyis pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa sogs ni zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis ka ston pas brjod bya rgya che ba yin la/ ma rgyud la ni pho nya'i lam la brten nas dbang gi tshon pa'i ye shes skyong pa tsam yin pas 'di la ltos nas brjod bya rgya chung ste/

de tsam ni sems dben gyi khongs su 'du ba'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ /'o na las rgya la brten pa'i lam thams cad kyi sems dben kyi rtog pa las lhag pa mi bskyed pa yin nam/ de las lhag pa bskyed pa yang yod/ dang po ltar na 'od gsal gyi skabs su yang las rgya la brten nas de las lhag pa'i rtog pa mi bskyed par 'gyur zhing / phyi ma ltar na pho nya'i lam gyis kyang de las lhag pa'i rtog pa bskyed par grub ste/ de'i sngon du rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor khyad par can rnams song ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di gnyis kyi khyad par la bla ma gong mas/ brjod byed tshig gi khyad par dang / brjod bya don gyi khyad par sogs mang du gsungs pa ni phyogs re la dgongs te 'gal ba yang med la/ khyad par dngos ni rim gnyis kyi nang nas bskyed rim dngos bstan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa dang / rdzogs rim dngos bstan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa nag po spyod pas gsungs so/ /de la pha rgyud la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar 'dod chags lam du byed pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskor/ zhe sdang lam du byed pa gshin rje gshed kyi bskor/ gti mug lam du byed pa rnam snang sgyu dra'i bskor te gsum yod do/ /ma rgyud la rgyud sde sgo drug las/ he ru ka'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ kyai rdor gyi rgyud rnams dang / sangs rgyas thod pa dang / mahā ma ya la sogs pa rnams yin la/ rgyud sde bzhir 'byed pa'i tshe gsang mtha'i rgyud rnams kyang 'di'i khongs su gtogs so/ /rnam snang gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ mi g.yo bla med dang / rtsa rgyud rdo rje gdan gzhi dang / de'i bshad rgyud man+t+ra aṃ sa te thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud rnams so/ /rin 'byung gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud de/ 'di la 'phreng bar/

rdo rje bdud rtsi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos su bshad cing / rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi khro bo ste gsum du rgyud las gsungs so/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa dang / rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa rnams so/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi rgyud la/ mgon po sngon 'byung dang / sgrol ma bla med kyi rgyud dang / phur pa rtsa dum gsum las/ dang po paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī'i sgrub dkyil dang / dbang bka' rong po la brgyud nas da lta yang yod cing / gnyis pa la nyi ma sbas sgrol ma lha nyi shu rtsa gcig so so'i sgrub thabs/ spyi'i sgrub thabs/ nyi shu rtsa gcig lus la bkod pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams yod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mtha'i rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ bshad rgyud rnam pa lngas 'chad pa'i lugs te 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa sgo drug pa de'i rtsa bshad kyi bzhugs tshul ni/ spyir bde mchog la/ ma rgyud spyi mthun par bshad pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par bshad pa/ dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa/ gsang mthar bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / jo bo rje la sogs pa slob dpon gzhan gyi bshad srol rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni bde mchog sdom 'byung ste/ gtso bo ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching ba dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lnga la sogs pa gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang cha 'dra bar bshad do/ /gsum pa ni bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ste/ sa dum bu bcu gnyis dang bstun nas 'khor lo bcu gnyis su byed pa dang / rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa dus 'khor dang cha 'dra bar bshad do/

/bzhi pa ni rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'bum phrag bdun pa dang / de las bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di yin la/ bshad rgyud ni slob dpon skar rgyal zla ba'i 'grel par/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod de/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ he ru ka sngon 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud/ nges brjod bla ma ste lngar nges so/ /de ltar nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'di'i lugs kyi nyams len gyi gtso bo smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis las/ smin byed kyi dbang ni rtsa rgyud las cung zad bshad cing / gsang mtha' ba'i lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni he ru ka sngon 'byung gis ston/ grol byed bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ba glang lhas kyi steng lding dang / /lhag ma skem byed rtsa gnas so/ /zhes pa 'byung ba lugs ldog gi mngon rtogs bstan/ yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pa 'byung ba lugs 'byung gi mngon rtogs bstan/ 'di gnyis la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang / a bhi dha na las/ mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa dang / sgong skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes gsungs la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yang / mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /sgong skyes glu ni med pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de la rtsa rgyud dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro rtsa bshad du sbrel ba la brten nas mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa ston/ rtsa rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod rtsa bshad du sbrel ba la brten nas sgong skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa ston/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan tsam dang / 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis ming tsam las zhal phyag la sogs pa gsal bar ma gsungs pas/

de nyid a bhi dha na nas gsal bar bstan/ bskyed rim gyi lam gyi yan lag sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa bskyangs ba dang / rigs ldan ma mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang / las tshogs rab 'byams rnams ni rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid du bstan/ bskyed rim mngal sgong gnyis char gyi lus dkyil rnams dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa phyag rgya bzhi'i nang nas chos kyi phyag rgya gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor de kha sbyor gyis bstan no/ /phyag rgya bzhi la/ las kyi phyag rgya rdo rje rigs kyi g.yung mo la sogs pa ni rtsa rgyud las dngos su bstan/ dam rgya dang por las rgya la brten nas skyes pa'i bde ba phyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la brten nas skyong bar byed pa ni cung zad tsam bshad/ chos rgya rtsa rgyud las dngos su ma bstan kyang / drag po'i sbyin sreg dang / chos 'byung gi nang du a l̥ ka l̥ bkod pa las sngags btu ba de nyid sam+bu ṭir nges don du bshad pas bstan/ phyag rgya chen po ni de la brten nas tshon bya don gyi ye shes skyes pa'o/ /bu ston rin po ches/ 'byung dang zhes pas sdom 'byung / he ru ka mngon 'byung dang / phag mo mngon 'byung dang gsum zin/ mkha' 'gro zhes pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gnyis/ kha sbyor zhes pas sam+bu ṭi dang / rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gnyis zin pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ni lung de la tshad mar byed na/ slob dpon des grangs kyang ma shes par 'gyur te/ bshad rgyud dgu yin pa la bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /tshad mar mi byed na khyed rang gis rang dgar bshad rgyud dgur 'byed par song gi lung de'i tshig 'dis 'di zin ces pa la don med do/ /des na gsang mtha'i bshad srol 'di la sdom 'byung sogs mi dgos pas na bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar nges so/ /'o na sdom 'byung sogs bshad rgyud du gtan mi 'dod dam snyam na/

spyir bde mchog gi bshad rgyud yin kyang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad srol 'di la mi dgos pa yin te/ dper na grub chen kun snying gis gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang / rnam snang sgyu dra rtsa bshad du sbrel nas 'chad pa'i tshe/ dgongs pa lung ston sogs spyir bshad rgyud du khas len kyang / lugs de la mi dgos pa bzhin dang / 'phags pa yab sras kyi gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang / dgongs pa lung ston sogs bzhi rtsa bshad du sbrel nas 'chad pa'i tshe/ rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud sogs spyir bshad rgyud du khas len kyang lugs de la mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa de nyid sgo drug par 'jog pa'i 'thad pa ni/ bla ma pham thing pas bshad pa rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos 'khor sa bcu pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma grangs med pa la gsungs nas de dag gis nyams len mdzad do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i snyigs ma lnga ldan gyi gang zag rnams kyis lam du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas de rnams kyi gzhung yi ger 'bri bar ma nus par sgra nam mkha' la dengs par mdzad de rgyas btab pas sgo drug par bzhed/ rgya gar dha ri ka pa dang / bal po thugs rje chen po'i bzhed pas/ rtsa rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa o ḍi sha'i gtsug lag khang du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi bai ḍūr+ya'i glegs bam la gser zhun mas bris te rgyas btab nas bzhugs pas sgo drug par bzhed do/ /de dag gi don yang sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nyams len ni rgyud sde 'di kho na yin pas rgyud sde gzhan las zab pa'i sgrub byed yin no/ /yang rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa shan+ti pas kyang rgyud 'di la rang stobs kyis 'grel pa rtsom par ma nus pas/ rgyud sde sgo drug par bzhed cing / yang chos gzhan rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ sprul pa'i sku mya ngan las 'das nas mi bzhugs par bshad la/

rgyud 'di'i ston pa sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na dngos su bzhugs shing / de rnams kyis bsgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs par byed pas byin rlabs myur zhing dngos grub nye bas sgo drug par bzhed do/ /gal te sprul sku de rnams sgyu ma bde mchog la sogs pa bde mchog gzhan rnams kyis kyang ston pa yin pas 'di'i khyad chos su mi 'gro'o snyam na/ ston pa yin par 'dra yang byin brlabs zab mo 'jug pa'i thabs 'di kho na la yod pas khyad par 'phags te/ thabs zab mo bskyed rim gyi skabs su pho nya gsum bsres dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs su dpyid kyi thig le'i man ngag bde mchog gzhan rnams las kyang zab pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags par song gi ston pa sprul sku bzhugs pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags par ma song ngo snyam na/ rgyud sde gzhan las ni de gnyis ka'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags la/ bde mchog gzhan las thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /bzhi pa de la rgya bod du srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ spyir bde mchog gi srol byung tshul dang / khyad par gsang mtha'i srol byung tshul lo/ /dang po la rgya gar du byung tshul dang / bod du byung tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni rtsa ba'i rgyud la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i stod kyi 'grel pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi zab don thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bshad pa dang / rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bkral ba'i dka' 'grel dang / slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa a bhi dha na'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa rnams dang bstun te bshad pa dang / yang slob dpon des mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'dzag pa zhes kyang yod la/

de dag kyang 'khor lo gcig pa'i grong khyad na/ /tshong dpon bu mo rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje phag mo de yis bkas/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam bshad byas/ /zhes bshad pas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gdam ngag byin nas mdzad par 'dug de'i rjes su slob dpon kong ka na rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel/ de'i 'grel bshad skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa/ de gnyis kyi bshad sbyar ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa ste/ de dag kyang ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa yin cing / lo chen nas brgyud de rje btsun gong ma rnams la bzhugs so/ /yang grub chen la wa pas mdzad pa nag tsho'i 'gyur/ slob dpon lhas sbas kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa 'gos 'gyur/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa nyung ngu'i mtshams sbyor ste gsum ni rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad pa yin zhing / rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel par rnam par dag pa ni dgu po de tsam yin la/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni/ bstan 'gyur bsdud mkhan rnams kyis bstan 'gyur du bsdus kyang / don la zangs dkar lo tsā bas byas pa yin zhing / dpa' bo rdo rje yang khong gi mtshan yin no/ /bshad rgyud he ru ka mngon byung la/ ku mā ra tsan+t+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la nor bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / bha wa bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gnyis yod cing / yang rgyud de'i zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / nges don gyi bshad pa rnams la yi ge sgras drangs pa'i bshad pas yang dag pa'i lta ba'i nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes pa gcig kyang yod do/ /mngon brjod bla ma la dz+nyā na badz+ras mdzad pa dang / shu raṅga warmas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gnyis yod do/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la slob dpon pad+ma badz+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gru gzings zhes pa yod cing / de'i slob ma dza ya se nas rin chen sna bdun zhes pa'i gzhung bdun mdzad pa las/ tshogs 'khor dang rab gnas kyi gzhung bod du ma 'gyur zhing /

dbang bka' yang ding sang yod do/ /dod pa rnams la paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i mngon 'byung gsum gyi dbang bka' yod zer kyang / he ru ka mngon byung la dbang zur pa med cing / phag mo mngon 'byung ni paṇ+ḍi ta sa dhi tras lha so bdun ma/ bcu gsum ma/ lnga ma'i gzhung gsum yod pa'i so bdun ma ni phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la rten nas byas zer ba yod kyang / rgyud dang mi mthun te/ rgyud nas gdong brnyan gyi tshul du bzhugs par bshad la/ khong gi de ni rtsa rgyud kyi dbang bka' de phyung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud ni/ chags lam gsal bar bstan pas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du 'dug kyang / kyai rdor dang bde mchog gang yin gyis gsal kha mi snang ngo / /rgya gar dha ri ka pa na re/ las chen bcu gnyis ston pa la/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shin tu rgyas pas de yang gsang mtha'i bshad rgyud du 'dod dgos pas so zhes gsungs kyang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i las chen bcu gnyis ni dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i las chen bcu gnyis yin pas lugs 'di la mi phan no/ /brdzus ma'i skor la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa che ba/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa chung ba/ ra li nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gsum ni paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi'i bsgyur zer ba yod kyang / don la gnyos lo tsā bas bzos pa yin cing / dge slong gi bshad pa la/ 'khor ba'i tshul ni dge bas te/ /de las lang pa dge slong yin/ /zhes dang / dur khrod kyi sgra bshad la/ dur chos nyid dang / khrod de rtogs pa'i ye shes la byas pa'i bshad pa yod pas/ bla ma rnams kyi brdzus mar mdzad cing / don la yang gnas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor ma gtogs pa'i mchog gi chos skor gzhan rnams bod du ma 'gyur la/ phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang pos kha cher byon nas/

paṇ+ḍi ta shad+dha la bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon kong ka nas mdzad pa'i chos skor rnams gsan cing / rtsa rgyud dang 'grel pa gsum po de'i 'gyur yang mdzad/ de'i bshad srol dar bar mdzad de rje btsun gong ma yang rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ma gsan gong du 'di la thugs rtsis che ba yin no/ /jo bo rje bod du byon dus lo chen gyis jo bo rje la jo bo'i lugs kyi dbang bskur dang bshad bka' gsan/ jo bo'i lugs kyi lū hi pa'i 'grel pa yang mdzad do/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la 'brog mi byon cing bde mchog la shin tu mkhas kyang slob ma rnams kyi don gnyer ma byas pas bshad srol chad do/ /rje 'gos la lhas sbas kyis 'grel pa'i bshad srol sogs bde mchog gi chos skor byung yang da lta chad do/ /jo bo rjes rong pa mgar dge la lhas sbas kyi 'grel pa'i steng nas bshad pa gnang yang / lha rtse ba grags pa dpal yan chod la yod cing de nas chad do/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti bod du byon dus mar pa do pa dang / spu hrang lo chung gnyis kyis bde mchog gi chos skor rnams legs par mang du gsan cing / mar do'i rtsa rgyud dang / kun spyod dang / nag po gzhung drug sogs gzhung phran phal che ba la 'gyur yang mdzad/ rtsa rgyud dang lū hi pa'i ṭīk+ka yang mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma la ze ba jo bde/ ze ba jo 'bum sogs ze ba mang du byung / ze ba'i slob ma la g.yag pa byang chub dngos grub la sogs pa g.yag pa mang du byung ngo / /spu hrang lo chung gi slob ma la dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grog ra ba dngos grub shes rab/ 'bri phya ru ba/ yar lung pa lha rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan sogs bde mchog la mkhas pa mang du byung ngo / /gnyis pa bye brag tu gsang mtha'i srol byung tshul la/ rgya gar du byung tshul dang / bod du byung tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar grub chen lū hi pas rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang /

mngon brjod bla ma la brten nas rim gnyis spyod pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i 'grel pa phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga lag mchod/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnams pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rtsa ba dang bcas pa la lū hi pa smad lngar grags so/ /gzhan yang bhu ri pas 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags/ lū hi pa'i rjes su slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas rtsa bshad kyi gzhung drug char la brten nas lus dkyil sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa rnams mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su grub chen nag po spyod pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung drug mdzad de/ rtsa ba'i rgyud bde mchog nyung ngu dang / bshad pa'i rgyud he ru ka mngon 'byung dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas dang por dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdzad do/ /de nas bslab bya rim pa gnyis la slob pa la/ thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dbang du byas te/ lha ma grub pa grub par byas pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / a bhi dha na dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten nas nag po mngon rtogs mdzad cing / de yang ting nge 'dzin gsum mam bsnyen sgrub bzhis bsdus pa yin la/ sngags ma grub pa grub par byed pa ni rin chen bzhi yin la/ de'i bsgrub pa'i bar chad sel bar byed pa ni sum+bha ni'o/ /thun mong gi dngos grub la dgongs nas grub pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'byin pa'i thabs sbyin sreg ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / sam+bu ṭi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten nas mdzad do/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas na gzhung gsum du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni dang por rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / shes rab kyi rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gnyis gleng gzhi rjod byed kyi sgra dang / yi ge tha dad kyang / brjod bya don gcig par bstan pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi gleng gzhi la brten nas gsang ba'i de nyid rab tu gsal bar mdzad do/

/rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nyid la yang snying po kyai rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa rjod byed kyi sgra tha dad kyi brjod bya'i don gcig par bstan pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams dang / kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang / rdo rje gdan gzhi la sogs pa la brten nas o la pa tir mdzad do/ /'khor lo sdom pa nyid la yang brjod par bya ba'i don de rim pa bzhi las med do zhes bstan pa'i phyir rtsa rgyud dang / sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa la sogs pa la brten nas dpyid kyi thig le mdzad do/ /grogs spyod pa gsum mam bzhi dang / 'bras bu rnam gnyis ni gzhung drug pa de dag gi gseb tshags nas bton pa yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i slob ma pham things pa sku mched bzhi las/ bar pa gnyis la klog kya shes rab brtsegs dang / mal lo tsā ba gnyis thug bla chen mal la rje btsun sa skya chen po dang / gnyan phul chung pa gtsug tor rgyal po gnyis kyis gtugs la/ gnyan gyis su ma ti kirti la yang rtsa rgyud gsan no/ /bla chen mal gyis rtsa rgyud la mchan dang / sa chen gyis de'i mchan sna bsrings ba dang / slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos de'i yang mchan sna bsrings te mchan zhib po mdzad cing / lū hi pa'i phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga dang / dril bu pa'i dkyil chog gi ṭīk+ka yang mdzad do/ /sa chen gyis nyung ngu'i mtshams sbyor tshigs bcad du dril ba'i bde mchog gi le 'grel dang / rgyud kyi sa bcad dang / nag 'bum du grags pa rnams mdzad la/ nag 'bum la nag po pa'i rnam thar nag po gzhung drug gi bsdu ba/ gzhung drug gi mchod brjod dang / bshad par dam bca'i dgos pa/ gzhung drug gi bsdus don drug tho yig drug ste yig sna bco lnga yod do/ /gnyan phul chung pas su ma ti kirti/ bla chen mal/ sa chen gsum gyi gsung bgros bris pa rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka mu tig phreng gces pa mdzad/

rje btsun rin po ches rnal 'byor ma kun spyod la ṭīk+ka dang / lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du dbye ba dang / dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog rigs lnga'i khrid yig gsum dang / rdul tshon la brten pa'i nag po pa'i dkyil chog rnams mdzad/ rje btsun gyi dngos slob nub pa rigs 'dzin grags kyis gnyan gyi ṭīk+ka de nyid bde ru btang ba'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka dang / lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi 'grel pa rnams mdzad do/ /dkar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad/ bla ma dmar chos kyi rgyal po chung ngu nas rje btsun rin po che la lū hi pa'i dbang bskur thob nas/ nub pa rigs 'dzin grags la sprad de/ khong la bzhugs pa'i bde mchog gi chos skor rnams la mkhas par mdzad do/ /lnga pa de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lugs ngos bzung ba ni/ bshad rgyud kyi bshad pa'i tshul rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas gsang mtha'i lugs khyad par du 'phags shing / de la yang rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i man ngag bla ma pham things pa sku mched nas brgyud pa 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan slob dpon zla ba grags pas bshad pa la tshogs bshad dang slob bshad gnyis yod par gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags gzhan rnams la yang yod pas nā ro pa'i slob ma gzhan rnams la tshogs bshad las med de/ slob dpon pra dz+nyā rak+ṣi tas ni nā ro pa lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsten kyang tshogs bshad las ma thob ces grags pa lta bu'o/ /'o na pham things pa sku mched la slob bshad yod na/ de'i khyad par ji lta bu snyam na/ smin byed kyi skabs su dpa' bo bskul ba dang / bskyed rim gyi skabs su dang por nag po pa'i lung ltar phyi bskyed rim gtso bor bsgom zhing / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi zhar la lus dkyil bsgom pa'i sgo nas dkri/

de nyid la rtogs pa brtan nas cung zad nang la gzhol ba'i tshe phyi dkyil yang sgra tshul las bskyed/ lus dkyil yang sgra tshul las bskyed pa lū hi pa'i lugs kyi phyi nang mnyam pa'i sgo nas dkri/ de nyid la rtogs pa brtan nas nang la mchog tu gzhol ba'i tshe/ phyi dkyil phyi'i he ru ka gsal btab pa tsam las med cing / lus dkyil gtso bo bsgom pa dril bu pa'i lugs kyi dkri ba'i lam gyi rim pa dang / bskyed rim gyi mngon par rtogs pa la yang sbyor ba'i skabs su tshad med bzhi bsgom tshul dang / tshogs bsag bcu gsum dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su rgyud las pho nya gsum gsungs shing / des bsres na bsgrub pa po la dngos grub ster bar gsungs shing / de ji ltar bsre ba'i tshul 'di kho na la yod pa dang / rgyud las/ sgra yi tshul las nges 'byung zhing / /zhes gsungs kyang / sgra tshul ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul 'di kho na la yod pa dang / mjug gi gnas skabs su cho ga gsum gyis bsrung ba dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag la sogs pa rnams ni lugs 'di'i khyad par gyi chos yin no/ /drug pa de nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar la/ dang po he ru ka'i byung tshul ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku de la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa mchog sprul pa mchog ma yin ste gsum du nges pa las/ dang po ni 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su sa bcu pa'i byang sems rnams la chos ston par mdzad pa'i rnam par snang mdzad de nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams du ma nang du 'dus pa ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams yin la/ de la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams du ma nang du 'dus pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ste/ de ni rnam par snang mdzad de'i phyag gi mthil na gnas shing /

de la sogs pa ba spu'i bu ga rnams la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams grangs med pa gnas pa rnams ni sprul pa'i zhing khams yin pas zhing khams de dag tu rgyun chad med par sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul ste/ gdul bya grub pa'i sa la gnas pa yan chad mngon par dbang bskur nas rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa po ni sprul pa mchog yin no/ /gsum pa ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i shākya thub pa lta bu nas bzung ste/ nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa'i gzugs dang / gzings dang / zam pa'i bar du sprul te/ gtso bor so skyes las dag pa dang / nyan thos rnams kyi don mdzad pa ste/ gnyis pa de ni sngar gyi longs sku de nyid kyi sprul pa'o/ /de la 'di'i ston pa he ru ka ni sprul pa mchog yin pas/ 'di la gdul bya dbang phyug chen po'i byung tshul dang / 'dul byed he ru ka'i rnam 'phrul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bskal pa rdzogs ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / gnyis ldan gyi rjes la rtsod ldan mgo rtsom pa'i tshe/ skye dgu rnams phan tshun rtsod par gyur te/ gcig gis gcig bsad pa'i ro phyogs mtshams su bskyal bas dur khrod brgyad du chags/ de'i rlangs pa las sprin brgyad/ de las char babs pas chu brgyad/ chu'i rlangs pa las shing brgyad skyes/ shing brgyad la phyogs skyong brgyad chags/ chu brgyad la klu brgyad chags/ skabs der ri rab dang 'dzam bu'i gling du gdul bya dbang phyug chen po'i rnam 'phrul byung ste/ de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs mtshams na rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i 'jigs byed nyi shu rtsa bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa byung ste yul de rnams bzung ngo / /de'i tshe de rnams kyi 'o skol rnams la dpon cig dgos zhes gleng ba na/ ri rab kyi steng du lha bang phyug chen po sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis pa/

gcer bu ral pa'i cod pan can/ yum lha mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis mas 'khyud pa/ thun mtshams kyi yum sgra gcan ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i mo brgyad dang bcas pa sprul lo/ /de nas dbang phyug chen pos 'jigs byed rnams la mchod pa'i rten du/ rdo'i rang byung gi tshul du liṅga nyi shu rtsa bzhi byin te/ de rnams kyis kyang dus gsum du mchod pa byed do/ /de'i dus su dbang phyug chen po gtso 'khor rnams kyi 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye dgu rnams ma rung par byas te/ zas su mi sha bza'/ skom du mi khrag 'thung / mi'i rus pa la rgyan drug byas/ mi'i skra la tshangs skud byas/ mgo bo la do shal byas so/ /gnyis pa ni de dag gang gis ma thul ba la sngar 'og min du sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de las/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang sprul pa'i sku gtso 'khor drug cu rtsa gnyis su sprul nas btul lo/ /de yang lha chen po yab yum gyi gnyen por he ru ka yab yum/ yum bzhi'i gnyen por bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi/ 'jigs byed nyi shu rtsa bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa'i gnyen por sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo zhal sbyor nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ ma mo brgyad kyi gnyen por dam tshig gi lha mo brgyad sprul te/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang zhal phyag gdul bya drug cu rtsa gnyis dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /de ltar sprul nas ji ltar btul zhe na/ longs spyod pa dang / thim pa dang / dbang du byas pa gsum gyis btul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ kha zas dang / rgyan cha gnyis la longs spyod do/ /khong rnams kyis kha zas sha dron khrag dron du bcas pa de rnams tshogs kyi 'khor lor longs spyad pas dpal khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgyan cha 'phrogs nas he ru ka gtso 'khor gyi rgyan cha byas pas/ phyag rgya drug dang /

mi mgo'i do shal dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /gnyis pa thim pa ni/ lha chen gtso 'khor rnams tshar bcad de/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal du bstim nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar sangs rgyas par lung bstan no/ /gsum pa dbang du byas pa ni/ 'jigs byed tshogs kyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bcom pa'i brdar lha chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus gdan du byas te/ thams cad kyang yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa zhes gsungs so/ /de yang dpal he ru ka yab yum gyis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gdan du byas/ bde chen gyi lha mo bzhis sgra gcan ma sogs yum bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i 'khor los 'jigs byed nyi shu rtsa bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa/ dam tshig gi lha mo brgyad kyis mi'am ci'i lha mo brgyad gdan du byas pa'o/ /de ltar na gdul bya 'dul byed kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de thams cad drang ba'i don yin gyi/ nges pa'i don tha mi dad do/ /de ltar yang 'dus pa las/ sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi ston pa dbang phyug che/ /thugs kyi ston pa khyab 'jug yin/ /zhes pas 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa ni dbang phyug gi sprul pa yin la/ dbang phyug ni rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa'o/ /de rnams 'dul bar byed pa'i lha rnams ni dpal he ru ka'i sprul pa yin la/ dpal he ru ka ni rdo rje 'chang gi rnam 'phrul lo/ /de thams cad kyang nges pa'i don du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin yin no/ /dpal he ru ka de nyid kyi dbang bskur zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ drang don du phyag na rdo rje yin la/ nges pa'i don du phyag na rdo rje nyid kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa kho na yin te/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ye shes gcig nyid 'og min du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor du rdo rje sems dpa' dang /

gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan par kun tu bzang po dang / mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su phyag na rdo rje'i skur bstan nas rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag bsdus nas/ gdul bya skal ldan rnams la ston par tshad ldan gyi gzhung rnams las bshad do/ /de ltar brgyud pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang de nyid kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dpal phyag na rdo rje las brgyud tshul bshad nas/ de man chad kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams ni rje btsun bla ma mchog gi gsungs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gong du bshad pa des don tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /de rnams kyis kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ rab mdzes ut+pal ut+pal mig can yid 'ong la/ /skyes bu mig ldan mig ldan chags can dga' ba ltar/ /legs bshad pad+ma pad+ma'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /mkhas dbang rtse dga' rtse dga'i rol ba chos nyid legs/ /gzhon nu rnams ni gzhon nu ma la dga' ba ltar/ /mdzes ldan ma rnams mdzes ldan dag la gus pa bzhin/ /legs bshad gsung rab legs bshad don du gnyer ba yi/ /mkhas pa'i dbus su mkhas par 'dod rnams cis mi len/ /bu ram shing pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rgyun bzang spel mdzad sa skya'i bla chen rje/ /rje btsun gang de slar yang mi yi zol/ /zol gyis byon pa bsod nams seng ge legs/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa sdom brtson dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan rgyal ba'i sras po chos kyi rje/ /dge slong tshul 'chang dge slong khrims ldan kun gyi rgyan/ /dam pa'i rjes bzung dam pa'i rnam thar legs skyong ba'i/ /sdom brtson dam pa sdom brtson gang de rtag par rgyal/

/zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa sdom brtson dam pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig las/ pha bla na med pa/ ma bla na med pa gnyis ste/ bla med rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di gnyis kyi khyad par la/ jo nang pa sogs bla ma 'ga' zhig pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum las/ gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu pha rgyud/ kyai rdo rje lta bu ma rgyud/ dus 'khor lta bu ni de gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i gnyis med rgyud yin pas/ thang ka'i gral yang dus 'khor dbus/ gsang 'dus g.yas/ kyai rdo rje bde mchog g.yon du bsgrig pa yin zhes zer/ de ltar na dbang gi dus su/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ dbang gong ma bzhi ste bcu gcig dang / lam bskyed rim la sku bzhi'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor yan lag bzhi dang / rdzogs rim la lam sbyor ba yan lag drug ston pa pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gang yang ma yin pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin nam/ de las lhag pa'i 'jog byed gzhan zhig yod/ dang po ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i lugs kyi kyai rdo rje de yang de gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'gyur te/ gong gi 'jog byed de tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /phyag rdor bstod 'grel ba'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog de yang de ltar du 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na/ rdo rje snying po'i lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i ras ris de gral dbus dang / kyai rdo rje gzhan gyi lugs rnams g.yon du bsgrig dgos pa sogs ha cang thal lo/ /de ltar na dus kyi 'khor lo ma rgyud yin te/

dri med 'od zer 'phro ba he ru ka ni dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu nyid/ zhes he ru kas sgras gsungs pa dang / shar gyi zhal nas shes rab rgyud gsungs/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa nyid ni nub kyi zhal nas so/ /zhes dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab kyi rgyud du gsungs pa dang / dus 'khor la shin du mkhas pa phyogs rgyal ba sogs kyis kyang ma rgyud du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ma rgyud las gzhan du gyur pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud yod pa mi 'thad de/ rdo rje 'chang gis ma rgyud las zab pa'i rgyud sde ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rje 'gos na re/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi nang nas rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud ni zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis ka ston pas brjod bya'i don rgya che ba yin la/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ni dbang gi mtshon pa'i ye shes tsam pho nya'i lam la brten nas skyong bar byed pa yin pas/ 'di la ltos nas brjod bya'i don rgya chung ba yin te/ de tsam gcig sems dben du 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /de ni dpyad par bya ste/ de ltar na pho nya'i lam la brten nas sems dben gyi rtogs pa tsam gcig 'dren gyis/ de las lhag pa mi 'dren/ chad pa'ang mi 'dren pa yin na/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas sems dben gyi rtog pa bskyed dgos par 'gyur/ de 'dod na/ sems dben gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i phyir du rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa brtan mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /yang de las rgya la brten nas sems dben gyi rtogs pa las lhag pa mi 'dren na/ 'od gsal gyi skabs su las rgya la brten nas sngar gyi sems dben gyi rtogs pa de las lhag pa'i rtogs pa mi skye bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir de la 'od gsal gyi skabs su las rgya la brten nas sngar gyi sems dben gyi rtogs pa de las lhag pa'i sems dben gyi rtogs pa gcig skyes te/

de'i gong du dben gsum dang / sgyu lus kyi lam bzang po de rnams sngon du song ba'i phyir snyam na/ 'o na ma rgyud pa'i skabs su yang pho nya'i lam la brten nas sems dben gyi rtogs pa de las lhag pa'i ye shes kyang skye bar 'gyur te/ pho nya'i lam de'i sngon du rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor khyad par can rnams sngon du btang nas pho nya'i lam de bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi dbye ba la/ he ru ka'i rigs kyi rgyud sogs lnga dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyud do/ /rin po che pa na re/ bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rgyud ste sgo bdun pa rigs drug cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud yin te/ de nas gtso bor byas pa'i rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gcig ston pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bde mchog a bhi dha na yang rigs drug cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud sde sgo bdun par 'gyur te/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgyur drug ston pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje gur yang rgyud sde bdun pa der 'gyur te/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa dang / rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa dang / rigs drug cha mnyam du 'jog cing / sbyong rgyud lta bus/ rnam snang lta bu'i rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor las mi ston pas/ rigs so so'i rgyud du mi 'jog pa bzhin rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor ston pas rgyud de nyid du rigs drug cha mnyam pa'i rgyud du mi 'gyur ro/ /des na bde mchog la/ 'khor lo bde mchog kyai rdor bde mchog sgyu ma bde mchog zhes gsum du 'jog par bshad pas/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor yang he ru ka'i rigs su gsungs so/ /he ru ka'i rigs la/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog sgyu ma bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa/

mahā ma ya'o/ rnam snang gi rigs la/ mi g.yo ba bla med/ de'i dbang bka'/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ gdan bzhi po re re la bzhi bzhir phye bas le'u bcu drug tu byas pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud maṇ+ḍal am̐ sa/ gsang ba thams cad pa gnyis so/ /grub chen ar+ya de wa'i sgrub dkyil sogs gzhung phran mang du yod cing / dbang yang da lta yod do/ /rin 'byung gi rigs la/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'di la zur bka' med cing / phreng bar de'i dbang bskur yod la/ de yang rdo rje bdud rtsi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos su bshad cing / rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi khro bo/ rdo rje bdud rtsi he ru ka gsum ni rgyud nyid kyi steng du gnas par bya'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs la/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa/ 'di'i dbang bzhugs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma dra ba can/ 'di la paṇ+ḍi ta rgyal ba dpal ye shes kyi sgrub dkyil 'di nyid bod du paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma na kas bsnams byon te/ zhwa lu ba la dbang bka' yod do/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs la/ mgon po mngon 'byung / sgrol ma rnal 'byor chen mor bshad pa/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu/ dang po mgon po mngon 'byung la paṇ+ḍi ta ma na shrī'i sgrub dkyil/ dbang bka' rong pa las brgyud de bod na yod/ 'di la mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud zhes pas phyag bzhi phyag drug pa la sogs pa'i chos skyong gi tshogs rab tu mang po bstan pa zhig yod do/ /de dag ni bod ma yin par 'dug go /gnyis pa grub chen nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa'i sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig so so'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig lus la bkod pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams yod do/ /gsum pa la rin po ches pas/ rnying ma ba rnams phur pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud zhes zer ba khungs su byas nas/

don yod grub pa'i rigs su bgrangs kyang / 'di'i khro bo bcu'i gang du 'god pa'i gnas/ sku mdog phyag mtshan/ sngags rnams sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi khro bo bcu dang 'dra bar 'dug pas/ de nas phyung ba 'dra'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyud la/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /'di la slob dpon shan+ti pa'i 'grel pa yod de/ khyad par du 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor la/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud la/ gu sam+bha ra bshad pa'i rgyud/ /'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /zhes pa slob dpon skar rgyal zla ba'i 'grel par bshad la/ slob dpon gzhan 'ga' re'i 'grel par yang 'di dang 'dra bar 'byung ngo / /'di la rin po che pa na re/ 'byung dang zhes pa la brten nas sdom 'byung / he ru ka mngon 'byung / phag mo mngon 'byung dang gsum 'don/ mkha' 'gro zhes pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnyis/ kha sbyor zhes pas sam+bu ṭi dang / rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ de ni lung de la rtsis nas byed dam/ mi rtsi nas byed/ dang po ltar na slob dpon des grangs kyang ma shes par 'gyur te/ bshad rgyud rnam pa dgu yin pa la/ lngar 'dod ces bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa ltar na khyed rang gi rang dgar bshad rgyud dgur byed mod/ lung de la brten pa'i don med do/ /des na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad srol 'di la bshad rgyud lnga kho na grangs nges pa yin te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ ba lang lhas kyi steng lding dang / /lhag ma skem byed rtsa gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pas 'byung ba lugs ldog gi mngon rtogs gnyis bstan/ yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pas lugs 'byung gi tshul gyis bsgom pa'i mngon rtogs bstan/ 'di gnyis la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan a bhi dha nar/ mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs dang /

sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs zhes bshad/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yang / mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /sgong skyes glu ni med pa dang / /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa 'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /de la rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro gnyis rtsa bshad du sbrel ba la brten nas mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa de legs par thon pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs gsal bar ston par byed pa mkha' 'gro kun spyod/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan tsam dang / 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ming tsam las/ zhal phyag sogs gsal bar ma bstan pa de nyid/ bshad pa'i rgyud a bhi dha nar gsal bar bstan pas bshad pa'i rgyud a bhi dha na/ mngon par rtogs pa de gnyis kyi sngon du dbang bskur ba gcig thob dgos pas/ he ru ka mngon 'byung gi rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ston pas/ bshad rgyud he ru ka mngon 'byung / mngon rtogs de nyid nyams su len pa'i gang zag gi sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pa dang / rigs ldan ma mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang / las kyi tshogs rab 'byams bsgrub dgos pa rnams rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid du gsal bar bstan/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos pa la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rnal 'byor las/ las rgya ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi g.yung mo la sogs pa'o/ /chos rgya ni gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ dam rgya ni dang por las rgya la brten nas bde ba bskyed pa de nyid phyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la brten nas skyong bar byed pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ni de rnams la brten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'o/ /de ltar bzhi'i nang nas chos kyi phyag rgya gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor te/ rtsa rgyud du dngos su ma bstan kyang /

drag po'i sbyin sreg dang / chos 'byung gi nang du pad 'dab la ā l̥ kā l̥ bkod pa las sngags btu mdzad pa de nyid/ sam+bu ṭir nges don du bshad pas/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor bstan pas na bshad pa'i rgyud sam+bu ṭi dang lngar nges/ las rgya ni rtsa rgyud du rgyas par bstan la/ dam rgya ni rang 'od kyi rig ma bsten pa sogs kyang cung zad bshad do/ /spyir phyag rgya bzhi la slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i gzhung / mnga' bdag mai tri pas mdzad pa'i gzhung / de'i 'grel pa bde ba'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa/ slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa sogs yod kyang 'di pa dang don mi gcig go /'o na bde mchog sdom 'byung sogs bshad rgyud du mi 'dod pa yin nam/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud ma yin zer ba yin snyam na/ spyir rgyud rnam dag dang / bde mchog gi bshad rgyud yin kyang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad srol 'di la mi dgos pa yin te/ dper na grub chen kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu dra dang / gsang 'dus gnyis rtsa bshad du sbrel nas bshad pa'i tshe na/ gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud gzhan rnams spyir rgyud rnam dag dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'i rgyud rnam dag ma yin mi gsung yang / khong rang gi yo gar 'chad pa'i srol de la rnam snang sgyu dras chog pas de'i tshe gzhan rnams bshad rgyud du khas mi len pa dang / slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi bshad rgyud bzhi dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud rtsa bshad du 'chad pa'i tshe na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis rtsa bshad sbrel nas bshad pa'i srol de la/ dgongs pa lung ston sogs bzhi po rgyud rnam dag min yang mi zer/ bshad rgyud min yang mi zer yang / lugs de 'chad pa la de rnams mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /des na 'khor lo bde mchog bshad lugs la/

rnal 'byor gsang mthar bshad pa dang / ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par bshad pa/ dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bshad rgyud lnga'i sgo nas grub chen nā ro ta pa'i bshad srol 'di'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / jo bo rje sogs slob dpon gzhan rnams kyi bshad srol rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung ste/ 'di la gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching gis bcings pa/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa sogs 'phags lugs dang mthun par bshad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ste/ dum bu bcu gnyis dang bstun pa'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis su byed pa dang / rdzogs rim la yan lag drug pa sogs dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pas so/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i tshig rkang bcu gcig pa yan gyi 'grel pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi zab mo'i don thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas bshad dgos pa yin zhes gsungs nas bskyed rdzogs dus 'khor dang mthun par bkral ba dang / rgyal po in+t+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ma rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba dka' 'grel du byas pa gcig in+t+ra bo dhi chen po de ni min par 'dug go /slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog a bhi dha na'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa rnams dang bstun te bshad pa mdzad pa gcig slob dpon des mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bdag nyid 'jug pa zhes pa gcig yod/ 'khor lo gcig pa'i grong khyer na/ /tshong dpon bu mo rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje phag mo de yi bka'/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam bshad byas/ /zhes bshad pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gdam ngag byin nas mdzad par 'dug cing / ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bshad pa yin no/

/de'i rjes su slob dpon kong ka na rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dka' 'grel du byas pa/ skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad/ de gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa de rnams kyang ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bkral ba yin zhing / 'di'i bshad bka' yang lo chen nas rje btsun gong ma rnams la brgyud de bzhugs so/ /grub chen la wa pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa nag tsho'i 'gyur rnal 'byor gsang mthar bshad pa yin la/ slob dpon lhas sbas kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa 'gos 'gyur yod la/ 'di dang la wa pa'i de gnyis yig phreng re tsam gyis bsnon 'phri ma gtogs 'dra bar 'dug cing / mchan gcig dkyus su shor ba yin nam dpyad do/ /de'i rjes la paṇ+ḍi ta su ma kirtis mdzad pa'i nyung ngu'i mtshams sbyar zhes pa yod la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor gsang mtha' la med mi rung gi yan lag yin no/ /slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa zhes pa gcig yod la/ 'di bstan 'gyur bsdud mkhan rnams kyis bstan 'gyur du bsdus kyang / zangs dkar gyi gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rje yin par 'dug cing / khong gis mdzad pa'i sam+bu ṭi'i 'grel pa'ang yod la/ khong pa rang gi kha g.yar byas pa yin kyang / bstan 'gyur bsdud mkhan rnams kyis ma dgongs par 'dug go /he ru ka mngon 'byung la ku ma ra tsan+t+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yod/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la nor bzang gis byas pa'i 'grel pa dang / grub chen bha ba bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang gnyis yod cing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sam+bu ṭi rdor dbyings dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa ni 'khor lo gsum gyi dod du/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gsum rim gcig bkod pa lha snam bzhag pa ste/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur yang yod do/ /kun spyod la ta thā ga ra rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang yod/

sam+bu ṭi la rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang nges don gyi bshad pa rnams la yi ge sgras drangs pa'i bshad pa/ yang dag lta ba'i nyi mas byas pa'i 'grel pa gyong nge ba gcig yod/ a bh+yes mdzad pa'i man ngag snye ma gsang sngags spyi'i bshad pa mtha' dag byas pa gcig yod/ mngon brjod bla ma la dz+nyā na badz+ra gyis mdzad pa dang / shu raṅga warmas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gnyis yod do/ /'di la zur bka' dril bu lha lnga dang / la wa pa'i bcu gsum ma dang / phreng bar 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang / hūm̐ mdzad la khro bo bcu'i bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bshad pa ni 'di'i le'u re re nas bshad pa yin no/ /sdom 'byung la bal po dz+nyā na shrīs mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ de'i slob ma rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yod cing / dbang bka' yang yod do/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gru rdzing zhes bya ba gcig yod/ de'i slob ma dza ya se nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi sgrub thabs zhes pa gzhung bdun las/ tshogs 'khor dang rab gnas kyi gzhung ma gtogs bod du 'gyur/ dbang bka' yang bzhugs so/ /phag mo mngon 'byung gi nang nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gdong gnyan gyis bskor ba'i bar so bdun pa yin la/ de nyid a bhi dha na'i le'u gcig nas kyang ston pas/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad srol la mi dgos pa yin no/ /rong pa rnams la paṇ+ḍi sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i mngon 'byung gsum gyi dbang yod zer kyang / he ru ka mngon 'byung la dbang bskur zur pa med cing / phag mo mngon 'byung gi u ma pa tri ta'i gzhung lha so bdun ma/ bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma rnams yod pa las/ so bdun ma ni phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas byas zhes pa yod kyang / rgyud 'di dang mi mthun par snang ste/ 'di gdong brnyan tshul du bzhugs pa yin la/

u ma pa tri ta'i de ni rtsa rgyud yum bka' de phyung ba yin par snang ngo / /rnal 'byor ma bzhi kun tu kha sbyor ni/ chags lam gcig gsal bar bstan pas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du 'dug kyang / kyai rdor bde mchog gnyis gang yin gyi gsal kha mi snang zhing / chags lam ni rtsa rgyud nyid/ de bas kyang rgyas pa gcig ston to/ /jo bo na ro ta pa'i slob ma rgya gar dha ri ka pa na re/ las chen bcu gnyis ston pa la/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rgyas shing gsal bar ston pas mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yang bshad rgyud du 'dod dgos zer yang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho de ni dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i las chen bcu gnyis de yin pas 'di la mi phan zhing / des bshad rgyud du mi 'gro'o/ /de rnams 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnam par dag pa'o/ /brdzus ma'i skor la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa che ba/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa chung ba/ ra li nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ pad 'dab kyi dbus su 'khor lo bde mchog dang / shar gyi 'dab ma la phyag bzhi pa ste/ bde mgon gnyis med kyi lha bcu gsum ma ston byed kyi rgyud gcig dang / gnyis pa ni zhang tshal pa slob dpon bha ya nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs chung ngu gcig de'i sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag de dag gi byin brlabs kyi cho ga rnams yod la/ zhang 'tshal pa'i dge bshes gcig gis/ de nyid ston pa'i bstan bcos le'u gsum byas pa'i le'u dang pos byin rlabs kyi cho ga de bstan nas dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ //le'u gnyis pas lha de'i sgrub thabs bstan nas bskyed pa'i rim pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa sems 'dzin pa'i gdam ngag de bstan nas rdzogs rim gyi le'u gsum pa'o zhes bshad pa gcig yod do/ /gsum pa la sku'i rgyud brgyad/ gsung gi thugs kyi/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud brgyad do/

/de yang dang po ni gsung ba po sku'i dpa' bo brgyad/ zhu ba po rab gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo brgyad/ gnas pu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad/ gsung dang / thugs la yang de'i rigs 'gre/ 'phrin las gsung ba po sgo mtshams ma brgyad do/ /zhu ba po phra men ma brgyad/ gnas dur khrod brgyad do/ /'di rnams paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi'i bsgyur zer ba yod kyang / gnyos lo tsā bas bzos pa yin cing / 'khor ba'i tshul ni dge bas te/ /de las slong bas dge slong yin/ /zhes pa dang / dur khrod kyi 'bru gnon la/ dur chos nyid la byas shing / khrod ni de rtogs pa'i ye shes la byas pa'i bshad pa yod pas/ bla ma rnams kyis brdzus mar byas shing don la ma gnas pa yin no/ /de rnams ni 'phags yul du byung tshul sogs mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de nyid kha ba can gyi khrod du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ bstan pa snga dar la sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor ma gtogs bde mchog gi chos skor gzhan rnams bod du ma 'gyur/ bstan pa phyi dar la lo chen kha cher byon nas/ jo bo shar+dha la bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon kong ka na'i chos skor rnams gsan cing / rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gsum po de'i 'gyur yang mdzad/ rje btsun gong ma rnams rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ma 'gyur gong du 'di rnams la thugs rtsis che ba yin no/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i sked tsam la jo bo rje bod du byon cing / lo chen gyis jo bo rje la lū hi pa'i dbang bskur dang bshad bka' gsan/ lo chen gyi jo bo lugs kyi lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa yang yod do/ /sku tshe'i smad la 'brog mi byon cing / khong bde mchog la mkhas kyang grwa pa rnams kyis bde mchog la don gnyer cher ma byas pas bshad srol chad do/ /rje 'gos la lhas sbas kyis 'grel pa'i bshad srol sogs bde mchog gi chos skor byung yang da lta chad nas med/

jo bo rjes rong pa mgar dge ba rab gsal la lhas sbas kyi 'grel pa'i steng nas bshad pa gnang kyang / lha rtse ba grags pa dpal yan la yod cing / de nas chad do/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti bod du byon dus/ mar pa do pa dang / spu hrang lo chung gnyis kyis bde mchog gi chos skor rnams legs par gsan cing dar bar byas/ mar pa do pas mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud dang / lū hi pa'i ṭīk+ka/ a bhi dha na nas gsungs pa'i mngal skyes kyi dkyil 'khor bdun cu rtsa lnga po re re la yang sgrub thabs byas pa yod zer/ mdzad byang la mañju badz+ras sbyar zhes pa yod do/ /khong gi rtsa rgyud dang / kun spyod/ nag po gzhung drug sogs gzhung phran phal che ba la 'gyur yang mdzad/ khong nas brgyud pa'i dril bu lha lnga'i dbang bka'/ la wa pa'i bcu gsum ma'i dbang bka' da lta yod do/ /rje btsun spu hrang pa'i slob ma rnams na re/ khong la lo chen dang / rje btsun spu hrang pa la lo chung zer ba ni/ yon tan che chung yod pas ma yin cing sku lus kyi che chung la de ltar grags pa yin/ spyir mar do khong bla ma su ma ti kirti khong bod du byon dus zhabs tog bzang po ma byas pas dam tshig la skyon byung ba yin zer skad/ mar do'i slob ma ze ba jo bde/ jo 'bum sogs mang du byung / ze ba'i slob ma lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub sogs yang dag pa mang du byung / la yag pa'i slob ma byang snyan rtog pa jo 'bum dang / rung rtong zhes pa rnams byung ngo / /rje btsun spu hrang pa'i slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'bri cha ru ba/ yar lung pa lha rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan sogs bde mchog pa mkhas pa mang po byung ngo / /yang grub chen nā ro ta pa'i dngos slob pham things pa sku mched bzhi las/ gcen che shos kyis lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du nā ro ta pa bsten nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhud dam yang zer/ mkha' spyod du bzhud dam yang zer/

de'i gcung po gcen 'jigs med grags pa'am/ a thab kyang zer/ de'i gcung po bla ma dus 'khor ba ngag dbang grags pa/ de'i gcung po bla ma thang chung ba rnams las/ bar pa gnyis la bla ma klog kya dang / rje mal gnyis kyis thug bla chen mal gyis rtsa rgyud la mchan gcig yod/ bla chen mal la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa dang / rje btsun gnyan phul chung ba rten skya bo'i mtshan gtsug tor rgyal ba/ rab byung gi mtshan la dge slong bsod nams rdo rje/ khong pas rtsa rgyud su ma ti kirti la'ang thug rje sa chen gyis sngar gyi de'i mchan sna bsrings pa/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos de'i yang mchan sna bsrings pa'i mchan zhib mo yod do/ /rje sa chen gyis nyung ngu'i mtshams sbyor tshigs bcad du dril ba'i bde mchog gi le 'grel dang / sa bcad dang / nag 'bum du grags pa rnams yod do/ /gnyan phul chung pas rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka mu tig phreng ba zhes pa/ su ma ti kirti/ mal/ sa chen gyi gsung bgros yi ger btab pa yod do/ /rje btsun chen po'i dngos slob nub pa rigs 'dzin grags kyis gong gi ṭīk+ka de nyid bder btang pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka dang / lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi 'grel pa rnams mdzad/ sa skya pa rnams phal che ba ṭīk+ka de nyid kyi steng nas 'chad do/ /rje btsun rin po ches kun spyod la ṭīk+ka/ nag po dkyil chog gi ṭīk+ka bshad sbyar/ lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad do/ /rje btsun gyi dngos slob dkar gyis rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod kyi ṭīk+ka/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad/ bla ma dmar chos kyi rgyal po chung dus nas yab gshegs nas/ khu bos nged rang dang chos brgyud mthun pa yin zer nas/ rje btsun gyi sku mdun du btang pas/ lū hi pa'i dbang bskur gcig thob/ de nas nub pa rigs 'dzin grags la sprad/

nub pa rigs 'dzin grags la gang bzhugs kyi bde mchog gi chos skor rnams zhus shing mkhas par bslab/ khong pas mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ṭīk+ka/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams yod do/ /spyir khong pa'i pha chos yin zer nas/ mgar lo tsā ba'i chos drug la 'chad nyan dang thugs dam mdzad/ chos drug ni zhi ba gsum/ drag po gsum/ zhi ba gsum la/ sgrol ma sna tshogs pa'i rgyud/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud/ rnam 'joms/ drag po gsum ni/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor chen/ mi g.yo ba/ rta mgrin rnams so/ /de ltar bod du 'gyur ba'i brgyud pa de rnams kyi nang nas shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla chen mal nas brgyud pa ni lugs 'di bshad par bya ba yin no/ /de la phar phyin theg pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis kyi khyad par yod/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / sogs/ khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs pas na/ sde snod gnyis po de rtogs bya'i lta bar don gcig 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan la dmigs pa don gcig kyang / khyad chos bzhi'i rigs 'dzin gyi sde snod de/ las dang po pa 'jug dgos la/ 'dir ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs pa'i gang zag gcig dang por 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar khyad chos bzhis khyad par du byas pa'i rigs pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag byed lugs slob dpon gyi dgongs pas mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang / ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa'i rgyud la brten nas gsang 'dus lugs kyis rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa ltar rang rang gi rgyud re la brten nas rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag byed pa ni shin tu legs shing skabs su babs pa yin pas/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi yang le'u nga gcig pa nas/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/

/sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas rgyud sde sgo drug tu 'jog pa yin no/ /de yang ji srid mdo ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa sde snod gsum dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa/ bya zhes pas bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang / gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / mtha' zhes pas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud dang / dbye ba nyid ces pas ma yi yang ma/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnams bstan to/ /rgyud ni sgo drug pa yin pa'i bsgrub byed ni/ 'di nyid las/ rgod dang blta ba lag bcang dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud la sogs pa'i bdag /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs te/ /de nyid bsdus pa 'khor sdom mam/ /gsang ba'am rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog 'di ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan pa yin te/ de yang rgod dang zhes pas bya rgyud/ blta bas spyod rgyud/ lag bcang gi rnal 'byor rgyud/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang gi bla na med pa'i rgyud bstan la/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde chen po bzhir ma gsungs pa'i zab mo'i don gcig rgyud sde chen po 'dir bstan zhes pa yin la/ de nyid bsdus pa ni/ yo ga de nyid bsdus pa dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa ste/ bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs kyi bshad srol la sogs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa rnams dang / gsang ba ste gsang 'dus dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa'o/ /de la bya ba'i rgyud ni legs grub la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud du bzhag ce na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod rgyud ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa ste/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang / nang ting nge 'dzin cha snyoms pa la spyod pas de skad ces bya'o/

/rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ 'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'o/ /nang gi sems kyi bya ba lha'i ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor rgyud ces bya'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'o/ /yo ga dang thabs shes rab gnyis med tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin ston pa tsam du 'dra mod kyang / rnal 'byor rgyud man nas mi ston pa'i dbang bzhi dang / rim pa gnyis dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga brten pa dang / 'bras bu'i dus sa bcu gsum pa la sogs pa ston te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ sangs rgyas kun gyis gang bstan pa'i/ /sa gyur de ni bcu gsum pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ni kyai rdo rje la sogs pa ste/ de yang rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa ston pa la zab mi zab med kyang / rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas pha rgyud la zab ste/ gsang 'dus su rlung gi rnal 'byor zhib par bstan kyang / da dung srog nang du dgag pa bum pa can gyi ming tsam yang ma bstan pa dang / gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnams pha rgyud du ming tsam yang ma bstan pa rnams kyai rdor du legs par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor ma'i yang ma bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams te/ 'di'i rgyud sde drug par 'jog pa la bla ma pham things pa'i bzhed pas/ rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po 'khor sa bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma grangs med pa rnams la gsungs nas de rnams kyis nyams len mdzad nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gang zag rnams kyi nyams len du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas de rnams kyi gzhung yi ger bri bar ma nus pa sgra nam mkha' la dengs par mdzad de rgyas btab ces gsungs so/ /rgya gar dha ri ka pa dang /

bal po thugs rje chen po'i bzhed pas/ rtsa rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa o ḍi sha'i gtsug lag khang du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bai ḍūr+ya'i glegs bam la gser zhun mas bris te rgyas btab nas bzhag pas sgo drug pa yin zhes bzhed do/ /yang rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa slob dpon shan+ti pas rgyud 'di rang stobs kyis 'grel pa rtsom par ma nus pa'i phyir du rgyud sde drug par bzhed pa yin zhes kyang zer ro/ /de rnams kyi go rgyu ni/ spyir rgyud rgyas pa sgra nam mkha' la dengs zer ba dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i glegs bam la gser gyis bris zer ba tsam sgrub byed du dka' yang / sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nyams len ni rgyud sde 'di nyid kho na yin zer bar song bas/ rgyud sde gzhan las zab pa'i sgrub byed du song ngo / /slob dpon shan+ti pas rang stobs kyis 'grel pa rtsom ma nus pas kyang rgyud sde gzhan las zab pa'i sgrub byed du song ste/ rgyud sde gzhan dang bstan bcos gzhan thams cad la rang stobs kyis 'grel pa nus pa yin par 'dug go /yang rgyud sde gzhan las 'di zab pa yin te/ chos gzhan rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ sprul pa'i sku mya ngan las 'das nas mi bzhugs par bshad pa la/ rgyud 'di'i dbang du byas na byin gyis rlobs byed kyi sprul pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dngos su bzhugs pas/ de rnams kyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs par byed pas na byin rlabs myur zhing / dngos grub thag nye ba yin pas so/ /sprul pa'i sku de rnams ni sgyu ma bde mchog la sogs pa bde mchog pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang ston pa yin pas rgyud byin gyis mnyam par rlobs pas rgyud sde 'di zab pa'i sgrub byed du mi 'gro'am snyam na/

'khor lo bde mchog gi ston pa yin par 'dra yang / byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs zab mo yod med kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags te/ dper na bla ma gcig gi grwa pa yin par 'dra yang / bla ma de'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom rgyu yod med la sogs pa'i sgo nas byin rlabs 'jug pa myur bul gyi khyad yod pa bzhin du/ 'dir bskyed rim gyi skabs su pho nya gsum bsres dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs su/ dpyid kyi thig le la sogs pa bde mchog pa gzhan las zab pa'i khyad chos du ma zhig yod pas so/ /de yang ma rgyud kyi gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang / dpyid kyi thig le bsgom pa'i 'bras bu dpe'i ye shes la khyad par med kyang / 'khor lo bzhi pa ni/ rtsa sum cu so gnyis sogs rtsa rnams dang / yi ge rnams ma shar gyi bar du bsgom dgos la/ dpyid kyi thig le la ni/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i dmigs pa'i gnad gcig la shes pa gtad pas ting nge 'dzin myur du skye bar 'gyur te/ dper na shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa dang / sgyu ma mkhan po 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa dang / shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa bzhin no/ /de yang lho phyogs ḍa ki ni pa ta'i yul na/ shing skyed rtsal shin tu che ba cig yod pa/ phyogs cig bcad tshar ba dang / phyogs gzhan de skyes zin nas chod pa'i dus med pa la shing gnad shes pa'i shing mkhan gcig gis rlung dang chu ba bsdong ste 'gro ba'i phyogs de thog mar bcad pas myur du chod pa dang / rgyal po ñja bo de zhes pa'i yul cig na/ mkhar gyi phyi rol na ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor yod pa las/ de'i gnad mi shes pa rnams kyis mtshon ji snyed cig brgyab kyang / des bcad de nus pa mi thon la/ gnad shes pas mdud pa'i mtshams cig bkrol ba na/ 'phrul 'khor de zhig yong ba bzhin no/ /de yang grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes/

gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal bar pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud rnams nas 'byung ba'i rdzogs rim spyi'i rnam gzhag rnams gsal bar bstan la/ o la pa tir/ rtsa rgyud kyi sngags btu dang / drag po'i sbyin sreg sam+bu ṭi'i nges don gyi bshad pa byas pas/ chos kyi phyag rgya gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor gsal bar bstan pa yin la/ 'di dag ni legs par bshad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ myos byed rdzas kyi myos pa'i blun po ltar/ /grub mtha' ngan pas grub mtha' slad rnams la/ /lung rigs rdo rje'i lung rigs char phab nas/ /yang dag bstan pa yang dag 'dzin mdzad rgyal/ /gang gi zab yang gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gang / /rnam mang yongs su bsdud par byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar rnam thar 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog /rgyal ba'i sras po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad gang de rgyal/ /gzhung lugs kun gzigs bla ma yis/ /gzhung lugs 'dzin pa mkhas pa'i gsung / /gzhung lugs don la mkhas pas bkod/ /gzhung lugs ngo mtshar 'di longs shig /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa chos kyi rje yon tan 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul ni/ gang gi sku ni tshul khrims kyis mdzes mdzes ldan kun gyi yid rab 'phrog /gang gi gsung ni legs bshad rab rgyas rgyas pa'i chos char 'bebs la brtson/ /gang gi thugs ni zla ltar rab dkar dkar po'i dge la gcig tu gzhol/ /gang gi snyan grags 'gro la rab gsal gsal ba'i mthar thug gang der 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i dngos slob chos rje nyag bre yon tan 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i don 'grel zin bris las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgong skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa bde mchog rigs bsdus zhes bya ba cung zad cig gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la gnyis/ spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / mngon rtogs dngos so/ /dang po la gsum/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ngos bzung ba dang / bka'i dgongs 'grel ngos bzung ba dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa gsung pa ni snyigs dus kyi gdul bya tshe thung zhing / nyon mongs pa mang ba rnams kyi longs spyod mi nus par dgongs nas mkha' la spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtad nas/ de rnams kyi longs spyod cing / mi'i yul du mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas rgyud rgyas pa gsungs pa'i rjes thog la/ 'khor de nyid kyi dbus su rgyud rgyas pa'i don ma lus pa tshig nyung bar bsdus pa rtsa rgyud dam/ bsdus rgyud dam/ la gu saṃ bha ra'am/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud ces bya ba ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa 'di snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams la dgongs nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud ni/ khrag 'thung mngon 'byung / sdom 'byung / phag mo mngon 'byung / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ sam+bu ṭi/ nges brjod dam/ mngon brjod dam/ a bhi dha na ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i kha sbyor ste rgyud rnam dag dgu'o/ /gzhan yang phag mo mngon par byang chub pa sogs dang / ra li bskor rnams ni the tshom can yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag 'on kyang de rnams kyi nang nas rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud ni rgyud rnam dag yin pa ni ma rtogs gsung ngo / /de ltar bshad rgyud mang yang / rang lugs ni slob dpon skar rgyal zla ba'am/ thub dka' zla ba'am/

mi thub zla ba'am/ sbyangs dka' zla ba'am/ dur+ya tsan+t+ra ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs lnga dang ldan pas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bzhed de/ 'byung zhes pas he ru ka mngon 'byung ngam/ khrag 'thung mngon 'byung / mkha' 'gros rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ kun spyod kyis rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ bla mas nges brjod bla ma ste thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud bzhi zin/ kha sbyor rgyud kyi kyai rdor sogs rgyud gzhan dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud kha sbyor zin to/ /gnyis pa bka'i dgongs 'grel la gnyis te/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel dang / bshad rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi stod la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes 'grel pa mdzad/ de las bsdus pa 'gos lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i 'grel pa ldeb ma bco brgyad tsam gcig yod pa phyag rdor gyis mdzad nges yin/ de las rgyas pa po sti long ba tsam gcig 'dug pa ni phyag rdor gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa min yang rgya 'grel yin gsungs/ des na 'grel pa gnyis ka gcig tu bgrang ngo / /rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i 'grel pa dang / kong ka na rgyal bzang ngam/ lang ka rgyal bzang zhes pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs gnyis dang ldan pa des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / de'i 'grel byed lta bur gyur pa slob dpon skal ldan grags pa'i 'grel pa dang / de nyid kyang rgyas su btang ba lta bu'i 'grel pa ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa ste gsum po dgongs pa gcig go /lha sbas kyi 'grel pa dang / la ba'am/ la ba'i na bza' can nam/ kam ba la ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang gnyis don gcig go /bha ba bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ dur+ya tsan+t+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ gsang mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rjes zhes pa dang / mtshan drangs po la bi bhu ta tsan+t+ra zhes pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang /

'di yang zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gsang mtshan yin pas rgya 'grel min gsungs/ dpa' bo rdo rje zhes pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang gnyis po don gcig go /bal po bha dan ta'am/ su ma ti kirti zhes pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ste de ltar na 'grel pa bcu gnyis so/ /'grel pa de dag gi nang nas rang lugs ni su ma ti kirti dang / la ba pa'i 'grel pa'i rjes su 'brangs so/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung la gzhon nu zla bas 'grel pa mdzad/ sdom 'byung la slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi tas gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ phag mo mngon 'byung la ni 'grel pa ni med/ paṇ+ḍi ta u ma pa ṭi tas phag mo bskor drug mdzad yod/ 'on kyang 'di'i sgrub thabs dang / rgyud kyi lha rnams ma mthun pas rgyud de'i rjes 'brang min pa 'dra yang / rgya gzhung tshad ldan ni yin gsungs/ slob dpon 'di dang phyis bod du byon pa'i mu stegs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta u ma pa bsgom pa ṭi ta zhes pa dang gnyis po ming gcig pas nor par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i stod la slob dpon nor bzang gis 'grel pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma bha ba bha dras bzang po yongs rdzogs la 'grel pa mdzad do/ /ka la ka pas sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub kyi sems kun tu gzigs la mdzad/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la slob dpon pad+mas dus 'khor dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ de nyid kyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg sogs slob dpon dza ya se nas mdzad/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod la slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje dang / ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta dang / pad+ma badz+ra dang gsum gyis 'grel pa re re mdzad pa'i rang lugs ni/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i 'grel pa yin/ gzhan gnyis mi bzhed/ kha sbyor la in+t+ra bo dhi'i 'grel pa dang / a bh+ya ka ras 'grel pa man ngag snye ma mdzad/ yang slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gcig snang ste/
