de na zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gsang mtshan yin gyi rgya 'grel min no/ /yang ga ya dha ra bgres pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa zhes pa gcig snang ste/ de ni kha sbyor gyi 'grel pa ma yin/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ḍa gha dha sha nyid du snang ba la 'khrul pa yin no/ /nges brjod bla ma la slob dpon shu raṅka warma'i 'grel pa yod do/ /de dag ni rgya gar gyi srol yin la/ bod du srol byung tshul la lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la skal ldan grags pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa zhus/ sku tshe'i smad la jo bo rje la lhas sbas kyi 'grel pa'i bshad pa zhus/ yang jo bo rjes rong pa 'gar dge la yang lhas sbas kyi 'grel pa bshad/ zangs dkar lugs ni/ zangs dkar lo tsā bas pham things pa la zhus zer ba'i brgyud ris la 'dug 'gyur kha cig la/ bal po hang ngu dang / zangs dkar gyi bsgyur zer ba yod kyang ngo bo la dz+nyā na shrī la zhus par 'dug cing / man ngag yi ger bkod pa rnams pham things pa'i lugs dang cig kyang mi 'dra ba 'dug pas lugs gcig tu bgrangs so/ /yang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad ces pa dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi 'grel pa bi ra badz+ras mdzad ces pa dang / yid 'ong dpa' bo sgrub dkyil gnyis dang bcas pa rnams rgya gzhung min/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rje yin pas byas pa yin kyang bod rnams kyis nor nas bstan 'gyur du btsud pa yin gsungs/ pham things pa sku mched la mal lo tsā dang / spu hrang lo chung grags mchog shes rab dang / mar do rnams kyis zhus pa la/ mal dang spu hrang pa gnyis kar gyi bshad srol sa skya pa la yod/ yang spu hrang pa la grogs ra ba dngos grub shes rab la sogs pa mang du byung / da lta yig cha tsam las mi 'dug sa skya pa'i bshad srol ni da lta yang ma chad par yod do/ /mar do la ze ba dang lho la yag pa la rgyud 'di'i yig cha ma gtogs bshad pa chad 'dug

kha cig mar do lugs dang / ze ba lugs gnyis su bgrang ba ni mi 'thad de/ ze ba mar do'i slob brgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig bi bhu ta tsan+t+ra'i lugs dang / paṇa chen lugs dang / cha lugs dang / sbas sna lugs dang / a bh+ya'i lugs zhes bgrangs kyang / bi bhu ta'i lugs dang / paṇa chen dang / cha lugs thams cad kyang a bh+ya'i phreng ba las zur du phyung ba yin gyi/ zur pa ma yin pas a bh+ya'i lugs kho nar bgrangs so/ /sbas sna lugs yang zur du med de/ jo bo rje'i brgyud 'dzin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mngon rtogs kyi skor la bzhi/ rtsa bshad gang la brten nas mngon rtogs gang mdzad pa/ gang gis mdzad pa'i slob dpon/ des mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul/ bye brag tu lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi dgongs 'grel ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la gsum gyi dang po dpal mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi/ yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes dang / ri steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i zhes sogs la brten/ der mi gsal ba rnams rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyis kha bskang ba yin te/ de nyid las/ zhal mdog mtshon bya la sogs pa/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du sbas par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa nag po gzhung drug ni/ smin byed dbang gi cho ga ni rtsa rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs kyis bstan pa dang / der mi gsal ba rnams khrag 'thung mngon 'byung nas kha bskang ba la/ kha cig gis khrag 'thung mngon 'byung nas kha bskang ba mi 'thad de/ rtsa rgyud du ma bshad pa'i cho ga khyad par ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na gang gis kha bskang zhe na/ rtsa rgyud nas mi 'byung ba'i cho ga khyad par ba rnams sdom 'byung nas 'byung bas des kha bskangs so zhes gsungs kyang / sdom 'byung la smin byed dbang gi rnam gzhag khyad par can ston pa la lhag chad med mod/ 'on kyang der ni gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par lha rnams zhal gsum phyag drug tu bshad pa dang /

'grel byed kyis kyang de ltar bkral ba'i phyir dang / slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun dang / brtul zhugs bcu bzhi'i rnam gzhag ma byung bas 'dir kha bskang bar 'dod pa ni yang dag pa min no/ /des na rang lugs la slob dpon spyod pa dang dgongs pa mthun par dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun dang / brtul zhugs bcu bzhi'i rnam gzhag he ru ka mngon 'byung nas byung bas nges par kha bskang dgos so/ /grol byed lam gyi cho ga ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten nas mdzad/ sbyin sreg ni rtsa rgyud la gsal zhing cung zad ma tshang ba rdo rje mkha' 'gros kha bskang ba 'di la/ mar dos/ bod kha cig nag po gzhung drug zer nas sbyin sreg gcig la bgrang ba ni mi 'thad pa yin te/ sbyin sreg nyid las/ des ma mdzad par mngon te/ dz+nyā na pa tis bshad pa yi/ /gdams ngag rim pa la brten nas/ /zhes sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi rjes 'brang cig gis mdzad par 'byung bas/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga pad+ma dbyangs kyis mdzad pa bzhin byed zer yang / 'di ni lha sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa min no/ /gal te des mdzad pa yin na/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhig 'byung dgos pa ma byung zhing / nag po spyod pa ba'i bde mchog gi cho ga dang mthun par byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na dz+nyā na pa ti zhes pa ji ltar drangs zhe na/ 'di'i don ni nag po spyod pa'i bla ma dz+nyā na grub pa zhes bya ba yin zhing / de nyid gnas dza len+dha rar bzhugs pas dza len dha ri pa zhes kyang mtshan btags la/ de nyid kyi zhabs la nag po spyod pa bas btugs shing de nyid kyi gdams ngag la brten pas rten zhes brjod do/ /rdzogs rim gsum ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud nges brjod bla ma dang / kha sbyor dang gsum la brten/ de la gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba ni/

pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes sogs bshad pa dang / ma rgyud du gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa ni zhes sogs bshad pa na don mthun pa'i sgo nas rdzogs rim ston/ o la pa tis ma rgyud spyi dang mthun pa'i rdzogs rim ston/ de la o la pa ti zhes pa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi brdas btags pa'i ming yin la/ don ni rim pa bzhi pa zhes ston to/ /saṃ skri ta'i skad du rim pa bzhi la tsa tur kra ma zhes 'byung ba dang / 'dir brdas btags pa gnyis mthun no/ /dpyid kyi thig le ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim khyad par can bston to/ /gsum pa dril bu skor gsum ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud lnga ka la rten nas mdzad do/ /gnyis pa gang gis mdzad pa'i gang zag ni/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa slob dpon chen po lū hi pa zhes bya ba nya rgyu la 'tsho ba mdzad nas bsgrub pa mdzad pas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa des mdzad/ nag po gzhung drug ni/ shrī dza len+dha ri pa'i slob ma nag po spyod pa ba zhes bya ba bar dor mchog gi dngos grub thob pa des mdzad/ dril bu skor gsum ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos grub kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa zhes bya ba tshe gcig lus 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa des mdzad do/ /gsum pa slob dpon de rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul la/ lū hi pas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pas sbyang gzhi skye gnas bzhi las/ sgong skyes gtso bor sbyong ste/ nges brjod bla ma las/ sgong skyes glu ni med pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems can sgong skyes zhes bya ba nang sems can dang / phyi shun lpags dang bcas pa ma'i mngal nas lhan cig phyir 'byung ba bzhin/ mngon byang lnga las gcig car du rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha rnams bskyed pas rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa mi 'byung zhing /

thig ler zhu ba med/ zhu ba med pas glu zhes bya ba 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i sgra saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang / 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i sgra min zhes bya ba pra kṛ ta'i skad dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi brdas btags pa'i sgra glu'i bskul ba mi 'byung bas rnam par spangs pa'o/ /slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sbyang gzhi mngal skyes sbyong ste/ nges brjod las/ mngal skyes glu dang bcas pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /ces gsungs te/ dper na sems can ma'i mngal nas lus yongs su rdzogs nas phyir 'byung ba bzhin mngon byang lnga las/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed/ de 'od du zhu nas glus bskul ba ni sgra zhes bya ba 'jig rten la grags pa'i saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang / sgra min zhes 'jig rten la ma grags pa'i pra kṛ ta'i skad dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi brdas btags pa'i glus bskul ba la rnam par brtag ces brjod do/ /de ltar glu'i bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang yab yum du bzhengs pa'i mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas 'khor rnams mngal nas phyir 'byin pas na mngal skyes zhes kyang brjod do/ /dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sbyang gzhi brdzus skyes sbyangs so/ de lta bu'i mngon rtogs rnams gang zag gcig gis nyams su len tshul la/ spu hrang pa dpon slob rnams kyis gang zag chags pa che chung gi dbang du bsgom par bzhed de/ de la gang zag kha cig chags pa che zhing rig ma bsten dgos pa'i rigs la smin byed dbang yang dngos su rig ma gtad pa'i dbang bskur zhing / de las bde ba skyes pa'i nyams bskyang ba dang / nyams len gyi rim pa yang mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs la byed/ yang gang zag kha cig chags pa yang cung zad chung zhing rten yang rab byung gi rten la gnas pa la smin byed dbang yang dngos su rig ma mi gtad pa'i dbang tshig tsam gyis bskur zhing /

nyams len gyi rim pa yang sgong skyes kyi rim pa la byed/ 'di dag kyang gtso che chung gi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ spyir gsang sngags kyi chags pa che chung gang yang grol mi nus pa lta bu ni min no/ /mal lo tsā ba de ltar min te/ las dang po pa la dngos dbang bskur na byang chub kyi sems nyams par 'gyur la/ byang chub kyi sems nyams na dngos grub nyams par bshad de/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems ni nyams gyur na/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la thob/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang lugs la sems brtan pa che chung gi ngos nas bzhag ste/ de la gsum gyi/ dang po gang zag las dang po pa ni spros pa la dga' zhing / lha'i ting nge 'dzin kho na la 'jog mi nus pas mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs spros pa che ba bsgom gsungs/ de la spros pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mngon byang lnga las rten gzhal yas khang dang brten pa lha so so bskyed/ brten pa lha yang rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa so sor bskyed cing 'khor rnams mngal 'byin byed pas rgyas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa brtan pa cung zad thob pa ni/ spros pa la mi dga' zhing mnyam gzhag la dga' bas sngar las cung zad spros pa chung ba'i mngon rtogs sgong skyes bsgom mo/ /de la spros pa chung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mngon byang lnga las rten dang brten pa dus gcig la skyes pas so/ /gsum pa brtan pa cher thob pas ni/ dril bu pa'i lus dkyil kho na bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa bye brag tu dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i dgongs 'grel ngos bzung ba la gnyis te/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams kyis ji ltar bkral ba ngos bzung ba dang / bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi 'grel pa ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshig 'grel dang / don 'grel/ dang po ni/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa la slob dpon la ba pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'am/ brtag pa'i rdo rje zhes pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/

ku ma ra gzhon nu/ byang chub bo dhi'i 'grel pa/ jo bo rje'i 'grel pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje'i 'di yang zangs dkar lo tsā ba yin nam snyam 'grel pa ste tshig 'grel lnga'o/ /gnyis pa don 'grel ni/ bi bhu ta tsan+t+ras 'grel pa sdom 'byung zhes pa dang / de nyid gsal bar byed pa khyad par gsal byed dang rtsa 'grel gnyis mdzad/ a bh+ya ka ras sgrub thabs 'khrul spong mdzad/ nā ro pa'i slob ma rgya gar dha ri pas sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog gnyis mdzad/ de ltar na don 'grel gsum mo/ /gnyis pa bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi 'grel pa ngos bzung ba ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'grel pa dang / 'di jo bo rje'i rjes 'brang yin/ spu hrang grags mchog shes rab kyi slob ma rje btsun gyi slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal po dang / dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen la sogs pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa bcu gcig tsam yod gsungs/ sa skya pa la gnyan phul chung pa'i dbon po puṇ+ya badz+ra'i bsod nams rdo rje/ 'grel pa dang / dga' ldan pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis byas pa'i 'grel pa'o rje btsun gyi slob ma yin gsung / /gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos la gsum ste/ gang gis bsgom pa'i gang zag des sa bcad phyi ma gnyis po 'di'i don shes par 'dod na yon tan 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i don 'grel zin bris su blta bar bya'o/ /bsgom pa'i lam/ de ltar bsgom pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon dril bu pas/ 'gro kun don la rab gzhol ba/ /rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa la ji ltar bshad pa bzhin byang chub kyi sems gom par byas la/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde la ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/

'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud shes pa/ 'di'i sngags dag par bya ba'i phyir btu ba dang / btus pa'i sngags la bzlas pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la byang ba cig gis bsgom pa ni las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug go /gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ spyir las dang po pa'i 'tshe ba med cing bkra shis pa'i gnas su bsgom pa khyad par du bsngags pa'am/ yang na dur khrod du bsgom yang rung ste bar chad 'ong gi dogs nas bsgom pa la brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i dgos pa yod pa'o/ /bsgom pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa'i gdan la ro gdan bting bar bsam pa'am/ yang na ro ras zhes pa ro dur khrod du bskyal ba'i gos blangs la/ bting pa'i dgos pa ni/ ro la bdag med pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas kyang bdag med rtogs pa dang / bdag med la 'dris shing gom par byed pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bsgom pa'i dus kyi kha blta phyogs la/ sngags kyi rgyud sde phal cher la shar du blta bar bshad pa ni/ shar phyogs su dbang po gnas pa dang / nyi zla 'ong bas bkra shis pa'i phyogs yin pa la dgongs so/ /bya spyod phal cher dang / dus 'khor las shar dang / byang thabs kyi phyogs dang / lho dang nub shes rab kyi phyogs zer nas shes rab kyi phyogs su blta bar bshad pa bzhin no/ /'dir yang shes rab kyi phyogs lhor zhal bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ shes rab kyi rgyud gtso bor byed pa'i skor phyogs la ltos na g.yas bskor thabs/ g.yon bskor shes rab las/ 'dir g.yon bskor/ lag pa yang g.yas pa thabs/ g.yon pa shes rab la/ 'dir bya ba thams cad g.yon pas byed/ rkang pa yang g.yas pa thabs/ g.yon pa shes rab la/ 'dir g.yon pa sngon la 'ong / phyogs la shar dang byang thabs/ lho dang nub shes rab las/ 'dir lhor bstan/ 'o na lho dang nub gnyis ka shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa la/ nub tu mi blta zhing lhor blta ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ 'dir lhor blta ba la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/

spyir gdul bya gang na yod pa der/ 'dul byed kyang gzigs dgos pa las/ bde mchog gi gdul bya ni drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas yin pa lhor yod pa dang / gzhan yang gling gsum na skyes pa'i mi rnams ni longs spyod che zhing dbang po brtul la chos kyi snod ma yin par dgongs nas ma gzigs shing / lho 'dzam bu gling pa rnams longs spyod chung zhing dbang po rno la chos kyi snod du gyur par dgongs pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i lus re re la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bzhed pas dag pa'i zhing yin pa la dgongs pa dang / yang bha wa bha dras zhal lhor bstan pa ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs dang dga' ba'i yul yin pas so/ /zhes dang / la ba pas zhal lhor bstan shes rab kyi phyogs su bshad pa'i don ni gong dang 'dra la/ dga' ba ni/ phyogs la ltos na 'jig rten pa'i shar mchog dga' dang / byang khyad dga' las/ 'jig rten pa'i lho rnal 'byor pa'i shar skye dka' ba dga' ba bzhi'i nang gi dga' ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i nub rnal 'byor pa'i byang lhan skyes yin pas khyad par 'phags/ de las dga' ba'i phyogs lho yin pa skye dka' ba la bltas pas lan cig don grub bo gsungs so/ /de rnams kyis yon tan 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon rnams sems can don du dmyal ba dag tu spro bzhin 'gro/ /'gro ba 'di dag theg mchog la zhugs de rnams bzhin du gong du 'gro/ /'gro ba gang gi sdig pa spyad na chu bo bzhin du 'og tu 'gro/ /'gro 'ong gnas med rtogs pa gang des 'khor ba rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro/ /gang de'i skyes bu gang des thams cad mkhyen/ /de de'i skyes bu gang des kun la brtse/ /de de'i skyes bu gang de nus par ldan/ /de de'i skyes bu 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin rgyal sras kyis/

/gsung gi bdud rtsi gsung ba 'di/ /don gnyer rnams kyi don 'grub phyir/ /dag pa'i yid kyis dag par bkod/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa yongs 'dzin dam pa chos dpal bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ 'gro ba'i dpal mgon thub dbang gsung gi skye bo kun gyi rna ba'i dpal/ /de bzhin dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun gsung rab skal bzang kun gyi dpal/ /rmad byung dpal ldan kun dga' bzang po'i legs bshad sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal/ /de 'dra'i dpal gyis nye bar mdzes pa'i slob bu de dag bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa yongs 'dzin chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam par bshad pa smra ba ngan 'joms rin chen bsam 'phel zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gangs can 'di na mkhas pa'i dpal 'dzin 'ga'/ /kun gyi man ngag bcud bsdus legs bshad kyis/ /skyes bu grol bar 'dod pa'i gzhung 'di dag /thub pa'i dgongs min dogs nas brda sprad bgyi/ /thub dbang rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po yis/ /rjes 'jug bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong ba yi/ /skyes bu mkhas pa rnams la gnad kyi don/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dgongs pa 'di ltar gsungs/ /gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'jig rten 'di na yod pa ma yin te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis gzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid thugs la bzhag nas/ bdag gi 'dren pa dam pas mdo dang rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag so sor phye ste ston par mdzad do/ /'di nyid rig ste yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang / 'dul ba'i sde snod la'ang rtsa ba'i sde bzhi las phye ba'i sde pa bco brgyad po rnams kyang rang rang gi gzhung gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan par 'gyur zhing /

theg pa chen po la yang sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yang bstan pa rnam par dag pa yin la/ rgyud sde rnams la yang gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug la sogs pa rang rang gi gdul bya la dgongs te gsungs so/ /de nyid kyi phyir chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kyang / dag dug bsdus pa'i gos la ni/ /chen po rnams kyi chas mi rung / /de bzhin thun tshags bsdus pa yi/ /chos kyis dad can sangs mi rgya/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dir rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i tshul ma 'dres par brjod par bya'o/ /de la gnyis/ spyir rnam par gzhag pa dang / so so'i don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mdo dang rgyud sde'i dbye ba/ de las rnal 'byor gsang mtha' khyad par du 'phags tshul/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi bstan bcos ji ltar mdzad cing dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ji srid mdo zhes bya ba las ma gsungs kyang / dpyid kyi thig le las/ sgra shes bya phyir bstan bcos gang / /drang srong rig byed ji lta 'o/ /de ltar las kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mi rnams rab tu bya ba byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / sgra zhes pa nang pa dang / phyi rol pa gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin pas/ 'jig rten pa lam la ma zhugs pa las/ bzo dang tha snyad la zhugs pa rnams khyad par du byas so/ /de dag bas kyang mu stegs byed khyad par du 'phags te lam 'tshol ba la zhugs pas so/ /de la'ang gnyis te bsam gtan pa dang / rtog ge pa'o/ dang po la skye bas thob pa dang / sbyor ba las byung ba'o/ /'di las dbye bas lta log sum brgya drug cu'i dbye ba yod do/ /rtog ge pa la rtsa ba'i grub mtha' lnga yod mod/ mchog ni gcer bu pa yin te/ /'di na gos med gcer bu dge slong la/ /mu stegs rnams kyi slob dpon ston par grags/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de dag las ni gnas ma bu pa khyad par 'phags te/

lta ba bdag med pa khas mi len kyang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin cing las 'bras la mkhas pas so/ /de las dngos por smra ba nyan thos sde pa khyad par 'phags te/ lta ba bdag med par 'dod pas so/ /de las kyang theg pa chen po sems tsam pa khyad par 'phags te/ chen po bdun dang ldan par 'dod pas so/ de las kyang theg pa chen po dbu ma pa khyad par 'phags te/ chos thams cad spros bral du 'dod pas so/ /de'ang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mdo'i don cung zad tsam mo/ /da ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi tshul brjod par bya ste/ de la rig pa ni me tog phog pa'i lha dang / de'i snying po la sogs pa yin la/ 'dzin pa ni dang po dkyil 'khor du zhugs te me tog phog pa'i lha dang / de'i snying po bzung nas lha'i rnal 'byor ram bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa lam du byas pas/ tshe 'di nyid dam srid pa bar do'am/ skye ba brgyud nas 'bras bu mthar thug bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'dod cing / de'i zhar la dman pa zhi sogs dang / 'bring bsgrub pa chen po brgyad thob par 'dod pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par yang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtogs bya lta ba dang / thob bya 'bras bu dang / spyod pa phul du phyin pa gcig na'ang / khyad par du 'phags pa bzhi'i khyad par du 'phags so/ /rgyas par rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la'ang / rgyud sde dang slob dpon rnams kyi dgongs pa mi mthun pa du ma yod mod kyang / dpal nā ro ta pa'i grub chen la ba pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i 'grel par/

bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor rnams dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo bya ba dang / sbyor ba lhan cig mnyam par gyur pa byed pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa'ang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin zhes gsungs pa dang / le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rgyud sde drug tu bzhed do/ /de la bya ba'i rgyud ni legs par grub pa la sogs te/ phyis lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas so/ /de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par/ 'di ni phyi'i bya ba gtso bor gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud la sogs te/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud las zhes bshad cing / spyod pa zhes pa phyi lus ngag dang / nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam par spyod pa ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus don las/ 'di ni phyi dang nang gi rnal 'byor gnyis ka thun mong du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa ste/ nang sems kyi bya ba lha'i ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa ste/ slob dpon kun snying gi de nyid snang chen gyi bsdus don las/ rgyud 'di ni bsgom pa gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/ 'dir bsgom pa nyid la 'bad par bya'i/ grangs kyi bzlas pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /rnal 'byor pha bla na med pa'i rgyud ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs te/ thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor ston pa tsam 'dra mod kyang / dbang bzhi dang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor sa bcu gsum dang bcas pa ston pa ste/ dgongs pa lung ston gyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gang bsten pa'i/ /sa gyur de ni bcu gsum pa/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ snying po kyai rdo rje dang / mahā ma ya dang / sdom 'byung la sogs pa ste/ brjod bya rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa ste/ slob dpon nag po spyod pas/ bskyed dang rdzogs 'byung dbye ba yin/ /bskyed pa rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma ru dran/ zhes bshad pas so/ /rnal 'byor ma'i ma bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ste/ le'u gsum pa las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud la sogs pa dag /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs te/ /de nyid bsdus pa 'khor sdom mam/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog 'di ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ de la rnal 'byor zhes pa ni/ rnam snang sgyu dra las/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis su med par thal bar sbyor bas so/ /gsang ba ni rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la gab cing gsang ba'o/ /mtha' ni/ sgron gsal las/ mtha' ni mur thug pa'i tshig /ces gsungs pas rnal 'byor bla med kyi zab don mthar thug pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rgyud la gsum/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gang la brten pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud ji ltar yod tshul/ bka'i dgongs 'grel ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la rgyud rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la bla ma rnams kyi bzhed lugs gnyis 'byung ste/ bla ma pham things pa'i bzhed pas/ rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos 'khor sa bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsungs te/

chos kyi longs spyod nyams su myong ba tsam mdzad nas snyigs ma lnga ldan gyi gang zag rnams la mi mkho zhing / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bsdu ba dka' bar dgongs nas sgra nam mkha' la rgyas btab pas shin tu gsang ba'i rgyu mtshan yin gsungs so/ /yang bla ma nā ro pa'i slob ma rgya gar dha ri ka pa dang / bal po thugs rje chen po la sogs pa ni rin chen bai ḍūr+ya las gser zhun mas bris pa sh+lau ka 'bum phrag gsum byung ba de nyid snyigs ma lnga ldan gyi sems can la slob pa'i yan lag tu ma gyur pas nub phyogs o ṭi bhi shar mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab ste bzhag pas rgyud sde drug par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhes gsungs so/ /rgyu mtshan gnyis pa ni rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shan+ti pas rgyud mang po'i 'grel pa mdzad kyang / 'di'i 'grel pa rtsom pa'i grab mdzad pas zhal nas khrag skyugs pas rtsom ma nus te/ bka' gnyan pas gsang ba'am drug par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ sprul sku gzhan rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas mi yul du mi bzhugs par bshad la/ 'dir ni 'dzam bu gling na yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi bsdud byed kyi gtso bor bzhugs te sgrub pa po rnams kyi rgyud la byin rlabs myur du 'jug pas rgyud sde drug par bzhag ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni de ltar rgyud rgyas pa'i bzhugs tshul gnyis po gang ltar yin yang rung 'khor de rnams kyi dbus su rtsa rgyud rgyas pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'am/ la gu saṃ bha ra'am/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud ces bya ba 'dir rgyud rgyas pa'i don mtha' dag ma tshang par med la/ tshig nyung ba 'di gsungs te rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di nyid do/ /'dir bla ma phyi ma kha cig bla ma mal nas brgyud pa rnams rgyud sde drug tu byed pa la ba pa'i dgongs par 'chad mod kyang /

de'i dgongs par yang mi snang la/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi dri med 'od las gsang 'dus dang kyai rdor gyi rgyud rnams kyang gnyis med kyi rgyud du gsungs pa la sogs pa'i gnod pas mi legs so zhes zer mod/ 'di ni rnam par ma bcad pa chen po ste/ nges don du gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dbye ba mi 'gog mod/ la ba pa'i dgongs pa yin zhes pa'ang sngar le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i 'grel pa'i lung gi grub cing / drug tu byed pa la gnod byed yod do zhes pa ni/ grub chen dang rgyud gnyis 'gog pa ste/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes spyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye zhing / de'i nang nas ma rgyud rdzogs rim zab par gnas/ mngon rtogs kyi skabs su/ bde mchog 'khor lo gsang ba'i don/ /grub pa'i gsang sngags kun bsdus nas/ /brda yi skad kyi sbas pa ste/ /zhes sbas don gyi man ngag tu gsungs pas drug par nges shing / rnam pa gcig tu na/ rdo rje 'chang nyid 'gog pa ste/ rtsa rgyud le'u gsum par/ gsang ba'am rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes pas pha rgyud dang / 'khor sdom dang zhes pas ma rgyud bstan la/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi mchog 'di ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyud sde drug pa gsang mtha' gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel pa pos de ltar bshad pa med pa'i phyir zhes pa brdzun te/ la ba pas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud la mkhas pa kha cig mi thub zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /ces bshad pa'i 'byung gis sdom 'byung / khrag 'thung sngon 'byung / phag mo mngon 'byung gsum/ mkha' 'gros rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ kun spyod kyis mkha' 'gro kun spyod/ kha sbyor rgyud kyis sam+bu ṭi dang / rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyar gyi rgyud/

bla mas nges brjod bla ma zin pas bshad rgyud rnam gzhag dgu'o/ /ra li rgyud sogs gnyis dang / phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u gsum pa rnams brdzus mar 'dod do/ /de la bshad rgyud ston byed kyi lung de tshad mar byed dam mi byed/ dang po ltar na nang 'gal te bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ zhes gsungs kyi/ dgu ru 'dod ces ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ltar na lung drangs pa don med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ /yang phyis kyang kha cig kun spyod kha sbyor ro/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ nges brjod bla ma/ sdom 'byung / phag mo mngon 'byung yang nges brjod las phyung ba'am/ bshad rgyud yin pas drug go zhes zer zhing / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyar cha mthun gyi rgyud yin la/ spyir rtsa bshad gnyis ma nges/ phyogs mthun gyi rgyud yod cing / bod snga ma kha cig he ru ka mngon 'byung bshad rgyud du 'dod cing / de yang dbang bskur ba'i bshad rgyud yin zer mod kyang / rtsa rgyud las mi 'byung ba'i dbang gi rnam gzhag cher med pa dang / gzhan bshad rgyud du mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal bar mi snang bas/ phyogs mthun gyi rgyud yin zer ro/ /'di yang ma brtags pa ste/ gzhan la gsang mtha' drug tu gsungs pa/ la ba pas bshad bzhin du 'grel pa gang na'ang 'dug pa ma mthong zer bzhin du khyed kyis drug 'dod pa'i lugs de 'grel pa gang nas bshad/ sdom 'byung bshad rgyud yin te/ sku'i dag pa la phan pa he ru ka phyag gnyis pa sogs ston pas so zhes zer mod/ de lta na ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ni zhal gsum phyag drug par byed rigs par 'gyur ro/ /des na mkhas pa bzhad gad kyi gnas yin no/ /he ru ka mngon 'byung nas rtsa rgyud na med pa'i dbang gi rnam gzhag med ces smra ba yang legs par ma rtogs pa ste/ dpa' bo bskul ba/

dbyangs skyong gi sngags/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bcu bzhi sogs grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag de nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ltar du smra ba ni bag chol 'ba' zhig go /cha mthun dang phyogs mthun gyi rgyud zhes pa'ang yo ga'i brda chad yin pas phan tshun bsre bar mi bya'o/ /des na rang gi lugs ni rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung las 'byung ba 'di bzhin du rgyud na'ang gnas pas bshad pa'i srol ni bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa/ ma rgyud spyi ltar bshad pa/ dus 'khor ltar bshad pa/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni nā ro pa'i gdam ngag gi bshad pa pham thing pa nas rim gyis brgyud nas byung ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud lnga sbyar nas 'chad par mdzad de/ skar rgyal zla ba'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa las/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyar rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dod de/ 'byung gis rtsa rgyud du dbang gi bshad pa mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pa he ru ka mngon 'byung zin/ mkha' 'gros mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs gsal bar byed pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ kun spyod kyis sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs gsal bar byed pa rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ kha sbyor gyis rdzogs rim gsal bar byed pa sam+bu ṭi/ bla mas bskyed rim gyi lha'i zhal phyag dang las tshogs gsal bar byed pa nges brjod ma rnams bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ma rgyud spyi ltar bshad pa ni/ sngar gyi rtsa bshad la brten nas slob dpon skal ldan grags pa dang / dur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa sogs kyis bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i sh+lau ka bcu gcig la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes dus 'khor dang mthun par bkral ba de'i rjes su 'brangs nas slob dpon pad+ma pas rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro sbyar nas bskyed rdzogs thams cad dus 'khor dang mthun pa'i bshad pa mdzad do/

/bzhi pa gsang 'dus dang mthun par bkral ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud sdom 'byung sbyar nas bskyed rdzogs phal mo che 'dus pa 'phags lugs ltar byas te/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas de ltar du byas so/ /gsum pa bka'i dgongs 'grel ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba dang / bshad rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'o/ /dang po la rtsa rgyud kyi stod la byang chub sems dpa' 'am phyag na rdo rjes 'grel pa mdzad de/ de la'ang bsdus pa 'gos lo tsā bas 'gyur ma shog bu mda' tshad bco brgyad tsam yod pa phyag rdor gyis mdzad nges yin/ de las rgyas pa po sti kha long tsam yod pa yang 'grel pa'i bshad 'grel yin gsungs te/ dus 'khor ltar 'grel pa la mi dgos kha med min gsungs/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi 'grel pa dang / kong ka na rgyal bzang 'am/ lang ka rgyal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / de yang 'grel bshad lta bur gyur pa skal ldan grags pa'i 'grel pa dang / de nyid kyang rgyas su btang ba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa ste gsum po dgongs pa cig go /la ba pa'am/ la bi na bza' can nam/ kam pa la ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa ste/ de rnams don gcig tu shes par bya'o/ /de nyid kyis mdzad pa dang / slob dpon bha bi las mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sgrub thabs kyi gnas pa zhes pa ste gnyis po dgongs pa mthun/ dur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa'am/ thub dka' zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / gsang mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje dang / mtshan dngos bi bhu ta tsaṇ+ḍas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / dpa' bo rdo rje dang / zangs dkar lo tsā ba gnyis gcig ste/ bstan 'gyur ba rnams kyis bcug pa yin gsungs te/ de rnams ni ma rgyud spyi ltar bkral ba'i lugs so/ /bal po bha dan ta'am/ su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ste/ gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa dang cung zad mthun te/ de ltar bcu gnyis tsam yod pa las/ rang lugs la cung zad phan pa su ma ti dang /

la ba pa'o/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung la gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa yod cing tshad mar byed/ bshad bka' dang lung bka' yang ma chad par yod gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la stod la slob dpon nor bzang gi 'grel pa yod/ de'i slob ma bha wa bha dras yongs rdzogs la 'grel pa mdzad/ 'di gnyis tshad mar mdzad kyang / nā ro pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bshad srol shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis 'grel pa la mchan btab pa'i bshad bka' dang lung bka' ma chad par yod gsungs/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod la ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dpa' bo rdo rje gsum las/ dang po la ba ri ba nas brgyud pa'i bshad bka' dbang bka' sa skya pa la yod kyang / man ngag gi bshad pa rje btsun rin po che'i bsdus don dang dka' 'grel mdzad pa gtso bor byed/ sam+bu ṭi la in+d+ra bo dhi'i 'grel pa/ a bha ya ka ras man ngag snye ma mdzad/ yang dpa' bo rdo rje'i 'grel pa cig snang ste/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gsang mtshan yin gyi rgya 'grel min/ yang ga ya dha ra bgres nas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa snang ste/ de ni kha sbyor gyi 'grel pa min/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ṭaṃ ka dha sha nyid du snang ba la 'khrul pa yin no/ /nges brjod la shu rang ka warma'i 'grel pa yod kyang gtso bor mi 'dzin/ man ngag gi bshad pa la gong ma rnams gtso bor mdzad cing / bshad bka' lung bka' ma chad pa yod/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyar gyi rgyud kyi chags lam kho na ston cing / in+d+ra bo dhis rgyud rgyas pa las phyung ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu yin par 'dod pas/ ma rgyud chags lam yod tshad kyi bshad rgyud yin gyi/ bde mchog kho na'i bshad rgyud ma yin no/ /yang phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud ni bshad rgyud du bgrangs rung / ma bgrangs kyang rung / 'di'i don thams cad nges brjod kyi le'u gcig tu 'byung ba'i phyir/

u ma pa ti ta'i phag mo mngon 'byung gi sgrub thabs/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su phag mo dpa' gcig bsgom pa dang / lha lnga dang / so bdun bsgom pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa/ dbang bka' ra chos rab nas brgyud pa da lta yang ma chad par yod pa ni rgyud 'di la brten pa ma yin te/ rgyud du lha rnams gdong brnyan can du gsungs pa dang / sgrub thabs su gdong brnyan med par gsungs pas mi 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rgya gzhung rnam dag yin gsungs/ yang dus phyis sa skya pa'i chos 'khor gcig gi dus kyi 'bul bskyel mdo smad pa blo gros rgyal pos rgya gar rdo rje gdan du bskyal ba dang / mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta u ma pa ti ṭa zhes pa sgra tshad snyan ngag la mkhas pa gcig dang 'phrad pas/ des bod du gser mang bar 'dug pas/ nga yang khyod kyi rjes la gser bsgrub tu 'gro zer ba la/ khyod mu stegs pa bod du song yang za mi zos/ nga la yang bod kyi rgyal pos chad pa gcod du yong / 'gro na rab byung gyis/ nang pa'i sngags slob byas pas/ kho song nas byang chub chen po'i drung du ser mo gyon/ sngags kyi yig cha rnyed tshad bris byung pa la/ khyod rab tu byung ngam dris pas byung zer/ su la rab tu byung / kho bos byang chub chen po'i drung du ser chas gyon pa tsam la brten nas rab tu byung zer/ sngags bslab bam byas pas bslab zer/ su la bslab byas pas/ a pha la bslab zer/ 'byung med rgya gar na mkhas pa 'di tsam la mi bslab byas pas/ chos mkhas pa ku ku rang rang ni a pha la bslab/ a phas ni bud+dha la bslab zer nas bod du 'ong pa/ 'tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes yon bdag byas nas sngags kyi dbang bka' yang mang po bzos pa rang bzo kho na yin pas dor ba'i gnas so/ /'di dang gong gi gnyis nor bar mi bya'o/ /rgyud ra li sogs gnyis dang phag mo mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / phag mo mngon par rdzogs pa'i rgyud rnams kyi nang nas snyog pa med pa'i rgyud ma gtogs gzhan rnams rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis ma dag par bzhed/

rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud ni kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rnam dag yin zhing / ku ma ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i 'grel pa yang yod do/ /de la ra li so gnyis kyi ston tshul ni/ sku'i rgyud brgyad/ gsung gi brgyad/ thugs kyi brgyad ni dpa' mo nyer bzhis zhus nas/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pa li la sogs pa'i nyer bzhis gsungs par 'dod/ 'phros pa'i brgyad ni mtshams ma brgyad kyis gsungs par 'dod pa rnams ni rje ga ya dha ra la gnyos kyi bde mchog gi man ngag zhus pa'i yi ger bkod cing rgyud du ming btags pa yin zhes bshad 'dug pas brdzun ma'o/ /yang ra li rnams nyams kyi rgyud yin nam snyam le'u gsum pa gcig 'byung ba ni/ a bha yas bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs dang / bskyed rdzogs gnyis rnams zhang 'tshal ba la byung ba dang / rten pa'i rgyud gcig med na mi yong bar 'dug snyam nas byin rlabs ston pa'i le'u/ bskyed rim ston pa'i le'u/ rdzogs rim ston pa'i le'u gcig gsum brtsams nas rgyud du ming btags nas sa bcad khog phub byas rung rang bzo kho nar zad do/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la ni phyag rdor stod 'grel la brten nas slob dpon pad+mas dus 'khor dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa gru rdzing zhes bya ba mdzad/ sgrub dkyil dza ya se na la rje btsun rin po ches zhus nas dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ lung bka' rnams ma chad par yod/ yang dza ya se na la rong sgang pas zhus/ de la srin po ri pas zhus/ de la karma pa rang byung rdo rjes zhus/ khong gi byas pa'i sgrub dkyil byas mod/ dkyil chog la dus 'khor gyis byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun kho na bris nas/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i cho ga ma bris pa'i phyir dang / brgyud pa yang ma dag ste/ karma pa rgya yul du byon pa'i dus su rgyal pos mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang dgos byas pas/ grwa pa gcig la rang gi zhus nas dbus gtsang du thob pa'i khung byas nas gsang zhing dbang bskur byas pas brgyud pa ma dag pa'o gsungs/

yang rong sgang pa dar ma snying po la gzhan rgyud lugs kyang yod gsungs so/ /sdom 'byung gi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi tas rtsa rgyud dang / sdom 'byung gi rgyud sbyar nas bskyed rdzogs kyi don rnams 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang mthun par bkral zhing / sdom 'byung 'grel pa'i dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ lung bka' rnams chag los zhus shing / bod du yang rgyud 'grel bsgyur/ bshad pa da lta yang ma chad par yod pa dang / gshong los rgyud la 'gyur dang / mchan dang sa bcad mdzad yod gsungs/ rje btsun gyi sdom 'byung gi bshad bka' nā ro pa la med gsungs/ 'on kyang dza ya se na la dbang bka' lung bka' zhus kyang / da lta ni dbang bka' med gsungs/ gnyis pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ bya rgyud ji ltar khyad par 'phags zhe na/ rang don tu phar phyin drug gam bcu spyod cing / gzhan don du bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / lta ba rnam par dag pa rnams ni 'dir yang mi spong la/ de'i steng du smin par byed pa chu'i dbang dang / lam la mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor/ mdun du ras bris la ye shes pa spyan drangs zhing phyag dang mchod pa phul nas ras bris la dmigs te bzlas pa byas pas/ bltas pa'i bde ba tsam nyams su myong zhing / mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor mer gnas dang / sgrar gnas dang / sgra mthar thar pa ster ba sogs kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de las spyod rgyud ji ltar du 'phags zhe na/ chu'i dbang tsam dang / ras bris la dngos grub len pa sogs ni 'dir yang mi spong la/ de'i steng du smin byed la dbang dbu rgyan dang phyag mtshan dang ming gi dbang sogs yod cing / lam la yang bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa dang / mdun du ras bris la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas sngags dang phyag rgya bstan nas rgod pa tsam gyis bde ba nyams su myong ba dang /

sngar ltar gyi mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pas dngos grub myur du 'grub pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de las rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ji ltar khyad par 'phags zhe na sngar gyi de dag mi spong mod/ dbang gi skabs su yang rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba yod cing / lam la yang bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug nas dbyer med du byas pa la phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa dang / mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la nyams snang gsum bsgom zhing / lag bcang gi bde ba lam du byas nas dngos grub myur du 'grub pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de las rnal 'byor bla med ji ltar khyad par du 'phags zhe na/ smin byed dbang gi dus su yang dbang gong ma gsum yod cing / lam gyis dus su yang grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid yongs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de'i don la kha cig gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor rgyud las khyad par du 'phags par 'dod kyang / rang lugs la dpal ldan 'dus pa rnal 'byor bla med thams cad la sbyor ste/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis dbyer med par 'dus pa la brten rnal 'byor gyi rgyud pa rnams/ sngon 'byung ston pa'i rnam 'phrul ste/ /rjes 'jug bsgrub pa'i nyams len yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang mi 'gog mod/ /sbyang gzhi skye ba sbyong bar byed pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / shi ba sbyong bar byed pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa yod pas skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub par byed pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /yang rnal 'byor pha rgyud du rlung gi rnal 'byor dang phyag rgya'i lam la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim yod mod/ 'on kyang nag po spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ bskyed dang rdzogs 'byung rim pa yi/ /bskyed pa rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma ru dran/

/zhes rdzogs rim rtsa'i rnal 'byor dang / gtum mo dang 'phrul 'khor la sogs pa gsal bar bshad pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de las gsang mtha' ji ltar du khyad par 'phags snyam na/ 'di la khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul gsum ste/ byin rlabs myur ba dang / bskyed rim zab pa dang / rdzogs rim myur bas khyad par du 'phags so/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku rnams bsdus nas mi yul na mi bzhugs par bshad la/ 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das kyi gdul bya drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas btul nas/ sprul pa dpa' bo nyer bzhi yul nyer bzhir dngos su bzhugs par bshad cing / de rnams kyis bde mchog bsgrub pa po la myur du byin gyis rlobs pas khyad par du 'phags te/ dper na/ sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs pa'i dus su bsgrub pa po rnams kyi dngos grub myur du thob pa bzhin no/ /gal te rgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa bden mod/ 'khor lo bde mchog gzhan las khyad par bzhugs so zhe na/ dbul po'i mal 'og na gter yod kyang ma mthong bas ni dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mi sel la/ mthong bas ni de'i sdug bsngal sel ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim zab pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ ma rgyud spyi'i lha la dam tshig pa bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug pa tsam las ma bshad kyang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'di ni rtsa rgyud du sgra'i tshul la nges 'byung zhing / zhes pas mngal skyes bstan/ sgra zhes pas mngal skyes su ji ltar 'gro snyam na/ sam+bu ṭi las/ sgra ni sngags zhes bya bar brjod/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyogs gcig go /zhing 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang zhes pas zhing skyes dang / pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ zhes pas pho nya lhan skyes bstan la/ de rnams bsre ba yang / de nas pho nya legs bsres nas/ /bsgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'grel ba'i tshul yang /

yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas gzhan rnams la de lta bu'i bsre tshul med pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gcig yin no/ /gsum pa rdzogs rim myur bas khyad par 'phags tshul ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid gya nom pa de thabs rgya che ba gcig gis 'grub pa dang / thabs rgya chung la myur ba gcig gis 'grub pa gnyis la myur bas 'grub pas khyad par 'phags tshul bshad pa la dpe gsum don dang bzhi las/ shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ rnal 'byor pa lam gyi gnad la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shan pas glang po che la sogs pa gsod pa'i tshe/ yan lag la sogs pa gang du yang mi brdeg par/ sems kyi rten gang na gnas bltas te/ gang gnas par snyug ma tshal pa gcig brgyab pa tsam gyis 'phral du 'chi ba bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas rtsa thig rlung gsum dbu mar zhugs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lho nub kyi phyogs na rgyal po bho dza de wa zhes bya ba'i khang pa yod pa la/ de'i nang na chu ris byas te rtsi btang nas yod pa'i seb tu nya dang chu srin la sogs pa'i gzugs du ma bris nas yod pa la/ 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad cig gis gzhan dag gis chu dngos su mthong ba dang / de na yod pa'i srog chags kyis gzugs thams cad 'khyug par mthong nas der sus kyang 'gro ma nus pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi na sgo yod pa'i g.yas g.yon na shing gi mi ral gri la sogs pa thogs pa gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan mo'i dus su/ de'i nang du rdo la sogs pa gzhan gyis skyur ram/ phyi nas byung ba'i mi thams cad dum bu brgya stong du gtub pa la/ 'phrul 'khor gyi thag pa gcig bcad pa tsam gyis chu nang na srog chags yod pa de kun yang mi snang bar 'gro la/ shing gi mi kun yang 'gyel nas 'gro ba bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas kyang rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas so/

/gsum pa ni lho phyogs ḍā ki ni pa ba zhes bya ba na/ shing gi sdong po chen po yod pa la/ mi brgya phrag re tsam gyi phyogs gcig nas bcad kyang / phyogs gcig nas skye zhing mi chod pa la/ shing mkhan gnad shes pas gang nas chu rgyu ba'i shing gi sbubs cig tu shing gi gzer gcig btab nas bzhag pa tsam gyis skam nas 'gyel nas 'gro ba bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas kyang rlung sems dbu mar myur du zhugs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gang brjod par bya ba'i chos kyi dbyings de kho na nyid rang la ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan 'byung yang / da ltar yon tan de dag sems la mi snang bas/ lam bsgom pa'i stobs kyis rtsa thig rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa'i thabs slob dpon nag po pas dpyid kyi thig les ston pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /gsum pa bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi bstan bcos ji ltar mdzad cing dar ba'i tshul ni/ thog mar rdo rje'i 'chang chen pos/ phyag na rdo rje la dbang bskur ba dang rjes su gnang ba byin/ des slob dpon sa ra ha chen po la dbang bskur nas gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs bshad de/ slob dpon de da lta yang dpal gyi ri la 'jig rten du nyi zla nam gnas kyi bar du bzhugs nas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i lus kyis longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gnas pa yin no/ /des slob dpon klu sgrub la 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ 'dus pa dang bde mchog la sogs pa bshad/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du mchod rten bye ba phrag gcig gser 'gyur gyis/ rtsi mas sogs pa mdzad de/ sems can rnams la phan pa dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /des slob dpon sa ra ha chung ba zhes kyang bya/ ri khrod dbang phyug zhes kyang bya ste de la dbang bskur zhing rjes su gnang ba byin/ de nyid kyis bde mchog la brten nas sbyor drug gi gzhung chung mdzad pa ma gtogs gzhan mdzad pa med do/

des grub chen lū hi pa zhes pa 'tsho ba la ming du btags pa de la rjes su gdams/ des rgyal po gi pa dang / slob dpon dha ri ka pa gnyis la gdams te/ de gnyis kyi don du rtsa rgyud kyi sgra'i tshul sogs dang / ri steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng / zhes dang / mngon brjod kyi sgong skyes glu ni med pa dang / /zhes sogs cha kha cig dang / kun spyod kyis gdam ngag rnams bsgrigs nas dpal mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa la/ 'di la tshig dang don gyi 'grel pa brgyad tsam 'byung ba ni/ 'og sgrub thabs kyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad do/ /grub chen dha ri ka pa zhes pa bsgyur na bud med can zhes pa des kyang rang gi slob dpon gyi gzhung lugs bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ kun spyod kyis rgyud rgyas pa'i nang nas 'khor lo gsum bkod pa'i rtog pa phyung ba yin cing / gzhan gzhung gang yang ma mdzad la/ bu ston gyis sgrub dkyil mdzad pa'i brten pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa ni nā ro pa'i slob ma rgya gar dha ri ka pa yin/ lū hi pa'i dngos slob min/ 'on kyang gsang mtha'i lugs yin pas sa skya pa'i lugs la phan gsungs/ des rdo rje dril bu pa la gdams te/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag la brten nas rtsa bshad thams cad kyi rgyud tshig bsgrigs nas/ smin byed dbang gi cho ga grol byed la lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga rnams mdzad de dril bu skor gsum du grags so/ /ras chung snyan brgyud pa rnams la rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i yig cha 'ga' 'dug kyang / sa skya pa la ma brgyud pas mi bgrang gsungs/ yang dril bu pas mdzad pa'i dril chung lha lngar grags pa de ni mar do las brgyud pa ni grub chen dril bu pas mdzad pa min kyang / mtshan gcig pa cig gi mdzad pas mi 'brang ngo /

/de nas rus sbal zhabs dang shrī dza len+dha ra ba gnyis kyis yig cha mdzad pa med/ slob dpon de nyid kyis grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje la rjes su gdams so/ nag po spyod pa'i bar la rtsa rgyud kyi/ ba glang lhas kyi mi bying dang / /zhes sogs dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud rnams bsgrigs nas snyan brgyud kyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams khong gi yi ger bkod nas mdzad pa la/ mngal skyes sbyong byed kyi sgrub thabs dang / lū nag gnyis ka thun mong du dgongs pa'i rtsa bshad kyi sbyin sreg gi skabs rnams bkol nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad do/ /'di la phyis kyi kha cig mar dos bkag pas yin min brtag go zhes zer mod/ 'di ni slob dpon nyid kyis mdzad pa yin te/ de nyid la dz+nyā na pa ti'i bshad pa/ sbyin sreg cho ga'i phyi rol pa/ zhes rang gi bla ma'i mtshan 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /the tshom yod pa ma yin no/ /'o na dza lan+dha ri pa zhes pa ma byung ngo snyam na/ de ni gnas la mtshan du btags pa'o/ /rtsa rgyud kyi dbang chog ston pa'i skabs rnams dang / bshad rgyud he ru mngon 'byung gi dbang gi skabs rnams nag po pa yan gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams gdam ngag bsgrig pa'i phyir ma bkod la/ khong gi yi ger bkod pa nag po dkyil chog tu grags so/ /'di la phyis kyi kha cig nag po dkyil chog lū hi pa la sbyar rgyu ma yin zhes bkag nas/ rang lugs la dril bu pa'i dbang chog bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ a bha ya'i lugs rnams bkod mod/ de ni ma brtag pa yin te/ phal mo che nag po mngon rtogs dang mthun pas nag po dkyil chog kyang yin la/ mdun du dkyil 'khor la lha dgod pa'i skabs su 'khor gyi lha mo lū hi pa dang mthun par zhal gcig phyag bzhi par mdzad pa'i phyir lū hi pa'i dkyil chog kyang yin no/ /spyir slob mas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog slob dpon gyis mdzad pa la sbyar du mi rung na/

grub chen klu byang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog mdor byas la sbyar du mi rung ba dang / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bir+wa pa dang mar me mdzad kyi bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sgrub thabs la sbyar du mi rung bar 'gyur te/ slob dpon de dag gis ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de dag ni dgag pa la dga' ba tsam du zad do/ /gzhan yang ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bshad pa rnams la rdzogs rim kyi bshad pa mdzad pa med kyang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa rnams la rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa yod de/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje yan la rtsa rgyud kyi/ mchod gzhi dpa' bo chen po ni/ /dbang gnyis yang dag snyoms par 'jug /ces dang / gsang ba mchog gi dgos pa na/ /zhes dang / sngags bsdu sbyin sreg gtor ma rnams des don du bshad pa'i gdam ngag bshad rgyud kha sbyor gyi rdzogs rim ston byed kyi skabs rnams sbyar zhing ston pa rnams slob dpon nag po pas yi ger bkod par mdzad pa ni/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus sogs la 'di skad bdag gis thos bshad pa de nyid/ ma rgyud du/ gsang ba mchog gi dgos pa na/ /zhes sogs bshad pa don mthun par ston pa/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad pa ni sngon 'gro'i rdzogs rim yin la/ rtsa bshad gnyis kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i skabs rnams gcig tu bsdus nas bris pa'i rim pa bzhi ni rdzogs rim gyi dngos gzhi yin zhing / phal cher bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi kho na'i dpyid thig zur du bskol ba/ dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba mdzad pa ni bde mchog gi myur ba'i rdzogs rim yin no/ /de ltar drug po de ni nag po gzhung drug tu grags pa yin zhing / spyir yang lū nag dril gsum char yang bla ma brgyud pa gcig cing man ngag rgyun gcig yin pas/ slob dpon gcig gis ma mdzad pa'i yig cha gcig gis mdzad pa yin la/

gdam ngag kyang rtsa bshad kyi rgyud tshig bsgrigs pa las gzhan pa'i gdam ngag dgos pa ma yin no/ /des na gu h+ya pa dang / rnam rgyal zhabs kyis ni yig cha mdzad pa med la/ ti lo pas bde mchog dang mthun pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i glu gsum mdzad/ nā ro pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dang / go cha'i sgrub thabs gnyis mdzad/ 'di yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa rgyas pa/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i glu dang / dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul rnams ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ de nas pham things pa sku mched kyis go cha'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad/ de yan chad kyis bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gdam ngag ston pa'i bla ma zhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams dang / byin gyis rlobs byed kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rim pa bzhin byin gyis ma rlabs pa med pas bla ma gnyis gnyis yin no/ pham things pa'i slob ma su ma ti kirtis rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / ma na ka shrīs lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams ni rgya gar dang bal po'i gsang mtha'i yig cha mdzad pa'i tshul yin zhing / spyir yang rgya gar du 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul rnams bstan zin to/ /da ni bod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su ni bshad pa'i srol ma byung la/ phyi dar gyi dus su ni lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang pos spyir yang mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang po bsgyur zhing gtan la phab la/ khyad par du sku tshe'i stod la skal ldan grags pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa zhus shing bsgyur/ thugs dam yang mdzad do/ /sku tshe'i smad la jo bo rje nyid kyi drung du lha sbas kyi 'grel pa zhus/ la ba pa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa mdzad cing thugs dam gyi gtso bo yang 'di la mdzad nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe yang / spu hrang gi kha char dang / gu ge'i shi rang g.yang gur dang / mang yul gyi nyar ma dang gsum nas sku lus ma spangs pa mkha' spyod la gshegs so/

/kha rtse ge gar nas ni spur bzhu la bzhu bas ring bsrel dmar po sran ma tsam gsum byung ste rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bde ba can du mkha' spyod la gshegs so/ /'on kyang de las brgyud pa'i bka' ni med do/ /yang jo bo rje la rong pa 'gar dges lhas sbas kyi 'grel pa zhus kyang chad nas med do/ /zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i lugs ni/ pham thing pa la zhus zer ba'i brgyud rim 'dug mod/ 'gyur kha cig la bal po hang du dkar po dang / zangs dkar gyis bsgyur zer ba 'dug cing / ngo bo dz+nyā na shrī la zhus par 'dug pas/ pham things pa'i lugs dang gtan mi 'dra ba'i phyir lugs gcig tu bgrangs so/ /yang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dpa' bo rdo rjes byas zer ba dang / kun spyod kyi 'grel pa wi ra badz+ras mdzad ces pa yid 'ong dpa' bo sgrub dkyil dang bcas pa rnams rgya gzhung min/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rje yin pas/ bod rnams kyis nor nas bstan 'gyur du bcug pa yin gsungs/ nā ro pa la kha che byang chub bzang po/ pham things pa sogs kyis zhus/ pham things pa sku mched la mal lo tsā ba dang / spu hrang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab dang / mar do gsum gyis zhus kyang / mal dang spu hrang pa'i bshad srol sa skya pa la yod pas brgyud pa gsum ldan yin no/ /mal gong du shes rab brtsegs brgyud pa yod kyang / pham things pa dang sbyor mkhan yin pas drin che ba'i dbang du mdzad mod/ ma bcug kyang brgyud pa chad pa'i skyon med gsungs/ pu hrang pa la grog ra ba dngos grub shes rab sogs la bshad srol mang du byung / sgrub thabs bcu gsum tsam mthong yang da lta chad nas med/ sa skya pa'i bshad srol ni da lta yang ma chad par yod do/ /mar do la ze ba dang / lho ma yag pa la brgyud pa sogs byung yang / yig cha tsam ma gtogs chad nas med/ kha cig mar do dang ze lugs so sor byas kyang 'thad pa ma yin te/

ze ba mar do'i slob ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig bi pu ta tsaṇ+ḍa/ kha che paṇa chen/ phyag lugs/ a bha ya'i lugs so sor byas kyang / don a bha ya las ma 'das so/ /lcags sna lugs kyang zur du grangs du med de/ jo bo'i brgyud 'dzin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bod du 'gyur ba'i tshul mdo tsam bshad pa'o/ /da ni rang lugs gang gi rjes su 'brangs par brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar mang du yod kyang / bla ma mal lo tsā ba dang / spu hrang lo chung gi lugs gnyis so/ /'di bshad par bya ba la/ spu hrang lo chung gi bzhed pas/ mngal sgong gi mngon rtogs gnyis po 'di gang zag chags pa che chung gi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin no/ /de la rnal 'byor bla med spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa'ang 'khyud pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa la/ 'di gnyis kyang chags pa shin tu ches che zhing / 'khor lo bde mchog la mos pa'i gang zag la dbang bskur gyi dus su dbang gsum pa'i tshe dngos kyi rig ma la brten nas bde ba ngo sprod/ der bde ba ngo ma 'phrod na/ bzhi pa'i dus su yang phyag rgya byin te bde ba ngos bzung ste de nyid dang lta ba bsre/ lam gyi dus su yang de dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya'i lam bsgom pa yin te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms 'jug gi dus na thig ler zhu ba'i dus dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms 'jug gi dus dang / mngal du thig le las rten brten pa bskyed pa'i dus rnams su bde ba lam byed kyi thabs mang ba yin pas 'di bsgom/ brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i dus su yang dngos su phyag rgya la brten nas skyes pa'i bde ba de lam chags lam brten nas rgyun skyong bar byed/ de la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes skye/ de skyes nas mthar chags lam de yang bor nas/ spros pa med pa'i ye shes nyid la mnyam par bzhag te phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'i phyir du gsungs so/

/gnyis pa ni 'dod chags shas chung ba'am/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / rab byung rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos su phyag rgya brten nus kyang / bstan pa la smod pa'i dgag bya yod pas/ thog mar dbang gsum pa'i dus su yang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang bskur/ lam bsgom pa'i dus su yang de dang mthun pa'i yab yum zhal sbyor tsam dang / gsang mchod kyi bde ba tsam ma gtogs dngos su snyoms 'jug gi bde ba gzhan mi ston pa'i sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ de la brten nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i dus su yang chos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas bde ba bskyed par byed cing rgyun bskyangs pas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes skye/ des phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /des na rten gyi gang zag 'dod chags shas che chung gi dbang du byas nas/ dbang gi dus su yang dngos dang dam tshig gnyis bskyed rim la yang mngal skyes dang sgong skyes gnyis/ rdzogs rim la yang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / chos kyi phyag rgya dang / phyag rgya chen po gnyis bstan pa yin zhes bzhed do/ /bla ma mal lo tsā bas de ni ma yin te/ las dang po ba la dngos dbang bskur na bde ba'i rgyu byang chub kyi sems nyams par 'gyur la/ de nyams na dngos grub myur du mi 'grub ste/ rgyal chen in+t+ra bo tis/ byang chub sems ni nyams gyur na/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la thob/ /zhes gsungs pas sems brtan pa che chung gi dbang du byas nas mngon par rtogs pa 'phri skye bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa yin te/ de la gsum/ las dang po pas nag po dkyil chog bzhin bskur nas gsum pa'i dus su/ ye shes kyi rig ma tsam la brten nas dbang thob par byas/ lam gyi dus su yun ring du ting nge 'dzin la 'jog mi nus pas/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa mngal skyes ltar bsgom ste/ rten gzhal yas khang dang brten pa lha so sor bskyed/

lha la rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa so sor byed/ 'khor rnams kyang mngal 'byin byas nas bsgom pas mnyam bzhag yun thung / rjes nas goms par gyur pa dang / rim pa bzhi'i rdzogs rim bsgom pas ye shes bskyed par byed de/ des na/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes la/ /phyag rgya chen por btags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /der rtogs nus na/ lū hi pa'i dbang gi sgo nas smin par byas/ sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ mnyam gzhag yun ring bar bya/ rdzogs rim yang yi ge dang thig le bsdu ba bsgom ste/ phyi rags pa'i dkyil 'khor yud tsam gyis shar yang / nang phra ba rtsa khams lhar shar bar bya ba'i phyir dril bu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ nang lus dkyil rkyang pa bsgom nas lus dkyil lha rnams yud tsam la shar ba dang / rigs lnga'i rdzogs rim nyams su blang nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa ni phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes dngos yin pas/ gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pa la dgongs pa yin zhes gsungs te/ gnyis ka'ang gzhung gi don la gnas mod/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams phyi ma la gtso bor mdzad do/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /yin phyir chu bo kun 'bab nga rgyal med/ /bkod ma'i sdong bu yur ba'i chus gang tshe/ /du ma'i tshogs snyam kheng 'di e ma mtshar/ /spyi'i don gtan la dbab pa'i skabs te le'u dang po'o// ༈ //de ltar spyi'i don nges par byas nas/ da ni so so'i don gtan la dbab pa bar bya ba la/ rgyud 'di brjod par bya ba la gsum du nges ste/ 'di man chad bde mchog gi chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang rgyud kyi don che rags rtogs pa la phan pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa lags/ lam bsgom par byed pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba/ lam nyams su len pa'i tshul/

'bras bu sa bcad 'di'i don shes par 'dod na chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi thams cad smra ba ngan 'joms rin chen bsam 'phel zhes bya bar blta bar bya'o/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can no/ /dang po lū dril gnyis kyi rten gyi gang zag ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes dkyil chog tu rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs par/ dag dang ma dag 'dres pa ste/ /sgrub pa po ni gsum du gnas/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ ma dag pa ni bskyed rim kho na bsgom pa/ dag pa ni rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i phyir sngon du lus dkyil bsgom pa'o/ /'dres pa ni bskyed rdzogs dbyer med du bsgom pa'o/ /de'ang rgyud nyid las gsungs te/ ma dag pa ni mnyes byed ces pa bskyed rim bsgom pas lha mnyes par byed pa'o/ /dag pa ni rnam par dag pa dag pa dang sbyar te/ rdzogs rim pas rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i phyir lus dkyil bsgom pa'o/ /'dres pa ni gsal byed yon tan ldan pa ste/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel bsgom pa ste 'di ni sgrub pa po thams cad kyi mchog yin la/ 'di ni mtha' ma bzung ste gnyis po ni shugs kyi 'byung bar 'gyur ste/ gang gi bsgom pa'i gang zag de'ang thog mar 'khor ba las yid byung nas sems can rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas bskul nas so sor thar pa'i bslab pa gang rung bzung nas dbang bskur ba thob par bya dgos te/ nges brjod las/ 'gro kun don la rab gzhol bas/ /rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mi g.yo ba bla med lo tsā ba rang rgyal gyis bsgyur ba dang / gshed dmar gyi rgyud bu ston gyis bsgyur bar/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs la/

/ming tsam bstan par mi bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la/ /'di'i gsang ba bstan mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i tshe/ bla ma las ni dbang bskur thob/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas thod pa las/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra bar/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ slob mar bcas pa dmyal bar 'tshod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu tan tra sde bco brgyad kyi glegs bam gyi char babs/ gzhan gyis ma shes/ rgyal pos dge slong ku ku ra dza la bstan pas/ des rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'ur shes te/ de la brten nas bsgrub pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong nas tan tra sde bco brgyad gsungs/ zhes rnying ma ba rnams kyis 'chad pa la/ rje btsun rtse mos/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong nas chos gsungs pa ngo mtshar che mod/ dbang bskur ba dang lung nod par med par yi ge tsam la brten nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong ba mi 'thad de/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /lus can dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /de'i ngal ba don med yin/ /lus can nyon mongs kho nar zad/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lū nag gnyis la dkyil chog gcig las med par khas len pa'i phyir/ dbang bskur yang gcig gis chog snyam na/ 'o na yo ga dpal mchog dkyil 'khor bcu gsum la dbang bskur gcig gi chog par 'gyur te/ thun mong du dkyil chog gcig las med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ ming po gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ klu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ zhes sogs bshad pa dang 'gal zhing / rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis la'ang de ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir na rigs pa ma yin no/ /des na gsang ba lam la sbyar ba dang /

gsang ba 'bras bu la sbyar ba gnyis/ lam la sbyar ba la/ lam la 'jug pa dang / lam bsgom pa gnyis gsung pa'i/ lam la 'jug pa nag po dkyil chog ltar dbang bskur ba shin tu gces pas/ sa bcad tsam zhig tshigs su bcad pa'i tshul gyis brjod na/ snod du rung phyir smin byed cho ga la/ /bsnyen pa spyod dang brtul zhugs mjug gi don/ /bsnyen pa dag la yan lag dngos gzhi gnyis/ /dang po lnga ste slob dpon mtshan nyid brtag /gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa dang / /gsum pa sbyor ba bri zhing bzhi pa ni/ /dam tshig 'dzin par spro bar dri ba dang / /lnga pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid brtag pa 'o/ /dngos gzhi dag ni gnyis ste bum pa la/ /rten dang ma rten gnyis te bsnyen pa'i tshad/ /rab 'bring gsum du gnas par shes par bya/ /'khrugs can byed pa'i lugs rnams gzhung du gsal/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i tshul la bdun du gnas/ /de yang sa chog sta gon thig tshon dang / /bskyed cing byin rlabs mchod dang 'jug pa 'o/ /sa'i cho ga dgu ste rtag pa dang / blang dang las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs dang rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kyis bzung mi snang ba las blang / /byin gyis rlabs dang dgu pa bsrung ba 'o/ /brjod pa'i rim pa dag ni gzhung du blta/ /sta gon dag ni bzhi ste sa lha dang / /lha dang slob ma bum pa sta gon no/ /gnyis pa lha la lū nag gnyis po yang / /gnas bcu byin rlabs gong 'og ma nor dgos/ /slob ma sta gon don tshan bcu gsum mam/ /slob dpon 'os la bcu bzhir gnas pa ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sems bskyed slob ma sbyangs/ /gsol gdab spro bskyed dam tshig sbyin pa dang / /bsrung dang lhar bskyed pa la mchod byed cing / /srung skud khyor chu so shing ku sha sbyin/ /chos bshad rmi lam brtag pa slob ma ste/ /slob dpon 'os pa khyad par gsol gdab bo/ /bzhi pa bum pa sta gon lnga pa ste/

/brtse ldan mkhas pa'i slob dpon dang po yin/ /gnyis pa grangs dang gsum pa bcud zhugs pa/ /bzhi pa rgyan dang lnga pa bzlas pa la/ /mngon byang lnga las cig car bskyed pa'am/ /yang na mkha' nang sbyin pa gnyis yin no/ /gsum pa thig ni gnyis sam bdun yang rung / /dang po las thig cha bgo gnyis pa ni/ /ye shes thig gi byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bdun po dag ni gzhung du shes par bya/ /de nas thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa dang / /bzhi pa tshon gyi bri bar bya ba dang / /mtshan ma 'god pa zhar la rgyan bkram pa'o/ /gzhan yang thog mar bzhi ste dang po la'ang / /tshon gyi rgyu tshogs drug rnams gzhung las shes/ /lnga pa bskyed pa la yang rnam gsum ste/ /sbyang dang lha bskyed byin gyis brlab pa drug /drug pa mchod pa sngags dang phyi mchod dang / /rig ma bcu drug rin chen rnam pa bdun/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi mnyes mchod yid byung dang / /bstod dang ras bzung ku sha 'khyud pa dang / /gtor ma la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs yin no/ /bdun pa 'jug pa gnyis te slob dpon dang / /slob ma 'jug la'ang phyi dang nang gnyis so/ /phyi ni bdun te yon dbul bden stobs brjod/ /gdong bcing me tog dor dang 'dod pa dri/ /sems bskyed gsang bar gdams te nang zhugs pa/ /rnam pa dgu yi dbye ba gzhung du gsal/ /nang gi 'jug la bye brag bcu bzhi ste/ /dam tshig bsgrag dang lha bskyed dpa' bo bskul/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro gsol gdab sbyang ba dang / /lhar bskyed phyag rgya bsdam bzung dam la bzhag /gsol gdab ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya/ /mdog dri gdong bcings dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /bzhi pa brtul zhugs dang ni bcu bzhi ste/ /sngags chu cod pan rdor dril ming gi dbang / /brtul zhugs slob dpon rjes gnang gzengs bstod dang / /lung bstan dbugs dbyung gsang ba shes rab bo/ /gsum pa'i ye shes ngo sprod bzhi pa ste/ /bsdu dang mi bsdu'i dbye ba rnam gnyis 'byung /

/dgu pa rjes gnang dag la bzhi yin te/ /lha mchod sems can don bya chos bshad pa/ /'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba 'o/ /dam tshig la ni gnyis te sdom byin dang / /bsrung ba'i dam tshig bka'i gnang ba 'o/ /gnyis pa dag la spyod dang thun mong du/ /rjes gnang srung ba'i dam tshig dngos gnyis so/ /mjug gi don la mchod bstod bzod par gsol/ /dngos grub blang zhing gshegs gsol dam tshig bsdu/ /bskyed rim gsal gdab bdag med ngang la bzhag /rdul tshon spyan drangs tshogs bya dri yis byugs/ /rdo rje'i glu blangs bkra shis smon lam btab/ /srung ba bya zhing dga' ston rjes kyi ste/ /'di yi dang po las can smin byed do/ /de ltar dbang bskur thob ma thag dam tshig gi tshogs bsrung ba la 'bad dgos te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i mjug tu/ dam chos snod du byas nas su/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /bklag dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya/ /zhes dang / 'dir yang / nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phar phyin theg par yang / tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan dang / /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ /zhes bshad pa dang gnad gcig tu shes par byas la/ thog mar rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher bshad pa 'khrul pa spong ba las shes par byas la/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig brgyad kyi rnam gzhag brjod na/ lha mo gzhan dang kun sbyor ba'i/ /'dod la chags pa kun 'gro dang / /mi g.yo bdag gzhan gnyis med min/ /gnyis su med pa thog med pa/ /dam tshig spyod pa spyad pa dang / /bud med dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /khro med rgyun gyi kun spyod pa/ /'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dran par bya'o/ /de la thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig brgyad po gang yin snyam na/

brgyad kyi dang po lha mo gzhan ste/ rang gi rigs lngar rtags shing dbang la sogs pas rgyud sbyangs pa de bor nas/ gzhan rigs bzang ba la sogs pa brtag te/ bram ze la sogs pa rang gis ma brtags shing ma sbyangs pa dang / kun du sbyor ba byed na'o/ /ji skad du/ snying rje chen po dga' ba yis/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi thabs spangs nas/ /'dod lha'i dngos grub bsgrub don du/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten byed pas/ /gang zhig dngos grub 'dod gyur pa/ /dmu long bzhin du de dag rmongs/ /rgyal srid las nyams skyes bu yis/ /nges par sdug bsngal gyis brdung 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni pho nya la brten pa'i dus su tha mal pa 'dod pa la chags pa'i bsam pas brten par 'gyur zhing de la bsgrod par byed na'o/ /gsum pa ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo ba/ bdag gzhan gnyis med par shes pas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rtogs par bya ba'i bsam pas ma brten pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni rigs ngan pa g.yung mo lta bu bor nas rigs bzang ba la bsam pa dga' bar mi byed pa'i bzang ngan la gnyis su med pa dang bzang ngan la thogs pa med pa'i bsam pas ma brten na'o/ /lnga pa ni dam tshig ste dbang bzhi pa yin la/ spyad pa spyod pa ste don gyi dbang bzhi pa rtogs par bya ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas spyad par bya'i/ de dang bral bas brten na'o/ /de skad du yang / spyod pa sna tshogs gsungs pa ste/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni/ /rigs rnams thams cad mnyam par spyad/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /nyan pa la sogs dbang po kun/ /bsre zhing bde bar bsdu bar bya/ /gtso bo gang du spyod pa yis/ /tshangs spyod stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ /brjed med dran pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /thog ma tha ma'i bde 'gro ba/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam dag pa'i/ /de nyid bla na med pa yi/ /dam tshig spyod pa rab tu bsrung / /zhes gsungs pas so/

/drug pa ni bud med dbang phyug ste/ skyes pa mang po'i skyon med pa la sogs yon tan dang ldan pa dang / yon tan dngos grub gzhan dang ldan pa la byang chub kyi sems mi 'chor bar bzung nas rten pa de la mi tshangs par spyad pa med pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin bsam gtan gnas ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bsam gtan la gnas pas brten par bya'o/ /bla ma su ma ti kirtis ni rim pa gnyis la sems gnas pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis brten pas na/ bsam gtan zhes bya zhes kyang gsungs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ khro med rgyun gyi kun spyod ces bdag nyid la gzhan gyis gnod pa sogs byas pas/ rang gi rgyud la khro ba med pa'i kun spyod kun du spyod pa gnas pa yin no/ /de ltar ma byas na dam tshig nyams zhes pa'o/ /gzhung bsdus te bstan pa ni/ 'di brgyad ces pa la sogs te/ de ltar sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig brgyad po 'di 'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba'i dam tshig kun tu spyod pa'i phyir/ rgyud 'di'i lam gyis dngos grub bsgrub pa la gnas pa'i bsgrub pa po de'i rtag tu mi nyams par bsrung bar shes par bya'o/ /smin byed dang dam tshig gi skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag des lam bsgom pa la thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa ston/ de yang thog mar mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa brjod par bya ste/ de'ang rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u so gnyis pa las/ ba glang lhas kyi mi bying dang / /lhag ma skye mched rtsa gnas so/ /brag chen po yi ngo bo ru/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ba glang gi gnas sam/ rten sa yin pas/ des tshon nas ba glang lhas zhes pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ shing leb dang / gci skam lta bu chu'i gting du mi bying bar steng du lding bas mtshon nas mi bying dang / zhes pas chu'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ 'byung ba lngar bshad pa'i lhag ma mes bsher ba la sogs skam par byed pa des mtshon nas/

lhag ma skyems byed zhes pas me'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ rlung gi rtsa gnas 'thor bar byed pa yin pas/ des mtshon nas rtsa gnas so zhes pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor bstan/ brag chen po yi ngo bo ru/ /zhes pas ri rab bstan te/ 'byung ba lugs ldog gi tshul gyis mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa yin te/ mngon brjod las/ mngal skyes glu'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /zhes gsungs pa'i mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs la zhi ba glus bskul yod pas/ sgra saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang / sgra min pra kṛ ta'i skad kyis brtag zhes pas kyang bstan cing / gtso bor zhal mdog phyag mtshan 'khor gyis lha rnams/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sbyar nas grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la brten nas gzhan gyi log rtog 'gog cing / rang gi lugs bsgrub pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ 'di la rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pas/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas nas spros pa la dga' zhing lha'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog mi nus pa la/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rkyang pas ni dus 'da' bar mi yong bas thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i thog mar/ mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa nyams su len dgos pa yin te/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa nas bzung ste gzhal yas khang thog mar bsgom/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed/ snyoms 'jug bya ste zhu nas glus bskul te/ de gnyis kyi mngal nas 'khor rnams 'byin pa'i tshul gyis spro/ de'i cha shas gcig lus la reg pas lus dkyil bsgom pa sogs mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pas nyin mtshan 'da' bar byed pa yin la/ de la sems goms nas mngon par rtogs pa bsdu ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa gcig byung na mnyam pa'i blo nang nas 'char bas/

de'i phyir sgong skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang brten pa lha gnyis cig char du bsgom pa dang / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dod tsam du mngon byang gsum pa hūm̐ dkar po bsgom pa/ zhi ba glus bskul sogs med pas bsdus pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhung gi don la bzhi/ gang gi bsgom pa'i gang zag ni bshad zin la/ gnyis pa gnas ni/ las dang po pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas sam/ brtan pa thob nas dur khrod du bsgom dgos pa yin te/ der brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / bya ba nyung ba dang / ting nge 'dzin ngang gis skye ba'i dgos pa gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rim pa bzhin du 'dre dang srin po sogs kyi gnod pa byung dogs pa dang / mi la sogs pa'i 'grul nyung ba dang / blo dman pas keng rus sogs la dmigs nas mi rtag pa skye ba dang / blo mchog rnams la rnam par rtog pa thams cad bral ba'i lta ba bdag med par skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs sam/ /chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag gam/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dus ni/ las dang po pas mtshan mo'i dus su bsgom ste/ mi rtog pa skye ba'i dus yin pas so/ /de la brten nas thun gsum dang bzhi la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /bzhi pa gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /de'ang gtso bor bsgom pa ni dang po sbyor ba/ 'khor 'byin pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go cha 'god pa nas lha'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par 'jog pa'i bar ni las rgyal mchog go /dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ 'di'ang rgyas par shes par 'dod na chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam bshad de nyid du blta'o/ /sngon 'gro dngos so/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag dag pa'i skabs su/

shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes pa bsdus pa/ ā l̥ kā l̥'i mjug tu hūm̐ phaṭ sbyar ba 'bring / rkang brgyad gnyis bzlas pa rgyas pa'o/ /thugs kyi dag pa la a dkar po/ mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las byung ba rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ bsgom pa ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ las dang po pas chu gtsang ba'i khrus bya/ rnal 'byor pas dri chen dang dri chu sogs kyis khrus byed/ nyan thos pa'i chab dang mthun pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu khar 'jug las dang po pas ro ras la ro'i gzugs bris pa'i gdan/ brtan pa thob nas ro ras sam ro dngos kyi gdan/ rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba lta ba bdag med pa'i dran pa gso byed du bting la/ kha lho phyogs su bstan la 'dug dgos pa yin te/ slob dpon bha wa bha dras rdo rje gdan gzhi'i 'grel par/ shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa'i phyir dang / dga' ba'i yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / lag pa g.yas g.yon thabs shes rab tu 'jog pa'i tshe g.yon shes rab dang / g.yas thabs su 'jog pa ltar/ byang shar thabs dang / lho dang nub la shes rab tu 'jog pa yin pa bzhin du 'dir yang shes rab kyi rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ lho phyogs su blta ba yin no/ /'o na nub phyogs su'ang blta bar rigs so zhes na/ rigs te yo ga rdo rje rtse mo thabs yin la/ dpal mchog shes rab kyi rgyud yin pas/ dpal mchog gi zhal nub tu gzigs par bshad pa bzhin no/ /'o na lho phyogs 'ba' zhig la blta ba ci yin snyam na/ 'jigs byed pa rnams sems can gyi tshe srog dang dbugs sogs 'phrog par byed pa'i gshin rje lho phyogs sa 'og rim pa bdun na yod pas de'i gnyen por bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal gzigs shing / de'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa yang kha lhor blta zhes pa ltar/

'dir yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'dul bya'i gtso bor drag po dbang phyug lho 'dzam bu'i gling na yod pas de'i gnyen por rtsa zhal lho phyogs su gzigs pa yin zhing / de'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa pos yang kha lhor blta ba yin no/ /slob dpon la ba pa'i bzhed pas/ gling gzhan rnams ni longs spyod pa'i sa yin la/ gling gsum pa'i mi rnams ni/ longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyed cing / /rtog med rnam dpyod med pa 'o/ /'dzam bu gling du legs skyes pa/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /zhes sdom 'byung las gsungs pa yin no/ /'dzam bu gling pa rnams las kyi sa pa yin pas/ dge sdig blang dor la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir/ gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pas zhal lhor gzigs pa yin te zhes gsungs so/ /dga' ba'i yul yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'ang dga' ba bzhi phyogs la 'jog pa'i tshe/ lhor dga' ba nas g.yon bskor gyi 'jig rten pa'i nub tu lhan skyes 'byung la/ dga' ba dang po ma skyes par gzhan gyi phyi ma mi skye bas lho phyogs dga' ba'i phyogs la zhal gzigs pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi chos dpal bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ pad+ma pad+ma'i gnyen gyis bskyangs nas rgyas byed ltar/ /skye ba skye bar dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung rnams/ /dus 'dir dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i yongs 'dzin gyis/ /bu gcig pu la ma yis skyong ltar chos nyid legs/ /rgyu skar rgyu skar bdag pos zil gnon bzhin/ /rab byung rab byung mchog gis zil gnon te/ /yongs 'dzin yongs 'dzin mchog gis zil gnon ltar/ /smra dbang smra ba mchog gi zil gnon gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don drug pa chos kyi rje srad pa kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/
