rnam dag bstan pa'i nyin byed shar phyogs sa 'dzin rtser/ /rnam gsal 'od kyi dra bas phyogs kun kheb pa na/ /rnam mang rgyu skar phreng ba kun kyang khor yug rtser/ /rnam par 'khod cing de yi rjes su 'jug pa ltar/ /legs gsung 'khrul med dam chos seng ge'i sgra/ /sgra cher bsgrags pas gzhan gzhung dregs byed rnams/ /rnam pa kun tu klad pa 'gems mdzad gang / /gang zhig smra ba'i dbang phyug gang de rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa chos rje srad pa kun dga' blo gros kyis thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po'i drung du nag po rim bzhi'i khrid dang rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ bde mchog dkar po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i khrid rnams dang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan pa'i dus su zin bris su mdzad pa'i gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de yang nag po rim bzhi'i zin bris las/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / gnas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud pa'i gzhal yas khang bsgom pa/ slob dpon ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar mos pa dang / khyed rang rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la thugs mnyam par bzhag nas chos gsan pa sogs rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung nyan pa'i kun spyod khyad par du 'phags pa rnams gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyud sde sgo drug pa ma'i yang ma gsang ba bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po nas 'byung ba'i gdam ngag dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bye ba phrag brgyad cu gshegs pa'i shul lam/

slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū nag dril gsum gyis bkral ba'i nyams len/ grub thob dbang po dpal nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba bla ma pham thing pa sku mched las/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la brgyud pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdam ngag khyad par du 'phags pa gcig ston cing nyams su len par byed/ de la rgyud 'di nyid las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pas theg pa chen po la sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa'i mdo dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / gsang zhes pas rnal 'byor pha bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / mtha' zhes pas ma bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / de las kyang zab pa logs su phye ba ma'i yang ma rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud yin la/ rgyud 'di rgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan yang spyir mang du yod mod/ gtso bor gyur pa gsum ste/ 'dzam bu gling gi yul nyer bzhi na zhing skyes kyi sprul sku dngos su bzhugs pa dang / bskyed rim la pho nya bsre ba'i thabs khyad par can dang / rdzogs rim dpyid kyi thig le dmigs pa nyung la rno zhing myur ba'i lam yod pas gzhan las zab pa yin no/ /de la dang po brgyud pa 'di pa'i lugs kyi sprul pa'i sku ji srid 'dzam bu gling gnas kyi bar du yul chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pas/ de dag gi bsgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyi rlobs pa yin pas myur ba yin te/ dper na nyan thos pa rnams la sprul sku shākya thub pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i dus su byin rlabs myur bas mang pos dgra bcom pa thob pa bzhin no/ /'o na rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs kyis kyang sprul sku dngos su bzhugs par mi bzhed dam snyam na/ dngos su bzhugs pa don la gnas kyang bzhugs par shes shing ngo sprod pa'i gdam ngag med pa dang / de dag dang rang gcig tu bsre ba'i thabs khyad par can yod pa ma yin la/

'dir sprul sku dngos su bzhugs shing de dag gis 'dzam bu gling pa'i sems can rnams rang bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs par yang bstan cing / de rnams dang rang dbyer med par bsre ba'i gdam ngag bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim la pho nya bsre ba'i thabs khyad par can bstan pa ni/ rgyud las/ de bzhin pho nya legs 'dres nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes dang / pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma ste/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi bsgom pa/ sngags skyes kyis zhing skyes bskul/ zhing skyes sprul skus/ longs sku lhan skyes kyis bskul bas chos kyi sku'i rtogs pa skye zhing / de ltar byas na byin gyis rlobs bya ba longs sku lhan skyes kyi zhing skyes des sngags skyes thams cad byin gyis rlobs/ pho nya zhes pa'i don yang 'jig rten na rgyal po'i pho nya ba zhes bya ba don myur du bsgrub par byed pa yin la/ 'dir yang dngos grub bsgrub pa gzhan las myur ba yin no/ /de ltar bsres pas ji ltar 'gre snyam na/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byed pa'i cho ga byas pas 'jug par 'gyur ba bzhin du/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i pho nya bsre ba'i cho ga byas pas byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang ma rgyud pa gzhan dang / bde mchog pa'i slob dpon gzhan rnams kyang gzhung de dang de nas bshad pa'i 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas rtogs pa skye ba de nyid dang / 'di nas bshad pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pas skye ba'i nyams myong la khyad par med kyang / rtogs byed kyi thabs gzhan nas bshad pa rnams ni dmigs pa'i rim pa rgya che bas bsgrub par dka' la/ 'di ni dpyid dang thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba thabs nyung zhing zab pa nyams su blangs bde ba cig ston pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang zab bo/ /'di pa'i bshad pa rnams su 'khor lo bde mchog zab ste/

slob dpon shan+ti pas kyang 'grel pa brtsam par ma nus so/ /zhes bshad pa'ang 'chad lugs legs po byas nas khyad par du 'phags chos su 'gro na yang / de'i bshad pa gzhung gi steng du 'chad cing / 'dir de tsam zhig gis chog pa lags/ de lta bu'i lam khyad par can ston pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud 'chad pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud rnams la brten nas grub chen rnams kyis 'chad pa la/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams kyis bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar bzhed de/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /zhes gsungs/ de'ang 'byung dang zhes pas/ he ru ka mngon 'byung zhes bya ba dang / mkha' 'gro zhes pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / kun spyod zhes pas rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang / kha sbyor zhes pas sam+bu ṭi dang / bla ma zhes pas mngon brjod bla ma dang lnga'o/ /de dag gis rtsa rgyud 'grel pa'i tshul yang / de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lam gyi gsang ba dang / 'bras bu'i gsang ba gnyis las/ lam gyi gsang ba la 'jug pa dang / lam gyi gsang ba dngos so/ /lam gyi gsang ba rim gnyis yin la/ de la 'jug pa smin byed kyi dbang ste/ rtsa rgyud dang kha 'thor ba'i tshul gyis gsungs pa/ de nyid gsal bar ston pa khrag 'thung mngon 'byung yin te/ gsang mtha'i bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / nges brjod bla ma las kyang dbang chog gsungs mod/ 'dir khrag 'thung mngon 'byung nas bshad pa'i dbang chog kho nas kha bskong zhing gsal bar byed/ lam gyi gsang ba dngos la gnyis las/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa la sbyar na/ rtsa rgyud las/ ba glang lhas kyi steng lding dang / /lhag ma skem byed rtsa gnas so/ /brag chen po yi ngo bo ru/ /yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pa'i don/ ba glang lhas ni sa'i dkyil 'khor/ steng lding chu/ skem byed me/

rtsa gnas rlung / brag chen po ri rab ste 'byung bzhi lugs ldog ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa/ mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs bstan/ yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pas rus sbal nang gi sems can dang phyi'i lkog grub pa dus mnyam pa ltar/ rten dang brten pa dus mnyam pa bskyed pa sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs bstan/ de lta bu'i mngon rtogs gnyis po de yang rgya gar ba'i gsang mtha' ba thams cad kyi thugs nyams su bzhes mod/ sgrub thabs mdzad pa po so so las ming btags te/ mngal skyes ltar bskyed pa la nag po pa'i mngon rtogs dang / sgong skyes ltar bskyed pa la lū hi par ding sang grags so/ /bshad rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud du lha rnams kyi ming dang / gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga thod pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig las gsal bar ma bshad kyang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ lha thams cad kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sku mdog gi nges pa rnams dang / sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs kyi tshul gsal bar ston to/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bshad pa'i zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ slob dpon a bh+ya yas bde mchog rdor dbyings zhes pa'i brda chad mdzad nas/ de'i dbang bka' phreng ba na yod/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor lha so bdun ma de la/ dang por rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed/ zhi glus bskul/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs/ des 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba sogs mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs gsal bar bstan/ mngal sgong gnyis kyi brda chad kyang / nges brjod bla ma las/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min yongs su brtag /sgong skyes glu ni med pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa 'o/ /zhes mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs la zhu ba glus bskul gyi sbyor ba/ sgra saṃ skṛ ta'i skad/ sgra min pra kṛ ta'i skad yongs su brtag la/

sgong skyes la ni de lta bu'i glus bskul med pa'o/ /saṃ skṛ'i skad du glus bskul ba mang zhing / pra kṛ ta'i skad du glus bskul ba yod de/ kyai rdo rje dang / mahā ma ya'i glus bskul rnams ni pra kṛ ta'i skad do/ /gsang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa la bzhag pa la yang rdzogs rim gyi phyag rgya'i lam ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis spyod yul du gyur pa shas che zhing / de'i tshul yang rtsa rgyud las gsal bar bshad pas/ bshad rgyud la ltos mi dgos shing / de'i sngon du sgrub pa po rnams kyis rlung dang gtum mo mthar phyin par byed dgos pas de dag gi rim pa rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la med cing / sbas don las 'byung ba ste/ de yang rtsa rgyud las/ drag po'i sbyin sreg dang / bzlas pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / gtor ma sogs bshad pa/ bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi'i nges don du bstan pas/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i dmigs pa dpyis phyin par bshad pa sogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim gsal bar ston pas de'i phyir bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /gsang ba 'bras bu la bzhag pa la gnyis las/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu las kyi tshogs rnams rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs shing / 'on kyang las chen bcu gnyis mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa dang / ma tshang ba kha skong ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas 'byung bas bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /rgyud 'di dag las las tshogs mang du bshad pa rnams kyang / dman pa la mos pa'i gdul bya mchog gi dngos grub la kha drang bar bya ba'i phyir bstan pa ste/ ji ltar zhes na/ bsnyen pa sngon du song pa'i sngags pas las kyi tshogs ji ltar brtsams pa bzhin grub pa dang / nges shes skyes te/ da ni 'di nas bstan pa'i mchog gi dngos grub kyang 'grub pa kho na'o snyam nas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi sangs rgyas te/

de'i rnam par bshad pa rtsa bshad thams cad du ci rigs par bstan to/ /nges brjod bla mas gtso cher bskyed rim gsal bar byed cing / lam gyi yan lag rnams kyang rgyas par bstan/ kun spyod kyis kyang lam gyi yan lag rnams shin tu gsal bar bstan te/ phyi mchod/ lag mchod/ gtor ma la sogs gnas skabs mang du phan 'dogs so/ /de ltar rtsa bshad phyogs gcig tu sdom pa'i man ngag rnams nyams su len pa'i rim pa ni/ thog mar blo chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams gsang sngags kyi lam la 'jug pa'i sgo dbang bskur ba dgos shing / de'i gzhung yang slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa nas mngal sgong gnyis ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ston/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag gis thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom dgos la/ de yang mngal sgong gnyis las bsgrub pa po chags can gyis gtso bor mngal skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ de'i sgrub thabs slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje nyid kyis mdzad la/ chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba'i gang zag gis gtso bor sgong skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ de'i sgrub thabs lū hi pas mdzad do/ /'grel byed rnams kyis lū hi pa'i gzhung ci rigs su bshad pa yod kyang / man ngag can gyi bshad pa sa lugs pa'i 'di shin tu legs pa yin no/ /de dag gi yan lag tu slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes sbyin sreg gi gzhung mdzad pa yin no/ /mchog don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa gtso bo yin zhing / de'i tshul la spyir gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa de kho na nyid yin la/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa rnams kyi rtogs bya de nyid yin pas de rtogs byed kyi thabs ni rdzogs rim 'ba' zhig yin no/ /zhes rdzogs rim kyi che ba ston pa'i gzhung gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba/

mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dbang bskur e wam̐ ma ya nas 'byung zhing / de'i nyams len gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi yin/ de'i nyams len gsal bar ston pa o la pa ti zhes pa mkha' 'gro'i brda'i skad yin la/ bod skad rim pa bzhi pa/ rtogs bya'i lta ba de rtogs byed kyi dmigs pa nyung ngu zhig gis rang rgyud la bskyed pa'i tshul ston pa/ 'phags pa dpyid kyi thig le/ de yang lte ba nas me 'bar ba/ phag mo thig le ru ni brjod/ /zhes pa thig le snying kha nas byang sems 'bab pa snying dga' bar byed pas dpyid de/ de gnyis kyi 'bar 'dzag la dpyid dang thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum mdzad de/ de rnams la nag po gzhung drug ces grags so/ /gzhung sngar bstan pa de dag gis bshad pa dang nyams len gyi rim pa la dpal nā ro pa nas brgyud de bod du byung pa la/ spu hrang lo chung nas brgyud pa tshig sbyor rgyas pa dang / mal lo nas brgyud pa bsdus pa ma gtogs don la khyad par med do/ /ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gi khrid yig tu/ sngar gyi rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum po de'i steng du/ sdom pa bshad pa rnal 'byor gyi sdom pa snying po bsdu ba don gyi sdom/ phyag rgya chen po thig le phyag bsten pa'i sdom zhes pa gzhung drug po slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad ces 'byung ba gsung bgros cung zad 'chugs pa yin nam/ phyi ma gsum ni slob dpon gyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ sdom pa bshad pa las/ spyod pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ /lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de'i slob ma zhig gis mdzad pa 'dra'o/ /'on kyang spyod pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung la phan pa'i gzhung bzang po cig yin no/ /snying po bsdu ba'i dpe mang por/ rat+na shrī a ka shas mdzad bya ba 'byung la/ de paṇa chen ga ya dha ra'i mtshan yin pas/

slob dpon des mdzad pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi rgya gzhung khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes gzhung la shin tu phan pa yin no/ /phyi ma 'di'i gzhung bod na mi bzhugs/ dang po nas med pa yin nam phyis dpe bor ba gang yin yang da lta med mod/ yod na'ang phyag rgya bsten tshul rgyas pa cig yod las che ste/ de'i tshul rtsa rgyud nyid las gsal bar bshad pas/ de tsam gal yang mi che'am/ des na 'dir mal gyo nas brgyud pa nag po pa'i gzhung drug nyid yin no/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams kyi bzhed pas/ de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lam dang 'bras bu'i gsang ba gnyis/ 'di man chad bde mchog chos 'byung rang du mi snang yang rim gnyis nyams su len tshul la phan pa zhig 'dug pas bris pa'o/ /dang po la lam gyi gsang ba la 'jug pa dang / lam gyi gsang ba dngos so/ /'di la gnyis las/ gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa la bzhag pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa mngal sgong gnyis kyi nyams len pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta phyi ma rnams kyis bshad pa re zhig bzhag nas/ pham things pa sku mched nas brgyud pa'i lugs bzhin nyams su len te/ de yang gsung bgros las/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas dpal nā ro ta pa'i zhabs drung du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs kyang tshogs pa la bshad pa ma gtogs/ slob ma la bshad pa ma gsan/ pham things pa 'di pa la zab don thams cad gnang ba yin no gsungs/ de yang bskyed rim nyams su len pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad btang nas sangs rgyas kho na don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas/ stan bde ba la lus gnad dang ldan pas mngal sgong gang rung gi mngon par rtogs pa tshul bzhin du bsgom/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog

thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas srung 'khor la thim/ de dur khrod la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ de sku 'khor/ de gsung 'khor/ de thugs 'khor/ de bde chen gyi 'khor lo la/ de gtso bo'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ sngon po/ khams dpa' bo mi shigs pa'i rang bzhin nges don gyi he ru ka yin no snyam pa de ltar bsdu ba'i lugs byed dam/ yang na phyed mar bsdu ste/ gzhal yas khang dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bsdu ba'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yab thams cad sna bug g.yas nas snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ yum thams cad sna bug g.yon nas lte ba'i am̐ la thim/ de ltar byed pa'i zhib cha ni spu hrang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab kyi gsung 'gros las/ de ltar byas pas rdzogs rim 'grub pa nye ba'i rten 'brel yod de/ rdzogs rim dpyid kyi thig le myur du 'grub pa'i dngos rgyu da lta nyid nas bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dpyid kyi dus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer rgya mtsho'i gting du phog pas mtsho dros/ des sa gzhi dros pa'i mthus rtsi shing dang lo tog 'phel bar 'gyur ba bzhin du lte ba'i am̐ me'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer snying kha'i hūm̐ la phog pas/ bde chen gyi ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur bas dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bskyed rim de yang rnam rtog gzhan dang ma 'dres par khril khril bsgom pas/ tha mal rnam rtog gi rgyun 'joms par byed de/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun 'di ma rtogs pa/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gzhan dag yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i sems/ /gang yin de ni kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang rnam pa 'gal te/ tha mal pa'i lus su 'dzin pa de/ lha zhal phyag mang po'i rnam par bsgyur/ der ma zad sems kyi 'dzin stangs kyang 'gal te/ rang tha mal pa 'di zhes bya ba 'dzin pa bor nas lha'i nga rgyal byed pas so/

mi gsal na ras bris dang lugs ma la sogs la blta ba la brten nas kyang dmigs pa gsal btab/ phyis kyi dus 'khor ba rnams na re/ de lta bu rtog bsgom yin zhes ras bris sogs la blta ba spang byar byed na'ang / 'dir ni de ltar ma yin te/ sdom 'byung du/ lha'i rnam pa blo la ma shar na ji ltar byed ces bris pas/ ras bris dang lugs sku la sogs pa las 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku bzo ba'i thig tshon sogs gsal bar gsungs pa'ang 'di lta bu la dgongs pa yin no/ /de ltar bskyed rim gyi tshul rgyas pa gcig bshad dgos te/ sngar gtso cher blo yul du byas pa'i gang zag shas che bas des khyab pa lags/ da ni shin tu zab pa'i gsang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa la 'jug de yang rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi rdzogs rim dang / sbas don gyi rdzogs rim gnyis su bsdu/ de yang rtsa rgyud las/ thig le'i gzugs kyis yid kyi dngos/ /zhes pas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rim pa bstan/ des mtshon te slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga/ bshad pa'i rgyud rnams kyi dngos bstan la/ bod kyi khrid yig bzhin du gsal bar bkod yod mod/ de'i tshul man ngag de nyid kyi steng du 'chad/ yang rtsa rgyud du/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang / /bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don la/ phyag na rdo rje'i 'grel par/ sngags bzlas pa ni yig 'bru gsum ste/ des srog rtsol bstan/ de mthar phyin pa'i lag rjes 'dzin pa des mtshon/ bsam gtan zhes pas yan lag lngas khyad par du byas pa'i bsam gtan/ de'i sngon du sor bsdud nges par 'gro dgos pas de'ang mtshon nas bstan/ bde ba zhes pa rjes dran gyi ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya la brten nas bde chen gyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed pa dang / de mthar phyin pa'i yan lag rjes ting nge 'dzin bstan/ de ltar rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi nyams len bstan pa yang dngos bstan gyi man ngag yin no/

/rdzogs pa'i rim pa de yang mdor bsdu na/ rang lus thabs ldan dang / gzhan lus shes rab ma'i nyams len gnyis su 'du/ phyi ma ni rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la shin tu gsal bar bstan/ rang lus thabs ldan ni rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor te/ de yang rtsa rgyud du sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin/ gang sbas na rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ tshul ji ltar sbas na sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ bzlas pa/ sngags bsdu ba rnams su sbas/ sngags bsdu lta bu gcig la sbyar na dngos su sngags bsdu ba'i phyir/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sde tshan brgyad a li dgod pa bstan/ nges don du bshad pas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten pa'i rtsa dang / de la yi ge bkod pa la bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang por nyams su blang dgos la/ de yang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom na/ lha bsdu lugs gnyis po gang rung byas pa'i rjes la bsgom pa yin la/ 'dir re zhig mdor bsdus te ye shes skye ba'i rten dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom/ 'dir phyis kyi mkhas pa dag rdzogs rim gyi rten gyi lha dang / thun mtshams kyi lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin pa'i lung rat+na rak+ṣi ta sogs kyis lung drangs nas bsgrub kyang / grub chen dril bu pas/ lha 'di dag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gsungs pas paṇ+ḍi ta mnyam po cig yin na dang lung phar tshur snyoms pas chog na'ang / sku tshe 'di nyid la dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyes pa'i grub chen de lta bu la su yi snyon/ des na rang lugs la zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par bsgom/ de'i tshul yang slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ sems can brdzus te skye ba bzhin/ /skad cig gis ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i lung gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ sbyang gzhi sems can brdzus skyes kyi gnyen por skad cig gis bsgom/

de yang gnas dben par stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis bsdad la/ lus gnad gzhan yang rgal tshigs drang po/ mig sna rtser dbab/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mchu dang so mnyam par byas la/ skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing zhal rnam par 'gyur ba can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa brgyang ste 'dzin pa/ gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgrengs pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ lū hi pa'i gzhung las byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa ltar bshad/ nag po par yab g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan gyi nu ma'i steng dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo stabs nas mnan pas bzhugs pa yin pa 'dra na'ang / yum g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba gsal btab/ yab kyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas rang la thim/ yang 'od 'phros yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul sku dngos su bzhugs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi'i sngags skyes rnams la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam ste/ yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/

/yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes pa'i don yin/ de nas rang gi rdo rje'i lus phra rags thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin yin snyam du mos par byas nas/ shes bya rgyud kyi rim pa thos bsam gyis gtan la phabs/ sngags rim bsgom pa'i sngon du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa lag mthil gyi ri mo ltar gsal btab gsungs/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs bzhin gnang ste zhag nyer gcig tsam mdzad/ 'di'i sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la zhag gsum/ he ru ka'i yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas la zhag gsum/ bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnal 'byor la zhag gsum/ de nas dngos gzhi gong gi spyi bshad la chos thun gsum mdzad de zhag gsum/ dngos gzhi rim pa bzhi rang la/ rgyud rim thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa la chos thun gsum la zhag gsum/ sngags rim gyi sngon du rgyud rim gsal btab pa la zhag gcig sngags bsgrub pa la zhag gsum/ sngags rim dang po la chos thun gsum pa la zhag gsum gsum ste dgu/ ye shes kyi rim pa la chos thun gcig la zhag gsum/ gsang ba'i rim pa la chos thun gcig la zhag gnyis mdzad/ rjes su ngo sprod pa la sa chen gyi rim bzhi lam bslong / spyod pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung drug sa chen gyis nag 'bum dang bcas pa la dka' gnas kyi bshad pa mtha' chod par gnang / sdom pa bshad pa'i lung / dpyid kyi thig le'i nyams len/ 'khor lo la brten pa/ ma brten pa/ brten pa la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag nyams len rgyun pa la 'phags pa rin po che'i mngon rtogs kyi nang nas gnang zhing / rim bzhi dngos gzhi'i dus su ṭīk+ka mu tig phreng ba dang / gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi khrid yig nang sel gyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad rnams kyang zhib par gsungs shing / sa lugs kyi nag 'bum dang / lo chung lugs gyi gzhung drug gi ṭīk+ka brgyud pa gcig yin pa dang man ngag gi rkang 'dra bas/

'dir nag 'bum dang mchan du mi gsal ba/ spu hrang lugs las kyang kha bskangs te gsal bar mdzad kyi snang ngo / /'di lta bu'i rdzogs rim gyi lam po che ni gsung ngag lam 'bras dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga/ sbyor drug rnams las gzhan la med ces kyang gsungs so/ /zhes pa rje btsun chos kyi rje kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas nag po rim bzhi gsungs pa'i zin bris cung zad kun dga' blo gros kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bkod pa'o/ /dngos gzhi mkha' 'gro gnyan pas 'bri ma nus/ khrid yig dang ṭīk+ka'i spyi don las zhib tu rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung zhing / yang srad pa kun blo'i mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor zin bris las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ srad pa kun blo'i mkha' spyod ma'i zin bris dang / bde mchog dkar po'i zin bris 'di gnyis bde mchog chos 'byung nang du mi snang yang rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyis bde mchog chos skor sogs dar rgyas su mdzad pa la rang nyid kyang dad pa ches skyes shing / rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de bzhin rtogs nas chos la don gnyer byed pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dag pas bris pa lags/ rje de nyid kyi drung du mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor zhus pa la/ rje nā ro pa'i sgrub thabs sogs gnang dus/ sngon du spyi bshad mdzad rjes/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas bde mchog gi khrid chung 'di rnams la/ sngon 'gro sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyong ba he ru ka'i yig brgya/ mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs pa yin pas gsungs/ skyabs 'gro'i bshad pa dang nyams len yig brgya lam 'bras pa bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul yul dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dus kyi bla ma rnams rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa rnams sku mdog dmar por bsgom pa bde mchog pa'i khyad chos yin/

'di gsung rnam par dag pa yin pas chos kyi phan 'dogs yong ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs/ de nas bskyed rim la rgya gzhung dang / sa chen gyis rnal 'byor bcu gcig la bshad pa zhib par mdzad/ stod lugs ra stag jo mo'i drung du na bza' phul bas lo de'i nang du dngos grub 'grub pa dang / rje nyid la de'i nyin rang dngos grub 'byung ba'i lo rgyus gsungs/ tshes bcu sogs cha lag rnams kyang zhib par gnang / rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig rje btsun chen po'i yig cha bzhin gnang / 'di'i gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas lugs mtshan nyid shes pas chog dmigs par mi byed par rim pa bzhi pa'i shes bya rgyud kyi rim pa la thos bsam rkyang pa byed rgyu gcig dang / sngags rim sngon du bsgom rgyu gcig dang gnyis yod pa'i snga ma dang 'dra gsungs/ gzhan rnams khrid yig ltar zla gcig tsam mdzad nas gnang ste dmigs pa re la zhag grangs 'di mdzad yi ger de 'phral la ma bris pas brjed/ rtsal 'don pa rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba la ston gyin gda'/ lam gyi yan lag pra dbab pa smin chen no/ /gnod sbyin mo dbang du bsdu ba rnams kyang zhib tu gnang ngo / /rtsa dbu ma gsung dus kyi bsgrigs rim ྀatshaḥ zhes 'byung la/ yang chos rje kun blo'i bde mchog dkar po'i zin bris las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog dkar po la brten nas bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i man ngag zhus pa'i dus sngon 'gro rtsa dbu dang 'dra/ bskyed rim dpa' gcig zhag gsum bsgom du bcug 'di bde mchog lū hi pa'i man ngag yin/ de'i nang nas kyang slob dpon a bha yas lū hi pa dang 'brel chen po yod gsungs/ dmigs rim dngos gzhi dpyal pa a mo ghas mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang / zur 'debs brgyud pa gsum pa bya ba paṇa chen gyi dngos slob cig gis mdzad pa ltar zhag bco lnga tsam mdzad de gnang /

zhib cha rang brjed de dus byin rlabs kyi cho ga mi mdzad pas rje mus pa la zhus pa yin no/ /shing mo phag lo'i ston bde mchog dril bu pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnang dus/ spyir rgyud sde'i byung tshul la chos thun gcig bye brag 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud sde'i dbye ba la gcig bde mchog zab pa'i rgyu mtshan la gcig mngal skyes sgong skyes brdzus skyes sbyong tshul lū nag dril gsum gyi spyi bshad la gcig sbas don dang dngos bstan gyi rdzogs rim spyi'i bshad pa la gcig skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la gcig bsang sbyangs gnyis la gcig rten gsal btab pa yan la gcig dge ldan pa'i kha mchu la gcig brten pa sku gsum lam 'byed kyi sgrub thabs la gcig bskyed rim lhag ma la gcig rgya gzhung gi 'bru gnon la gcig rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs la thun gcig de nas khrid pa mang grags pa des drung du mkha' 'gro'i khu ldog gcig byung tshod du 'dug pas/ rdzogs rim rgyas par ma gnang par 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i khrid yig de'i lugs gcig las ma mdzad do/ /de'i dus su/ rnal 'byor ches mchog he ru ka /yul phyogs gang du gnas gyur pa/ /rigs ngan kla klo yin na yang / /yul de yongs su brtags pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma ste/ /de bzhin pho nya legs 'dres nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes sogs kyi rgyud tshig gsungs pa'i tshe nges shes skye ba dang / chos grwa gzhan las mnga' bro ba dang / rje la rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus stsol med du byung / khyim du sleb nas kyang blo bde ba mnga' bro nges pa byung / nub gcig drung du mngon rtogs kyi mdzub khrid zhur phyin pas/

gang bzung gsungs rje pa'i de bzung zhus pas/ sku mnyel mdzad pa las bzhengs te dges tshor dang bcas pa zhib tu gnang / nang mchod 'bul dus mngon rtogs su/ blo gros grags pa rje btsun mchod/ /ces pa'i 'phro la/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ rje btsun dpal ldan tshul khrims/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rang gi bla ma rnams mchod gsungs/ bde mchog 'di rje'i drung gi thugs dam mthil rang du 'dug snang ste/ bdag gis snga mo'i dus bdag gis sngags rgya chen slob pa mi yong / kyai rdor bka' babs 'di pa tshang ma gcig zhu zhus pas/ khyod snying nas rang gi sa skya pa'i chos gcig nyams su len na/ bde mchog cig dgongs gsungs pa dang / chos gsungs dus kyang byin rlabs gzhan las 'khul che zhing / chos nyan kyang blo rtse gcig tu hril gyis 'gro rgyu gcig bdag la ni byung / gzhan yang sku bsnyel ba dang / gshegs pa'i nyin dang rjes su yang chos kyi rje 'khor lo bde mchog la thugs rtsis shin tu che ba'i zhal ta dang / ltas bzang po mang po zhig byung ba yin no/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun 'dus pa/ /rje btsun dam pa kun dga' bzang po des/ /phul byung rgyud sde yangs rtse'i gdam pa rnams/ /ma sbas legs par gdam pa ngo mtshar che/ /sngon chad de 'dra'i skyes chen gshegs pa la/ /don med mya ngan gdung ba gyis lags mod/ /da ni 'di lta'i lam bzang nyams blang na/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro dngos su bzhugs pa snyam/ /sems la dga' bde'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang / /rgyud kyi don la go rtogs bzang po skyes/ /skyes mchog skyes pa 'dod ldan bdag nyid ni/ phun tshogs tshogs gnyis mang du bsags par rtogs/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi khrid yig rnams la zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba'i gzur gsos/

rnal 'byor pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bkod/ rtsa rgyud kun spyod dang bcas pa'i ṭīka chen mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas dang / bla ma rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i chos skor rnams kyi lung bshad pa dang bcas pa yang rje nyid la dngos su thos so/ /dga' ba la/ skyid pa la/ bde ba la/ de yang bla ma'i bka' drin no/ /khrid 'di rnams la chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas sngon 'gro thun par sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa gsum khrid kyi sngon 'gro/ thun la bsgom pa rnam gsum byed/ sems bskyed kyi tshig slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru kar rang bya/ /zhes gsum mngon brjod ltar mdzad do/ /de rnams kyis chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ dad pa ches lhag lhag bsam bsam gtan la brtson zhing / /legs byas chos spyod spyod tshul tshul ni bla na med/ /lung zin chos rje rje btsun mchog gi rjes bzung ba/ /skyes mchog grub dbang dbang po'i mchog der gus pas 'dud/ /khang bzang khang brtsegs ngo mtshar bsgrigs pa ltar/ /bkod legs legs par bkod pa'i legs bshad 'di/ /yongs 'dzin 'dzin ma yongs skyobs yongs grags gsung / /tshe rab rab mang tshogs gnyis bsags rnams longs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bdun pa mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa ni/ mkha' 'gro dbang phyug 'khor lo sdom dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug sems dpa' che/ /gnyis med byin rlabs mtshan ma gzigs pa'i byin rlabs gter mnga' mkhas pa'i phul/

/snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun khyab cing grags pa don ldan sangs rgyas dpal/ /bzang po'i mtshan can gus pas bstod do mtshan mchog ldan pas byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis rje btsun sems dpa' chen po mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam bshad ngo mtshar can las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba las ches gsang ba'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rje btsun bla ma'i gsung bzhin zin bris byas pa la/ chos khung btsun zhing yid ches par bya ba'i phyir chos 'byung / lo rgyus bsnyad pa dang / sa spyad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis sems dpa' chen po'i gsung bzhin bris pa'i bde mchog thams cad du blta bar gyis shig kho bo'i byas pa'i bstan bcos 'dir ni rnam thar de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul nyid bsdus pa'o/ /shin tu gsang ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul gyi man ngag zab pa las kyang ches zab pa dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul/ byon nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud zab mo gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud la 'phags yul du 'grel byed ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ rgyud 'grel rnams kyis lam gyi srol ji ltar phye ba'i tshul/ lam srol rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i srol bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gdul bya dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul/ 'dul byed he ru ka'i rnam 'phrul/ des de ji ltar btul ba'i tshul ni/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i byon tshul nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa byon nas rgyud gsungs pa'i tshul la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa le'u 'bum phrag gcig

'bring po sh+lau ka 'bum phrag gcig bsdus pa tshig 'bum phrag gcig ste gsum gsungs pa las/ dang po gnyis dus 'khor ba sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes nas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi spyod yul du ma gyur pas sgra nam mkha' la dengs zhes sam/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis spyan drangs zhes grags so/ /'on kyang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du phye ba brjod byed dbang du byas kyi/ brjod bya la khyad par med do zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul la/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di tshig nyung la brjod bya zab cing rgya che bas shin tu rtogs dka' bar dgongs nas/ de'i dus kyi 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams kyis mchod pa sngon du song nas bshad pa'i rgyud gsungs pa/ gsol ba gdab pa las gsungs pa da lta bod na bzhugs tshod ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sdom 'byung / he ru ka mngon 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ nges brjod bla ma'am/ a bhi dha na/ dpal kha sbyor ram/ sam+bu ṭi ste phyi ma lnga gsang mtha'i rgyud do/ /yang bde mchog la/ 'khor lo bde mchog kyai rdor bde mchog sgyu ma bde mchog gsum du byed par gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor yang bde mchog yin no gsungs/ gzhan yang phag dngos grub 'byung ba dang / rnal 'byor ma kha sbyor dang / ra li nyer gsum gyi nang gi dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud rnams ni rgyud rnam par dag pa'o/ /gzhan rtsod byas dang / rje btsun ma'i skor rnams 'bri ma nus so/ /gnyis pa de lta bu'i gsungs pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams la 'grel byed ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i stod 'grel/ rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhi'i 'grel pa gnyis/ yang slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa/

thub dka' zla ba/ mi thub zla ba'ang zer/ slob dpon lang ka rgyal bzang gi dka' 'grel/ slob dpon skal ldan grags pas de'i 'grel bshad/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas de gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar te bzhi po ni rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par 'grel lo/ /yang grub chen la ba pas mdzad pa dang / slob dpon lhas sbas kyis mdzad pa gnyis ni mdzad pa po gcig gis mdzad pa lta bu yod/ slob dpon su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa'i nyung ngu mtshams sbyor te gsum po rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa rnal 'byor gsang mthar 'grel lo/ /dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa dang bcur yod pa las/ phyi ma ni zangs dkar lo tsā bas gsang mtshan gyi 'khrul gzhi byas par snang bas bod ma'o gsungs so/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la pad+ma badz+ra gyi 'grel pa gru gzings/ de'i slob ma slob dpon dza ya se na'i sgrub thabs yod/ sdom 'byung la bal po shrī dz+nyā na'i sgrub thabs dang / de'i slob ma rat+na kirti'i 'grel pa yod/ he ru ka mngon 'byung la ku ma ra tsan+ḍas mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la slob dpon nor bzang dang / slob dpon bha wa bha tras mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod la ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ mngon brjod la dz+nyā na badz+ra dang / shu raṅka warmas mdzad pa/ kha sbyor la rgyal po in+t+ra bo ti dang se na yis mdzad pa ste de rnams 'grel pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /gzhan rnams la yod med ma nges so/ /de dag gis rtsa bshad la 'grel pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa bshad srol de dag gis lam srol du gyur pa'i che ba'i tshul ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / stod 'grel rnams kyis rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa dus 'khor dang mthun par 'grel/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa dang bcas pas gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par 'grel/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/

bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ ces gsungs pa'i bshad rgyud lnga dang / la ba pa/ lha sbas/ su ma ti kirti/ bha wa bha dra'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa rnams kyis rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa rnal 'byor gsang mthar 'grel/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / skar rgyal zla ba sogs kyi 'grel pa bzhi pos rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par 'grel lo/ /de ltar rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs shing / rgya 'grel rnams kyis bkral ba'i lam srol ni bzhi po der nges so gsungs/ phag mo mngon 'byung ni/ a bhi dha na'i le'u gcig phyung ba'am/ ma byung yang de las don khyad par med/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor ni ma rgyud du snang yang / bde mchog gi rgyud yin min dpyad gzhi'o gsungs so/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam srol bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gsang mtha'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa ngos bzung ba dang / de lam srol gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang / khyad par gyi lam zab mo de 'phags yul nas bod la ji ltar bsgyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ sbyin bya bzhi byin nas/ bslab bya gnyis las bslab pas/ grogs spyod pa rang don dang gzhan don gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis thob pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis lū nag dril gsum ka'i lam rim bstan to gsungs/ thog mar lam spyi la sbyar nas bshad na/ sbyin bya bzhi byin nas zhes pas thog mar dbang bzhi'i rgyud yongs su smin par byas pa bstan to/ /smin pa lam gyi rim pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud he ru ka mngon 'byung sbyar ba las thon te/ de yang nag po pas mdzad pa'i dbang chog go /de yang lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog nyid do/ /'di la lū hi pas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par rnams sbyar bas lū hi pa'i dbang chog yang thon no/

/lam 'di nyams su len pas ni smin byed kyi dbang 'di nyid kho na thob dgos kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i rtsa bshad sbyar ba'i dbang chog thob pas mi chog pa'i gnad rnams legs par shes nas nges pa brnyed par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyud yongs su smin par byas nas kyang / dbang dus su khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs legs par skyong ba'i tshul ni rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid nas gsal bar bstan to/ /thun mong ba rnams lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni 'khrul spong nyid yin no/ /bslab bya gnyis la bslab pas zhes pas bstan to/ /de la bslab bya gnyis ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la slob pa'i tshul dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa la slob pa'i tshul gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas nas lam nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ dang po la gsum las/ dang po lha mngal skyes ltar bskyed pa'i bskyed chog gi rim pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ba glang lhas kyi steng lding dang / lhag ma rtsa gnas skem byed do/ /brag chen po yi ngo bo ru/ /yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pas dang po gsum lugs 'byung du bshad pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro sbyar ba las/ lha mngal skyes ltar bskyed pa nag po pa'i mngon rtogs yang thon to/ /mngon rtogs de la de ltar tha snyad 'dogs pa ni/ a bhi dha na las/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /zhes gsungs/ yang gnyis pa lha sgong skyes ltar bskyed pa'i bskyed chog ni/ yang na rus sbal dag gis so/ /zhes pa bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang sbyar ba las/ sgong skyes ltar bskyed pa lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs thon no/ /'dir cung zad bshad na/ gong gi gsum po lugs ldog tu bshad pas gzhal yas khang gi rten dang / de'i sna tshogs rdo rje pad 'dab dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ ri rtser sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng / /lte bar ā l̥ kā l̥ bskyed/

/zhes dang / mngon byang las rten dang brten pa gcig char bskyed pa ni/ yang na rus sbal dag gi so/ /zhes pas ston/ 'di la tha snyad de ltar mdzad cing zhi ba glus bskul med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ a bhi dha na las/ sgong skyes glu ni med pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par spangs/ /zhes so/ /sgra tshul las bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / sgra'i tshul las nges 'byung zhing / /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul can/ /zhes dngos sgra tshul las grub tshul/ gnyis pas grub pa'i brten pa lha dam tshig spyod pa/ rten gzhal yas khang spyod yul can zhes pas bstan to/ /gsum pa brdzus skyes ltar bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las/ gsang ba mchog gis dges pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /zhes pa dang / bshad pa'i rgyud kyi cha so so nas nye bar mkho ba rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag dang sbyar ba las/ lha brdzus skyes ltar bskyed pa dril bu pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs thon no/ /mngon par rtogs pa gsum po'i sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa rtsa rgyud du mi gsal ba rnams a bhi dha na dang sbyar ba las thon te/ de nyid las/ kha dog mtshon bya la sogs pa/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du sbas pa bshad/ zhes so/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam gyi yan lag sngags btu zhing bzlas pa/ rigs ldan ma'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg las tshogs rab 'byams sgrub dgos pa rnams rtsa rgyud nyid du gsal bar bshad do/ /de lta bu'i bskyed rim gsum po gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dang por las dang po pa'i dus na phyi dkyil gtso bor gyur pa nag po pa ltar/ cung zad brtan pa thob nas phyi nang cha mnyam pa lū hi pa ltar/ brtan pa cher thob nas nang dkyil gtso bor ston pa dril bu pa ltar nyams su len par gsungs pa ni don la 'byor gsungs/

gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ bde mchog dkar po la brten pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las thon te/ 'di lū hi pa'i rdzogs rim dang sbyor ba yin gsung / yang nag po pa'i gzhung gsum/ dril bu pa'i rdzogs rim rnams rtsa rgyud dang dpal kha sbyor las thon no/ /de yang rdzogs rim bsgom pa la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rnal 'byor bzhi las/ las kyi phyag rgya ni rdo rje rigs kyi g.yung mo la sogs pa'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dam rgya ni/ dang por las rgya la brten nas bde ba skyes pa de nyid phyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la brten nas skyong ba'o/ /phyag chen ni/ de rnams la brten pa'i don gyi ye shes skyes pa'o/ /de rnams la gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i rnal 'byor de rtsa rgyud las dngos su ma bstan kyang / drag po'i sbyin sreg chos 'byung gi nang du pad 'dab la ā l̥ kā l̥ bkod pa las sngags bsdu ba de nyid/ sam+bu ṭir nges don du bshad pas thon no/ /phyag rgya bzhi yang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mai tri pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dgra las rnam rgyal sogs kyis mdzad pa dang don mi 'dra'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar ba las 'bras bu rnam pa gnyis thob par 'gyur ba ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa yin pas/ lam srol 'di la bshad pa'i rgyud kyang lnga pa der nges so/ /de ltar yin yang gzhan rnams rgyud 'grel rnam par dag pa min zhes kyang mi brjod de/ dper na ye shes zhabs lugs pas rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang sbyar nas 'chad kyang / rgyud 'grel gzhan 'phags lugs sogs la skur pa mi 'debs pa bzhin no/ /yang de ltar rnam par dag pa yin kyang / de dag dang ma mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas 'di la rgol ba dang /

yang de dag 'dir bsre bar mi bya ste/ de dag lam srol so so bar sangs rgyas kyi gsungs/ paṇ+ḍi tas bshad/ grub chen rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i lam so so ba yin pas so/ /zhes bdag gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lam srol 'di lam srol gzhan las khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa la/ dpal nā ro ta pa chen po'i bzhed pas/ pha rol du phyin pa'i sde snod dang / sngags kyi rgyud sde sgo drug gsungs pa'i zab don mtha' thug sgo drug pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha' yin par bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ji srid mdos pha rol du phyin pa'i sde snod dang / bya bas bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pas spyod rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gsang bas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la gsum yod pa las/ pha bla med dang / mthas ma bla med dang / dbye ba nyid kyis ma'i yang ma bla med rnal 'byor gsang mtha' bstan par bzhed pa yin no/ /de yang gdul bya'i dbang po'i rim pas theg pa'i bye brag mi 'dra ba de ltar gsungs kyang / zab don mthar thug pa gsang mtha' yin par dgongs so/ /'di rgyud sde sgo drug par 'jog pa'i tshul/ pham things pa chen po'i bzhed pas rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud dang / rdo rje 'chang chen pos 'khor sa bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsungs/ de rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes/ snyigs dus kyi gang zag rnams kyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa la dgongs nas de rnams yi ger 'bri ma nus par sgra nam mkha' la dengs par bzhed de rgyas gdab ces gsungs so/ /yang rgya gar dha ri ka pa dang / bal po thugs rje chen po'i bzhed pas/

rtsa rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa o ḍi sha'i gtsug lag khang du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bai dur+ya'i glegs bam la gser zhun mas bris te rgyas gdab nas bzhag pas sgo drug pa yin par bzhed do/ /de gnyis kas kyang rgyud 'di gang zag yongs su smin pa dbang po yang rab kyi nyams len yin pas sgo drug par bzhed do/ /yang snyigs dus kyi kun mkhyen gnyis pa slob dpon shan+ti pa chen po'i rgyud 'grel gzhan dang gzhan la rang rgyud du 'grel pa rtsom par nus shing brtsams pa las/ rgyud 'di la 'grel pa rtsom pa'i nub mo rmi lam du/ khyod mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag thang la 'bod pa yin nam zer ba rmi zhing / sang shangs khrag mang po brdal nas 'grel pa rtsom par ma nus pas sgo drug par bzhed do/ /yang rgyud sde gzhan gsungs ba po rnams mya ngan las 'das tshul ston pa'am/ sku'i rnam 'phrul slar bsdud pa yin la/ rgyud 'di gsungs ba po'i ston pa'i rnam 'phrul ni da ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na dngos su dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs nas sgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i sgo drug par bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud las yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /rtsa gzugs mdzes pa'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /de ni 'dod pa'i gzugs can de/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gal te de rnams spyir 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud sde gzhan las zab pa'i sgrub byed du song mod/ 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad du ma song ngo snyam na/ bden mod/ rgyud gsungs ba po'i ston pas/ spyir rgyud byin gyis rlobs par byed pa tsam du mtshungs mod/ byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i gdams pa zab mo yod med kyi khyad par yod pa 'di zab khyad du 'gro ba 'di mi 'thad la/ de yang gang yin snyam na/ rgyas par rtsa bshad sbyar ba'i skabs su bshad mod/

'dir yang mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bshad na/ smin byed dbang gi skabs su dpa' bo bskul ba zhes pa/ pho nya sngags skyes la pho nya zhing skyes dang / pho nya lhan skyes bstim nas sa bon btab pa de'i phyir/ grol lam bskyed rim gyi skabs su pho nya gsum bsre ba'i gdams pa nyams su blangs pas pho nya zhing skyes dang / lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs myur du bkug nas rtogs pa khyad par can 'char ba'i gdam ngag yod de/ rje btsun gyis rtsa rgyud don 'gyur du gsungs pa las/ pho nya rnam gsum legs 'dres nas/ /bsgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes so/ /yang grol lam rdzogs rim gyi skabs su/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ 'phrul 'khor mkhan 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa/ shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ zhes pas dpes mtshon pa/ rnal 'byor pa gdam ngag gi gnad la mkhas pas dmigs pa'i gnad cig la bsnun pas dpe'i ye shes myur du 'dren/ de nas don gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo yod pas zab khyad du 'gro'o/ /de dag ni mtshon pa tsam mo/ /'di lta bu'i gdams pa 'di ni gsang zhing sbas nas nyams su blang bar bya ba kho na nyid yin pas/ kho bo cag la gzhan la med pa'i gdams pa yod ces sgrog pa dang / brgal lan gyi phreng ba'i yul du byed pa ni rigs pa ma yin no zhes smra ba'o/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi lam de 'phags yul nas bod la ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul la/ spyir bshad pa dang / khyad par du bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la rgya bod na nyid zla ltar grags pa'i grub chen dpal nā ro ta pa la slob ma'i dbang du byas na/ dpal mchog ḍom+bhi ba dang / mda' bdag mai tri ba dang / shan+ti pa chen po sogs grub chen che bar grags pa bdun/ zhi ba bzang po/ zhi ba go cha la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob ma mang po byon pa yin la/ mar me mdzad bzang pos shan+ti pa chen po la bde mchog gi dbang gi brgyud pa/

bhi pu ta'i bshad pa yan lag dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas dha ri ka pa'i slob ma bram ze sdom pa bzang po la lū nag gi dbang zab mo don dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa la bde mchog yab bka' dang / phag mo zhal gnyis ma dang / nā ro mkha' spyod sogs nyams len byin rlabs dang bcas pa gsan no/ /de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi lo chen rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta dkar dmar gsum spyan drangs/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud mngon brjod gnyis bsgyur zhes sam/ yang lo chen gyis jo bo shrar+dha na la rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa lang ka rgyal bzang dang / kong ka na'i skor rnams gsan nas rtsa rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis kyi 'gyur yang mdzad ces so/ /de nas nag tsho lo tsā bas jo bo spyan drangs tho mthing du byon pa na/ lo chen gyis bde mchog lū hi pas gtso byas dbang man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ jo bo lugs kyi lū hi pa'i 'grel chung yang brtsams/ lugs de shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de nas brgyud pa sa skya pa chen po la babs cing thugs nyams su yang bzhes so/ /de nas jo bos dbus su byon nas rong pa mgar dge ba la lū hi pa'i skor dang / lha sbas kyi 'grel pa'i bshad pa dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /de dag ni jo bo nas bod la brgyud pa'i tshul te 'grel pa lugs yin no/ /yang dpal nā ro pa yun ring du bsten pas mnyes par byas pa ni/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ mahā ka shrī/ kha che byang chub bzang po/ bal po pham things pa sku mched bzhi'am gsum mo/ /gcen po dge slong dar ma ma tis lo bcu gnyis su bsten nas/ mthar gcung po la khyod nga'i bla ma'i drung du sdod la zab don zhus shig kho bo la bla ma'i lung bstan yod pas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la bsgom du 'gro gsungs nas bzhud de gar gshegs ma byung ste don la mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin skad/ de'i gcung po 'jigs med grags pa a thas ma yas lo dgu bsten/

de la bal yul du a thas pa chen po dang / bod la bal po pham things pa grags so/ /de'i gcung po bla ma dus 'khor ba ngag dbang grags pa'am/ bal po mai tri bas lo lnga bsten/ de'i gcung po tha chung pas dbang tsam thob/ pham things pa chen po la slob ma mang du yod kyang / mchog tu gyur pa jo bo bha dan ta'am/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti la mchog tu grags so/ /'di nyid bod du byon pa'i dus su slob ma lo tsā ba rang yang mang po byung ngo / /de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa mar do dang / spu hrang pa gnyis so/ /de gnyis kyi nang nas kyang gzhung dang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ spu hrang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab yin no/ /lo tsā ba 'di ni he ru kas dngos su rjes su bzung zhing sku lus de nyid ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /rje btsun spu hrang pa la slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grog ra ba dngos grub shes rab/ 'dre bya ru ba/ yar lung pa lha btsun dpal gyis rgyal mtshan sogs bde mchog la mkhas pa mang po byung skad/ spu hrang pa dang mar do ba gnyis la lo chen lo chung zhes grags pa'ang sku bong gi sgo nas yin gyi/ chos ni lo chung mkhas zer ro/ /mar do ba la yang slob ma dpyal se nyi ma rdo rje/ ze ba jo bde ba jo 'bum sogs byung / ze ba la lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub sogs byung ngo / /mdor na lo tsā ba de gnyis kyis bde mchog shin tu dar bar mdzad do/ /de dag ni paṇa chen su ma ti kirti nas brgyud pa'i tshul mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par du 'dir dpal nā ro ta pa'i tshogs bshad dang slob bshad gnyis kyi nang nas/ slob ma la bshad pa 'grel lugs pa dang / man ngag lugs gnyis las/ man ngag lugs kyi brgyud tshul ni/ bla ma klog kya shes rab brtsegs dang / mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags gnyis kyis su ma ti kirti dang / pham things pa'i gcung po bod du byon dus bde mchog gi chos skor dbang sgrub rnams tshang bar thob bo/

/khyad par bla ma lo tsā bas dus phyis bal po nas nā ro pa'i slob ma kha che byang chub bzang po dang / ka na shrī'i slob ma bal po thugs rje chen po/ su ma ti kirti rnams la legs par gsan/ khyad par du yang pham thing pa sku mched legs par mnyes par byas nas lū nag dril gsum ka'i zab don ma lus pa rgyud kyi bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan no/ /bla chen mal gung thang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po de chos zhu ba la byon pas tshogs bshad khyug pa cig gnang skad/ de nas mar la chos zhu ba mang po byung ba rnams kyi 'bul ba phul ba'i gser srang bco brgyad 'bul du btang pas/ bla ma shin tu mnyes nas slob ma dam tshig par yod par 'dug pas/ nga rgan po yun ring du mi sdod pas gdam ngag rnams len du shog gsungs nas bka' gnang bas/ slar byon nas zab don yongs su rdzogs pa gnang nas sngar gyis 'grel pa lugs dor skad do/ /rje de nyid kyis gnyan phul chung pa dge slong bsod nams rdo rje dang / rje btsun sku mched la yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ngo / /rje btsun chen pos chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang / nub pa rigs 'dzin grags dang dkar shākya grags la gnang ngo / /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po des 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che la gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ngo / /yab sras de dag gi gsung bgros rnams kyang lugs 'di la med kha med yin no/ /de rnams dkar chag na bzhugs pa bzhin yin no/ /nub pa rigs 'dzin grags kyi rtsa rgyud dang / dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i ṭīk+ka gnyis dang / dkar gyi rtsa rgyud dang / mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod kyi ṭīk+ka/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ lū dril gyi mngon rtogs sogs kyang lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres par ston pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /zhib par rgyud yig dang rnam thar chen mo sogs su shes par bya'o/

/chos 'byung lo rgyus mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /de rnams kyis mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ 'jig rten phun tshogs 'byor pas 'byor pa'ang 'byor ldan dbang phyug legs mod kyi/ /'byor ba'i gtso bo thugs rgyud gtso bo yon tan gtso bo 'byor gyur pa/ /dam pa khyod ni mkhas pa'i mkhas mchog mkhas pa kun gyi bla ma ste/ /de ltar nges pa lhag par nges pa'i dad pas nges par bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni yon tan dpal/ /dpal de ma lus mkhas dbang khyod la mnga'/ /mnga' bdag dam pa rnams kyis bkur 'os mchog /mchog khyod gsang mtha'i bstan pa'i gsal byed legs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don brgyad pa snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas pa bzang po dpal ba'i gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa ni/ thang cig tsam gyis skyo bar mi bgyi sngon med legs bshad bsam mi khyab/ /nyung ngu tsam gyis chog shes mi bgyi tshig don gnyis ka bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs re tsam gyis mgu bar mi bgyi sbyangs pa'i gzhung lugs bsam mi khyab/ /tshig bshad tsam gyis dges par mi bgyi ting 'dzin rtogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar dpal ldan dpal ldan bla ma mchog /chos kyi rgyal po rgyal po gang gi sras/ /mkhyen rab bzang po bzang po'i lhag bsam can/ /rmad byung chos dpal dpal 'byor can de rgyal/ /brgyud pa bzang po'i rjes zhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi dpal ster ba/ /sdom brtson mkhyen rab bzang po can/ /snyan brgyud zab mo'i dpal de rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mnga' bzang po dpal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa la/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i rnam bshad zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i rnam bshad zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa/

bde mchog dril bu pa'i rnam bshad zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa ste/ rgyas par dbye na de lta bur 'gyur kyang / 'dir ni 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i rnam bshad zin bris zab don bdud rtsi'i bum pa las 'byung tshul bshad pas gzhan rnams kyang der 'dus par rnam bshad de nyid rang las gsungs pas na/ bde mchog nag po pa'i rnam bshad de nyid las 'byung tshul 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rnam bshad zin bris de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de la 'dir 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid kyi gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ sngags kyi theg pa 'di 'chad/ 'di la rgyud sde bzhi yod pa las bla med/ de la yang pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud rnams su yod pa las/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor 'di 'chad/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'dir 'jug pa la rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs pa gcig dgos pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yi/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i don mdo zhes pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ste/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ spyod lam la sogs bye brag chos/ /mdo sde rnams shes dbu ma pa/ mos pa'i sems can rnams bshad de/ zhes gsungs so/ /de'i don la/ spyod lam zhes pa 'dul ba'i sde snod nas gsungs pa'i gzhi tshul khrims la gnas dgos pa bstan/ sogs khong nas mkhas pa'i yan lag tu rta drag pa nor bu btags pa la sogs pa 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / phyi rol mu stegs kyi gzhung lugs la mkhas par byed dgos pa bstan/

gzhi tshul khrims de la gnas nas lta ba rim pa can la bslab par bya ba'i phyir/ bye brag chos smos te bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' la grags pa'i dpe gtan tshigs lung rig la brten nas/ rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi dam tshig bdag dang bdag gi ba'i mtshon pa'i spros pa bkag nas/ gang zag gi bdag med du gtan la phab/ phab don la zhi lhag gi rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag de dang 'brel ba'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'bras bu bsgrub par byed pa'i lam rim gyi rgyud sbyangs/ de nas mdo sde zhes smos te/ gzhi tshul khrims sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mdo sde'i grub mtha' la grags pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas snang ba phyi don bden grub du 'dod pa'i bdag dang bdag gi ba'i spros pa thams cad bkag nas yul snang sems su gtan la phab/ phab don la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /'o na mdo sde pa'i lugs la phyi rol gyi don med dam snyam na med pa ma yin te/ phyi don lkog na mo zhes bya ba rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyu khas len pa'o/ /de la mdo sde pa yul snang thams cad sems su 'dod par/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi las bsgrub pa'i rig par bshad cing / rje btsun rin po ches mngon pa kun las btus par/ mdo sems gnyis kyi bstan bcos thun mong pa yin par bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams las shes so/ /phyi don lkog na mo yod par/ grub chen klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim par/ ut+pal lta bu'i sems can dang / zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa'i skabs su bshad do/ /de lta bu'i mdo sde pa'i lam rim gyi rgyud 'byongs pa dang / sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' la grags pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas gzung ba chos kyi bdag dang bdag gi spros pa ba thams cad bkag nas/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gzung ba chos kyi bdag med/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal du gtan la phab/ de la zhi lhag gis mnyam par bzhag ste/

de ltar ston pa'i gzhung lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'bras bu bsgrub par byed pa'i lam rim gyi rgyud sbyangs/ de nas dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la grags pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag dang bdag gi pa'i spros pa thams cad bkag nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sems/ de sgyu ma/ de mtha' bral stong pa nyid du gtan la phab/ de la zhi lhag gis rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag de dang 'brel ba'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'bras bu bsgrub par byed pa'i lam rim gyi rgyud sbyong tshul 'di ni skabs 'dir spyod pa dang lta ba rim pa can gyi rgyud tshul yin la/ 'di dang kyai rdo rje'i lugs kyi lta spyod rim pa can la khrid tshul khyad med par snang ste/ brtag gnyis las/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de nas bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de la bye brag smra ba dang / /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje brtsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos/ gso sbyong sbyin zhes pa'i shugs la dge bsnyen la sogs pa so thar rigs bdun gyi rgyud sbyong ba bstan/ bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin pa'i shugs la smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi rgyud sbyong ba bstan ces gsungs pas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub sems kyi rgyud sbyangs pa gcig sngags kyi theg pa la 'jug pa byed de/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ theg pa chen por yongs smin nas/ /phyi nas sngags ni rab brtan bya/ /zhes dang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ rigs dang dam tshig mi ldan snying rje med/ /byang chub sems kyi sbyang ba ma byas shing / /sangs rgyas ma dad lha gzhan la dga' la/ /nga yi gsang sngags bstan na phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/

/de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khong pa'i sems pa la/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam 'di la brten nas myur na'ang bskal pa grangs med pa gsum nas 'tshang rgya bar gda'/ de tsam 'gor na sems can rnams de bar la brlag gyag la 'gro bar gda'/ da 'di bas 'tshang rgya ba myur ba gcig yod dam med/ yod na der zhugs nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas nas sems can gyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu bya'o snyam pa'i blo gros chen po dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la rim gyis 'khrid par byed do/ /brtag gnyis las/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje brtsam/ /zhes dang / gur las kyang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gdul bya'i dbang po'i khyad par gyi dbang gis 'jug bya gsang sngags la rgyud sde sgo drug tu yod de/ gang zag kha cig spyir gsang sngags la mos kyang rang gi phung khams skye mched lhar bsgom mi nus pa'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bya rgyud gsungs te/ ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dang / /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ltar gyi dbang gnyis bskur/ de dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig legs grub nas gsungs pa bcu drug la gnas/ lam mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor yan lag dang bcas pa la brten nas thub pa rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byed pa'i lam gyi rgyud sbyong / de dbang po 'bring du na 'phos pa dang / rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom nus kyang ye shes pa'i ngo bor bsgom mi nus pa'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir spyod rgyud gsungs te/ rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang /

/spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ltar dbang lnga bskur/ de dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig bzhi la gnas/ lam mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas sa bcu gcig gi rtogs pa bgrod nus par byed pa spyod rgyud kyi lam rim la 'khrid par byed de/ gang zag dbang po rab mnyam bzhag gi skabs su rang lus yi dam gyi lha ye shes pa'i ngo bor bsgom nus kyang / rjes gcod kyi skabs su ye shes pa'i ngo bor bsgom mi nus pa'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs pa yin no/ /ye shes thig le las/ de bzhin drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang du brjod/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa la/ /dbang brgyad phye la sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa ltar dbang brgyad bskur/ de dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig bcu gcig la gnas/ lam mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor yan lag dang bcas pa la brten nas khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa ste/ de gsum ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor zhes dang / kun spyod las/ mdo dang bya ba spyod rnams dang / /rnal 'byor gsang sogs dbye ba yis/ /zhes pas bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi don mdor bsdus pa'o/ /da ni gsang zhes pa'i don 'chad do/ /de yang gang zag dbang po yang rab lus yi dam gyi lha ye shes pa dang dbyer med du ji srid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar 'bral med du bsgom nus pa'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bla med kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /'di la rigs gsum yod de/ gang zag kha cig thabs kun rdzob gtso bor gyur pa'i lam la dga' ba rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ rags pa dang rtogs sla ba dang thabs gtso bor gyur pa pha rgyud kyi bla med gsungs so/ /'di la yang rgyud sde gsum yod de/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/

zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor rnams gsungs so/ /yang shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'i lam la dga' ba'i rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa la ma rgyud rigs drug go /thabs shes cha mnyam la dga' ba'i gang zag rjes su 'dzin pa la gnyis med kyi rgyud rnams gsungs pa las/ da lan ma'i yang ma bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di la 'jug par byed do/ /'di la 'jug pa la ma rgyud kyai rdo rje man gyis rgyud sbyongs dgos na/ rgyud sde de dang de'i rtogs pa skyes skyes bsgom dgos sam snyam na/ 'di la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gis de dang de'i rtogs pa skyes skyes bsgom mi dgos te/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i tshe mdo rgyud rab 'byams thams cad la spyod dgos te/ gsang mtha'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por gyur pa'i tshe mdo rgyud thams cad kyi sgo nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin dgos la/ de la yang mkhas par bslab dgos pa'i phyir/ spyad don nyams su len pa'i tshe mdo rgyud kyi don thams cad bla med kyi zab don gcig gi nang du dril nas nyams su blangs pas mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ jo bos dbu ma bden gnyis las/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad ni ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dwangs du len par bya/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sbyangs pa sngon du song nas rgyud kyi rgyal po'i gsang mtha'i lam rim 'di nyams su len pa la gnyis te/ 'grel pa lugs dang / man ngag lugs gnyis/ dang po ni dpal nā ro pa nas pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta la/ des ma na ka shrī la/ des ka na ka shrī la/ des su ma ti kirti/ des mar do chos kyi dbang phyug dang /

spu hrang lo tsā ba gnyis la brgyud do/ /mar do'i lugs ni ding sang chad nas med la/ spu lugs 'di dpal ldan sa skya pa la babs/ deng sang yang mal lo lugs dang dbyer med du yod pa yin zhes chos rje rdo rje 'chang gsungs kyang / mal lo lugs dang mi 'dra ba du ma yod de/ rten gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dang bcas pa lus la bsgom pa ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / khong gi rjes 'brang dmar chos kyi rgyal po dang / rgyal mtshan gnyis char gyis mar lo la dgag pa byas 'dug pa'i phyir/ lugs de gnyis gcig tu mi 'gre ba 'dug gsungs so/ /'grel pa lugs de ni grub chen gyi rgya gzhung la 'grel pa dang / bstan bcos gzhan gyi kha bskangs nas bshad pa mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi gdams pa dngos la skyon zhugs pas cung mi zab pa yin la/ nā ro rtsa rkyang gi lugs 'di ni grub chen gyi gzhung dngos bstan la/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud kyi kha skong cung zad byas te/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa la skyon ma zhugs pas shin tu zab pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan grub chen lū nag dril gsum gyi rang gi 'jug gi pa'i bla ma sha wa ri dbang phyug la sogs pas lam 'di bstan/ rang gi nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ yi dam gyi lha mthong ba la sgrib byed kyi dri ma sangs dag nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i zhal mthong ste yi dam gyi lha de rnams kyis dngos su gdams pa'i gdam ngag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing / sa lam gyi rtog pa bgrod pa la gzhan las ches myur ba yin no/ /de'i lam srol 'di la bzhi ste/ lū nag dril gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang bzhi'o/ /'di bzhi spu hrang pa rnams kyi rten gyi gang zag gnyis kyi lam rim la sbyor te/ chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang /

/chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba'o/ /dang po nag po pa'i lam gyi khrid/ de la dbang yang dngos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas bskur/ lam yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thig le'i gong bur zhu/ zhu ba las glus bskul/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs/ de'i mngal du dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sprul pa la sogs pa chags lam gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de nas dbang po rab tu 'phos pa dang dril bu pa'i lam la 'jug de nas dbang po yang rab tu song ba dang nā ro mkha' spyod la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig la mkha' spyod che chung gang rung gi go 'phang bsgrub par byed la/ chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba'i gang zag la ni/ dang por lū hi pa'i chos skor bstan/ de nas dril bu pa/ de nas nā ro mkha' spyod la khrid/ ces gsungs la/ dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams ni gang zag gcig gi lam rim la sbyor te/ las dang po pa rjes su gzung ba'i phyir dang / mngal skyes kyi dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir nag po pa'i chos skor ston/ de la blo 'byongs te dbang po 'bring du na 'phos pa dang / skye gnas sgong skyes kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir lū hi ba'i chos skor ston par byed do/ /de nas dbang po rab tu na 'phos nas phyi'i spros pa thams cad chod do/ /nang rdo rje'i lus 'ba' zhig la gnad du bsnun pa'i gang zag de rjes su gzung ba'i phyir dang / skye gnas brdzus skyes kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir dril bu pa'i chos skor bstan to/ /de nas yang rab tshe gcig lus gcig la mkha' spyod bsgrub par byed pa'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir nā ro mkha' spyod la 'khrid pa yin no/ /ding sang dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyi phyag na bzhugs pa'i bde mchog gi chos/ dbang dang lam bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa khrid dang bcas pa tshang ma bzhugs pa ni de tsam yin la/ gzhan bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang /

sangs rgyas thod pa dang / sdom 'byung rnams la dbang bka' re yod pa las/ gzhan phal cher chad/ yang lang ka rgyal bzang nas shrar+dha la/ des jo bo rin chen bzang po/ des brag steng pa nas bla ma sa skya pa'i phyag tu babs pa'i bde mchog yang byung te ding sang chad nas med do/ /yang jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig byung ba rnams kyi nang nas rab dang mchog tu gyur pa ni nā ro rtsa rkyang gi lugs 'di yin la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi nyams len yang 'di la mdzad cing / grub pa yang 'di la brten nas thob pa yin no gsungs so/ /'o na bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams kyi brjod bya thams cad bsdus na gang du 'du snyam na/ spu hrang pa rnams kyis rgyud gsum gyis bsdus par bzhed/ gzhi dri bcas kyis 'khor lo bde mchog dang / lam dri ma sel ba 'bras bu dri mas dag pa'i bde mchog dang gsum du bsdu la/ rje btsun rin po ches ni kun spyod kyi yig snar/ nyams su len pa po'i rten gyi kun spyod/ nyams su blang bya lam gyi kun spyod/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i kun spyod dang gsum bshad pa la/ de'i sgrub pa po rten gyi gang zag gi bshad pa la/ rtsa rgyud las/ dag dang ma dag 'dres pa yi/ /sgrub pa po ni gsum du gnas/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /zhes so/ /'di la gnyan phul chung bas/ ma dag pa ni bskyed rim bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po/ dag pa ni rdzogs rim/ 'dres pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgrub pa po yin par mdor bstan nas/ de nyid rgyas par ston pa la gsal byed ces sogs kyis bshad pa mdzad pa la bshad sbyar du dgag pa mdzad nas/ rang lugs la gong ma lam la ma zhugs pa'i gnas skabs la sbyar/ 'og ma lam la zhugs pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyar te/ ma dag pa ni sngar lam la ma zhugs pa sdig pa mi dge ba 'ba' zhig spyod pa'i gang zag

dag pa ni dge ba bcu spyod pa'i gang zag 'dres pa ni dge sdig spel mar spyod pa'i rten can bstan pa yin la/ mnyes byed ni lha'i nga rgyal ste lha mnyes par byed pa bskyed rim bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po bstan/ rnam par dag pa ni gya nom ltar zhen gyis rnam gzhag rnam par dag pa ste rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po bstan la/ gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /zhes pas ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgo nas rang rgyud la yon tan gong nas gong du gsal bar byed pa bstan zhes bshad/ bla ma zhang bya ru bas ni 'bras bu 'grub pa'i rten la sbyar te/ ma dag pa thun mong gi dngos grub/ dag pa mchog gi dngos grub/ 'dres pa mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka la sbyor ro/ /kha cig ni rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i rten la sbyar te/ ma dag pa shes bya rgyud kyi rim pa/ dag pa bsgom pa sngags kyi rim pa/ 'dres pas skye ba ye shes kyi rim pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bstan to/ /yang nag po dkyil chog gi gzhung las/ /gcig tu sems can 'dug cing gtum/ /sdug bsngal dang ni las kyis gzir/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yis/ /byang chub la gzhag yid la bya/ /zhes dang / byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /'dres med rnal 'byor bde bar gnas/ /zhes dang / kye ma sems can sdug bsngal che/ /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi kun rtog gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru ka rang bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ des byams snying rje sngon du 'gro ba can gyi kun rdzob dang / don dam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi rgyud sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gsang mtha'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i lam rim 'di la 'jug dgos par bstan no/ /yang sa skya pa chen pos nag po ras bris kyi dkyil chog dang / gnyan gyi 'bru 'bum dang / nag po bshad sbyar rnams las/ sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub par byed pa'i lam 'di ru 'dus par bzhed do/

/de la sbyin bya bzhi ni smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi yin la/ he ru ka mngon 'byung gi le'u bcu gnyis pa dang / bco lnga pa gnyis la gtso bor brten/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas sa lha sta gon dang / thig tshon gyis bri ba la sogs pa dbang chog phal cher bstan/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u gnyis par sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa dang / sa chog dang dkyil 'khor chen po bris shing bsgrub pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun bstan/ le'u gsum pas slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang / 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i rim pa phal che ba bstan/ le'u bzhi pas mchog dbang bzhi pa bstan/ rgyud sde rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ slob dpon spyod pa bas nag po dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di mdzad do/ /'di'i lag tu blangs pa'i rim pa ston pa byed pa la/ rje btsun rin po ches nag po rdul tshon gyi cho ga dang / sa skya pa chen pos ras bris kyi cho ga dang / 'phags pa'i dkyil chog rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di rnams lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil chog thun mong ba yin pas/ lū hi pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / nang 'jug gnyis la khong rang gis sgrub thabs kyis 'gros sbyar ba tsam las dkyil chog la sogs pa mi bzhed do/ /gzhan dag la ba pas mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yod zer ro/ /mdor na dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de rnams nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun/ brtul zhugs kyi rim pa bcu bzhi ste/ dbang gi mngon rtogs nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ba'i cho ga'i sgo nas sbyin bya bzhi sbyin/ de dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig thun mong ba nyer gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa brgyad de sum cu tham pa la gnas nas lam nyams su len pa yin la/ bla ma zhang bya ru bas dbang bzhi dam tshig nyi shu la gnas dgos par bshad de/ bum dbang la rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig lnga/

gsang dbang la bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu brten pa'i dam tshig lnga/ shes rab ye shes la phyag rgya bsten thabs kyi dam tshig lnga/ dbang bzhi pa la dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig lnga ste nyi shu'o/ /bslab bya gnyis la bslab par bya ba la bum dbang thob pa'i bslab bya bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / dbang gong ma gsum thob pa'i bslab bya rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis so/ /dang po la nag po pa'i bskyed rim 'di ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la gtso bor brten/ a bhi dha na la yan lag cung zad brten/ kun spyod la rdo rje phag mo'i phyag mtshan sogs phra mo cung zad brten/ de yang a bhi dha na las/ mngal sgong gi dkyil 'khor bdun cu rtsa bzhi tsam gsungs la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas drag po he ru ka lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gcig dang / rdo rje sems dpa' phyag bzhi pa lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gcig ste gnyis gsungs/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs so/ /rtsa rgyud le'u so gnyis pa las/ zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /ji srid phyag 'bum bar du ste/ /zhes dang / le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ rdo rje dril bu lus la 'khyud/ /ces pa la brten nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ phyag 'bum phrag pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bar dkyil 'khor khri phrag lnga gsungs la/ yang gtso bo de nyid la 'khor lha nyer lnga pa dang / nyer gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / nyer gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor/ nyi shu ma/ bcu dgu pa/ lha dgu ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ de la yab sbas dang / yum sbas kyi dkyil 'khor/ lha bdun ma/ lha lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs so/ /rgyud de rnams la brten nas slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes nag po sgrub thabs kyi gzhung 'di mdzad do/ /'di'i don gsal byed pa la sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i nag 'bum/

rje btsun gyi sa spyad/ slob dpon pradz+nyā dza li ta'i ṭīka chung / 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la sogs pa yod/ rdzogs rim la rgyud 'di'i gleng gzhi dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gleng gzhi gnyis la tshig mang nyung yod kyang brjod bya'i don la khyad par med do zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba'i gzhung 'di mdzad do/ /'di nas don chos kyi phyag rgya rim pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang / dpe las kyi phyag rgya'i rdzogs rim gcig ste gnyis bstan no/ /de la sa skya pa chen pos gsal byed tshig 'grel dang / don 'grel bzhi yod do/ /yang 'di'i gleng gzhi dang / kyai rdo rje'i gleng gzhi gnyis phyogs gcig tu bsres pa'i gdam ngag ston pa la o la pa ti'i gzhung mdzad do/ /'di nas 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i rim bzhi'i rnal 'byor gcig dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thig le'i rnal 'byor gcig ste gnyis bstan to/ /dang po la dpyid dang thun mong ba'i sngags rim bsgom lugs gcig dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta bgres po rnams kyis bzhed pa'i lugs gcig gzhon pa dang thun mong ba'i lugs gcig ste gnyis yod do/ /yang rtsa rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan gyi rim pa bzhi 'di la sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa'i zab khyad thams cad mnan nas ston pa la dpyid kyi thig le'i gzhung mdzad do/ /'di nas 'khor lo bzhi dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa gcig dang / 'khor lo bzhi tsam la gnad du bsnun pa gcig dang / 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa dang / gcig la brten pa rnams su yod do/ /rtsa rgyud dngos bstan nas bshad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rdzogs rim thig le'i rnal 'byor dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yod do/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo nas brgyud pa'i rim bzhi lam bslong gi rdzogs rim yang yod de/
