'di ni nā ro rim bzhi yin gyi nag po rim bzhi ni ma yin no/ /yang gtum mo lam rdzogs la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /kun spyod lū hi pa'i skor la rtsa rgyud dang rnal 'byor ma kun spyod la brten nas dpal mngon par rtogs pa 'di mdzad do/ /'di'i don gsal bar byed pa la rje btsun gyi don 'grel chen mo/ tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba la gnyan gyi 'bru 'bum/ nyams len gyi ngag 'don bsgrigs pa la 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ tshes bcu'i lag len ston pa la rtse mo'i mchod phreng / de rnams kyi rgyab rten du kun spyod kyi yig sna dang bcas pa rnams so/ /rdzogs rim la bsdu ba gsum/ rdo rje phag mo dngos kyi gdams pa rtsa dbu ma/ rje btsun gyi khrid yig dang bcas pa/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ yang sa chen dang / gnyan dang / dkar dang / nub pa la sogs pa rnams kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rdzogs rim lū hi pa la sbyor bar bshad pas rdzogs rim de rnams so/ /zab don dril bu pa'i skor la/ gsang mtha' rtsa bshad kyi rgyud mtha' dag la brten nas dril bu gzhung gsum mdzad do/ /de la smin byed dbang gi cho ga dang / bskyed rim lus kyi gzhung / rdzogs rim rim lnga'i gzhung ngo / /bskyed rim kyi gzhung 'di nas las dang po pa phung khams lhar bsgom nus shing / ye shes pa'i ngo bor bsgom mi nus pa la rtsa thig rlung gsum thams cad lhar bsgom pa'i lus dkyil gcig dang / de nas rab tu 'phos pas lha thams cad yi ger bsgom pa dang / yang rab la rtsar bsgom pa'i lus dkyil gsum gsungs so/ /yang lhar bsgom mi nus pa la rtsa'i rnam pas/ de nas yi ger/ de nas lha'i rnam par bsgom pa'i lugs gsum mo/ /rdzogs rim gyi gzhung chung 'di nas/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i/ dza len+dha'i ra'i/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa rnams bstan la/

'di rnams kyang rdzogs rim yongs su rdzogs pa re re yin pas gang zag gcig gi rim pa lnga ka bsgom dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum po re re la'ang rdzogs rim rim pa lnga lnga sbyar bas bco lngar yang 'gyur ro/ /yang grub chen dril bu pas mdzad pa'i lha dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gcig kyang yod do/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di ni gzhung gsum dang mi mthun pa du ma yod pas dril bu pas mdzad ma mdzad rtsod bcas su snang ngo / /dril bu gzhung chung du grags pa ni pu hrang lo tsā bas mdzad pa yin no/ /de rnams gsal bar byed pa la rtse mos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rje btsun sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun gyi rim lnga'i khrid yig rnams yod do/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos 'di ni rtsa rgyud kyi le'u zhe brgyad pa dang zhe gcig pa gnyis la brten te/ de nas rje btsun ma'i sngags gsungs la/ le'u so gnyis pa nas/ rdo rje phag mo de yi ni/ /kha dog mtshon cha chad la gzigs/ /zhes pas lha gsungs pa la/ de rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa la dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa'i gzhung chung 'di yin no/ /'di la sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i phyi rkyang gi mngon rtogs rnal 'byor bcu gcig bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa ston pa la phag mo las bcu'i gzhung rnams so/ /dbu ma paṇ+ḍi tas 'phags pa rin po che la brgyud pa la lha so bdun/ phyi nang gnyis ka la bsgom pa'i lugs gcig dang / phyi lha bcu gsum la nang lha so bdun bsgom pa gcig dang / phyi lha lnga la nang so bdun/ phyi dpa' gcig la nang so bdun bsgom pa'i lugs rnams so/ /de'i gtso mo la mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba'o/ /kha cig 'di rnams phag mo mngon 'byung nas bshad pa'i lus dkyil yin zer/ de la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gis phag mo mngon 'byung gi lha rnams ni gdong brnyan can du bshad la/

'di la ni sgo ma bzhi ma gtogs gdong brnyan med pas rtsa rgyud dngos bstan nas bshad pa'i yum ka yin gsungs/ rdzogs rim ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mchod gzhi dpa' bo chen po ni/ zhes dang / rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya/ /zhes pa la brten pa yin la/ phyag chen gces bsdus dang / man ngag gces bsdus rnams la 'thor nas bzhugs so/ /de lta bu'i bslab bya bskyed rdzogs gnyis la bslab pas/ ting nge 'dzin skyes pa dang grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas 'bras bu mngon du byed do/ /de la rang don dang / gzhan don phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa gnyis so/ /'phags pa rin po ches spyod pas rten nye rgyus mtshams sbyor bar bshad kyang / rje btsun gyi skabs 'dir spyod pa las logs pa'i nye rgyu ma bshad pas/ de lta bus spyod pa la brten nas sa bcu gnyis kyi rtogs pa rim gyis bgrod nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed do/ /'di la mu tig phreng ba las/ don la sa bcu min pa bgrod rgyu med par bshad pa la/ kha cig 'khor lo bde mchog la/ sa bcu pa la dkyil stod dkyil smad rgyun mtha' gsum du byas pas/ don la sa tha dad pa bcu min pa bgrod rgyu med zer ro/ /'di ni mi 'thad de/ rje btsun rin po ches gtum mo lam rdzogs su/ sa bcu gnyis kyi rtogs pa rim gyis bgrod nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par byed do/ /zhes dang / rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig tu/ sa bcu gnyis kyi rlung dbu mar thim nas/ zhes dang / mu tig phreng ba las kyang / khyim bcu gnyis kyi rlung dbu mar thim/ zhes dang / a bhi dha na las/ rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyangs dka' ba dang mngon du 'gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ dpe med pa dang ye shes brtan/ /rdo rje'i sa ni bcu gsum pa/ /zhes gsungs/

lung 'di sa tha dad sa bcu gsum bgrod pa'i shes byed la rje btsun rin po ches drangs pas so/ /de lta bu'i lam rim 'di la du yod snyam na/ lam srol mi 'dra ba bzhi yod de/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rtsa rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bkral te/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bsgrag gi nang du lha snam bcu gnyis la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lnga brgya tham pa bkod/ mgron thabs la skal bzang gi sangs rgyas 'di'i gtso bo shākya thub pa dang tha mi dad yin la/ 'od srung sogs gsum ni 'dis bla ma yin pas 'khor du mi 'byung ngo / /stong la bzhis ma tshang ba bkod/ phyi dur khrod so gnyis kyis yongs su bskor ba/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'chings kyis bcings pa/ rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ de re re la'ang drug drug sum cu so drug gi rdzogs rim nyams su blangs/ grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i lam rim gcig dang / gnyis pa ni/ dpal bde mchog sdom 'byung / gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyis lam rim dang mthun par bkral te/ 'di nas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa la lha bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings pa rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gsum pa ni/ bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bkral te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / sdom 'byung lta bu'i khyad chos kyang med/ gsang mtha' lta bu'i zab khyad kyang med par/ rang dang kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i lam rim dang mthun pa'i sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis/ 'bras bu mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnams ston par byed pa'i lam rim dang / bzhi pa ni bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga po nyid kyis rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam rim du bkral te/

gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i lam mo/ /'o na gsang mtha' 'di rgyud sde gzhan las zab khyad ci yod snyam na/ dpal pham things pa'i gsung gis/ gsang mtha' 'di rgyud sde gzhan las zab ste/ dang po bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa rgyud rgyas pa rje btsun gyi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u 'bum pa/ 'bring po sho lo ka 'bum pa/ bsdus pa tshig 'bum pa gsungs te brtag par bya'o/ /'bum phrag gsum pa gsungs/ de dus kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi don byas/ phyis gdul bya rnams kyi spyod yul du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas sgra nam mkha' la dengs/ de'i phyir zab gsungs/ bal po thugs rje chen po'i gsung gis/ rtsa rgyud 'bring po 'bum phrag gcig pa gsungs/ de dus kyi 'khor rnams ni grol/ gdul bya mi rnams kyi spyod yul du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bai ḍūr+ya'i shog bu la gser gyis bris nas glegs bam du bsgrigs te rgyas btab nas nub phyogs u rgyan du bzhugs pa'i phyir zab ces zer/ kha cig slob dpon shan+ti pa chen pos mdo rgyud thams cad la 'grel pa thogs med rtsom nus pa la/ rtsa rgyud 'di la 'grel pa brtsam par bzhed pa'i tshe/ shangs khrag brdal/ mnal lam du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis snying khrag thang la 'bod pa e yin zer tshar bcad nas 'grel pa rtsom par ma nus pa'i phyir zab ces zer/ de rnams ni mi 'thad de/ zab khyad de ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs bde mchog gzhan la'ang yod pas so/ /gnyan phul chung pas rgyud sde gzhan rnams sprul bshad mdzad pa'i tshe rgyud gsungs tshar ba dang gtso 'khor rnams 'og min du bsdus la/ 'di'i rgyud sprul bshad mdzad zin pa dang / bde chen lha lnga 'og min du bsdus/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams ma bsdus par deng sang yang 'dzam bu gling gi yul nyer bzhi na dngos su bzhugs nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i phyir zab ces gsungs/

'di la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gis/ 'di yang gsang mtha'i zab khyad ma yin te/ bde mchog gzhan la'ang yod pas so zhes gsungs/ des na rang lugs la 'dzam bu'i gling na pho nya zhing skyes rnams bsgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i phyir dngos su bzhugs kyang / bde mchog gzhan rnams la ni byin rlabs de dngos su 'gugs pa'i gdam ngag med la/ gsang mtha' la ni byin rlabs 'gugs pa'i gdam ngag pho nya gsum bsres kyi sgo nas zab pa yin la/ de'ang zab tshul gsum ste/ smin byed dbang gi skabs su dpa' bo bskul ba'i sgo nas pho nya zhing skyes rnams dang lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs rang rgyud la bkug ste/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ bdag gi dpa' bo rab tu bskul/ /shrī he ru ka ya bid m+he bid+dhe ra dza ya dhe ma he swāhā/ zhes so/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la pho nya gsum bsre ba ni/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni pho nya sngags skyes sprul pa'i sku yin la/ de nyid 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes dngos yin/ de nyid 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes dngos yin snyam du dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar lū hi pa'i don 'grel na dngos su gsal bar gsungs shing / nag dril gnyis la brjod pa gsum la dran pa gsum gyi skabs su bsre/ rnal 'byor ma la ye shes pa zhugs pa dang 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis kyi bar skabs su bsre'o/ /rdzogs rim la pho nya gsum bsre ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de ni pho nya legs 'dres pas/ /sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob/ /ces so/ /'di la rje btsun rin po ches don 'gyur du mdzad nas/ pho nya rnam gsum legs 'dres pas/ /sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs la/ pho nya gsum ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rnal 'byor ma ni rnam gsum ste/ /zhing sngags lhan cig skyes rang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i don la gnyan phul chung bas/

las kyi phyag rgya'i rdzogs rim la pho nya bsre bar bshad do/ /des na ma mtha' dbang dang bskyed rim la bsre/ ya mtha' pho nya'i nyams len la bsre/ bar pa chos kyi phyag rgya la bsre ba skabs thob yin no/ /de lta bu'i gdam ngag gi sgo nas rang rgyud la yi dam lha'i byin rlabs bsdus te bsgom pas yi dam lha'i byin rlabs myur du 'jug cing de la brten nas ting nge 'dzin myur du skye zhing / sa lam yang myur du bgrod pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyi 'jug par byed/ /ces dang / sems can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /nga ni de ru rtag tu gnas/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i pho nya gsum bsres kyi sgo nas shin tu zab bo/ /'o na gsang mtha'i lam rim la/ lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bzhi yod pa 'di bzhi'i zab khyad ji ltar yin zhes na/ kha cig na re/ nag po pa mi zab ste/ ma mo bcu gnyis phyag la bkod pa'i lus dkyil bsgom pas/ sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i thob skal med pa'i phyir/ lū hi pa de bas sgra tshul gyi sgo nas zab la/ dril bu pa la ma mo bcu gnyis snying kha'i phyi bskor nang bskor la bkod pas/ sa bcu gsum gyi thob skal tshang ma yod pa'i phyir zab ces zer mod/ de ni ma dag pa yin te/ nag po pa la'ang phyi nang gi sgra tshul yod cing / sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i thob skal gyi lus dkyil gyi thob skal yod pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ dang po ni/ dkyil chog las/ sgra yi tshul la nges 'byung zhing / /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul can/ /zhes gsungs la/ rje btsun gyis zab mo lus dkyil sgra tshul las bskyed par bshad cing / gnyan dang nub pa gnyis kyi ṭīk+ka las/ paṇ+ḍi ta bgres po rnams mngal skyes 'di la yang lū hi pa rtsa rkyang ltar rten gzhal yas khang dang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis cig car du bskyed par mdzad ces phyi'i sgra tshul bshad pas so/

/de bzhin du sdom pa bshad pa las/ 'dren pa'i steng du kha babs pa/ /rgya dang ldan pa'i ri bo gzugs/ /ral pa'i rtsa bar gnas par bshad/ /sna tshogs sems can don byed pa'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa/ /drug ldan pa yis gnas grub pa/ /bdun pa dang ni nyi ma yis/ /dkyil 'khor steng du 'gro dang 'ong / /ā l̥ kā l̥ ldan pa yi/ /hūm̐ ni dngos po'i rten can no/ /zhes nang sgra tshul ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa yang grub ste/ ma mo bcu gnyis snying kha'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug la bkod pa'i nag po ṭīka chung yod pa dang / ma mo bcu gnyis phyag la bkod pa'i ṭīka chung yang yod/ gnyis ka la ma bkod pa'i nag po ṭīka chung yang yod la/ sa skya pa'i dgongs pa ni/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun lus la bkod pa yin te/ dpyid dang thun mong ba'i sngags rim las/ phyi he ru ka yab yum la nang lha sum cu rtsa bdun rang yin snyam du bsgom/ zhes gsungs la/ bshad sbyar las/ go cha chen po lha sum cu rtsa bdun lus la bkod la zhes gsungs so/ /bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi dpa' bo'i go cha dang / dpa' mo'i go cha ni phyi'i he ru ka la bkod pa yin la/ go cha chen po'i skabs su sngar gyi lus dkyil gsal btab pa'am/ yang na lus dkyil gyi lha rnams zhu nas rtsa khams ro gcig tu 'dres pas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom pa'o/ /dpyid kyi thig le'i le'u dang por/ rang gi phung khams skye mched kyi lha bcu bdun bstan/ de nas gnyis pa man chad kyis rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me la sogs pa'i rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa rtsa so bdun lha so bdun gyi ngo bor bstan cing / mdor na lus dkyil lha tshang ma bstan la/ gnyan gyi snying kha'i rtsa bcu drug po ma mo bcu gnyis so zhes bshad do/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bud med rtsa las ngos 'byung zhing / /gang yin bcu drug rtsa las skyes/

/zhes pa'i gong mchan du/ snying kha'i rtsa bcu drug la bud med bcu gnyis bsgom par bshad do/ /de'ang mkha' 'gro ma la 'dab ma gnyis/ gshin rje 'joms ma la gnyis so/ /rtsa bcu drug po 'di sam+bu ṭi las lte bar sbyar te bshad/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor mgrin pa la bshad do/ /dkyil chog gi gzhung las/ grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnam bzhi/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa'i gong mchan du/ snying kha'i lte ba'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rnal 'byor ma bzhi bsgom par bshad/ a bhi dha na las/ snying kha'i ye shes 'khor lo las/ /kha gdong la sogs yongs bskor te/ /rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor byas te/ /dur khrod dang ni nye dur khrod/ /ces snying kha la bsgom par bshad/ yang dpyid thig tu/ gong gi ngag ldan sgo ma ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rtsa yi sgo ru bya gdong ma/ /de ma thag tu 'ug gdong ma/ /grwa ru gshin rje rten ma 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i thad du sa chen gyis rnal 'byor ma bzhi snying kha'i phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi la bkod nas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad sna bug gnyis phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i bug pa brgyad la bsgom par bshad do/ /gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las/ spyi bor yang dag byung ba ni/ /rtsa ni spyi bor skyes zhes brjod/ /rnal 'byor ma rtsa sum cu drug /zhes gsungs pas spyi bo'i nang bskor la rtsa 'dab bzhi/ phyi bskor la so gnyis/ de la ro rkyang kun 'dar ma gsum khyab byed yin pas logs su mi bgrangs/ nyer bzhi rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi'i ngo bor yin pas yul nyer bzhi la zug lhag ma lnga ni/ 'khrig ma dang / 'khris gzugs ma dang / bdud rtsi'i bu mo dang / 'dul bral ma dang / gtum mo'o/ /dang po la rtse mo gnyis su gyes pa mig g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa la re re ste/ de la rim bzhin gshin rje brtan ma dang pho nya ma gnyis 'god/ gnyis pa la rtse mo gnyis rna ba g.yas g.yon du zug pa la gshin rje mche ba ma dang 'joms ma'o/

/gsum pa sna bug la zug pa la 'ug gdong ma'o/ /bzhi pa khwa la khwa gdong ma'o/ /lnga pa la rtse mo gnyis gyes pa'i gcig gsang gnas la phag gdong ma'o/ /gcig gshang lam la zug pa la khyi gdong ma'o/ /de bzhin du rim bzhi lam bslong las bshad la/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las kyang / snying khar grags pa ji ltar gsungs/ /sgo dgur ji ltar 'byung ba 'o/ /mig la sogs pa'i sbub rnams nas/ /yul la sogs par 'jug par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar bug pa la bkod pa dang / snying kha la bkod pa gnyis rtsa rtse'i khyad par ma gtogs don gcig pa yin te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo skal ba bzang / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de ltar 'dab ma las skyes pas/ /rnam shes brgyad ni kun rdzob pa/ /zhes so/ /snying kha'i phyi bskor 'dab brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa yin la/ rtse mo mig la sogs pa'i bug pa rnams la zug par bdag med bstod 'grel du bshad la/ rje btsun gyi ma mo brgyad ni snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la 'god ces bshad la/ dkar gyi thung spyod dang nye ba'i thung spyod ni snying kha'i phyi bskor du bug pa brgyad la'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje btsun gyi bde mchog dang kyai rdor gnyis rtsa ba'i rtsa rtse'i khyad par las med de/ bde mchog las bol la sin+dhu zer/ kyai rdor ba mig la sin+dhu zer ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar byas na ma mo bcu gnyis phyag la ma bkod pa'i ṭīka chung la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / dpyid thig dang / gnyan gyi sgrub thabs kyi gzhung dang / lam bslong dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang 'phags pa rnams kyis bshad pa ltar gyis gdam ngag sbyar nas ma mo snying kha la bkod pa'i lugs kyi ṭīk+ka chung ngur 'gyur la/ yang gzhung de nyid la/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ru ka dpal yang dag sbyor/ /zhes dang bla ma las/ glang chen ma rtogs 'khyud ma rtogs/ /ma mo brgyad po rnams kyis thabs/

/zhes dang / sbyin sreg gi gzhung dang / sdom pa bshad pa dang / bshad sbyar dang / sa skya pa'i sbyin sreg dang / 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar khyad chos sbyar na/ ma mo phyag la bkod pa'i ṭīka chung du 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di la phyi gzhal yas khang dang / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa cig car du bskyed/ snyoms par zhugs pa las thig le'i gong bur zhu/ de glus bskul te 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha mngal du bskyed la phyir spros/ nang sgra tshul gyi rten 'brel las lus dkyil bskyed/ ma mo phyag la bkod/ gtso bo'i zhal dang phyag mtshan lū hi pa bzhin dang / 'khor yang phyag bzhi par bskyed/ de'i tshe sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa thob skal nang sgra tshul gyis chod de/ spyi bo na gnas pa'i rtsa so drug rnal 'byor ma so drug gi ngo bor ri rab kyi steng gi pad+ma yin la/ nang gi khams so bdun dpa' bo'i ngo bo nyi zla bskyed pa'i dbyangs gsal lo/ /klad pa dang klad khyims ni nyi zla'o/ /nang sgra tshul las lus dkyil bskyed kyang / ma mo phyag la bkod pa'i khyab pa med de/ klad pa dkar po zla ba klad khyim dmar po nyi ma zhes pa'i man ngag sngon chad ma mo rnams snying kha'am/ bug pa brgyad la 'god de/ de ltar du dmar chos kyi rgyal pos bshad do/ /spu hrang mar do ba ni rnal 'byor ma bzhi snying kha'i phyogs bzhi la sgo mtshams ma bug pa la 'god par bshad/ dpal ldan a de shas zhe sdang med pa gtso bo yab yum spyi bo dang gnas su/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi 'khor ba bar pa gsum la/ sgo mtshams brgyad bug pa la 'god pa'i lus dkyil yang 'dug go /rang lugs kyi zab khyad la/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i gsung gis/ sbyang gzhi la gnad du bsnun tshul gyi sgo nas zab khyad 'don gyi/ lha grangs kyi sgo nas ma yin no/ /nag po pa ni phyi rtog rtags sems la gnad du bsnun/

nang zab mo'i lus la zhar byung gi tshul gyis gnad du bsnun pas mi zab pa yin te/ sa skya pa chen pos 'di ni phyi gtso bo/ nang zhar byung gi tshul gyis bsgom zhes gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gis phyi bskyed rim rtog rtags sems la gnad du bsnun pas mi zab la/ lus dkyil ni lus la gnad du bsnun pas zab pa yin gsungs/ lū hi pa ni phyi nang gnyis la cha mnyam du gnad du bsnun pas 'bring / dril bu pa ni phyi'i spros pa thams cad sangs bcad nas/ nang 'ba' zhig la gnad du bsnun pas shin du zab pa yin cing / nā ro mkha' spyod dbang bzhi'i don thams cad bskyed rim gyi steng du tshang bar nyams su len pas zab don mthar thug pa yin te/ rdo rje 'chang gis dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam/ /thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas/ /sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug bde ba'i sku/ /mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpa' bo thams cad zla ba'i dkyil/ dpa' mo thams cad sngags 'bras bu'i rnam par bsgom pa yin gsungs so/ /zab khyad de dang ldan pa'i lam rim 'di nyams su len pa la/ yid ches rnam pa bzhi skye dgos te/ bla ma la yid ches pa dang / rang gi nyams myong la yid ches pa dang / bstan bcos la yid ches pa dang / lung la yid ches pa'o/ /dang po la bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar nyan pa'i sgo nas mos gus bsgom pa ste/ de la ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul ni/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ bla ma zhang bya ru bas mdzad pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa rnams so/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rnam thar ni ston pa rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis rnam thar las logs su mi 'byung ste rdo rje 'chang gi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i phyir/ bram ze chen po man chad la grub chen lū hi pa'i rnam thar gnyan bsod nams rdo rje'i 'bru 'bum na bzhugs/

dril bu pa'i rnam thar rje btsun rtse mo'i sgrub thabs na bzhugs/ nag po pa'i rnam thar bshad sbyar na bzhugs/ mal lo yan chad brgyud pa thams cad kyi rnam thar phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyis mdzad pa 'di'i lung rgyun yod/ gzhan nub pa rigs 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa/ dmar chos rgyal bas mdzad pa/ 'bring 'tshams kyi lha rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rnams yod do/ /nyams myong tshad ma ni/ bla ma de rnams kyis gdam ngag nyams su blangs pas rang rgyud la skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin no/ /bstan bcos la yid ches pa ni/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de grub chen lū nag dril gsum gyi gzhung dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa'o/ /de'ang bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa mdzad pa la lung tshad ma'i chos bskor ro/ /de la ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul la bzhi ste/ he ru ka ji ltar byon pa'i tshul/ des rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ 'grel byed gzhan gyis ji ltar bkral ba'i tshul/ bye brag snying por gyur pa'i lam srol ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i byon tshul dang / ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mdo sde bskal bzang las/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar nged rang gi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid kyis dang po bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyis byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyis tshogs rgya chen po bsags te/ mthar srod la lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ tho rangs nges don la 'og min du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/

gdul bya sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don mdzad/ drang don du 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya'i sku sprul nas/ yul wa ra na si la sogs par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa de bsdu na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ de yang sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'dus te/ ji srid mdo zhes dang / spyod lam la sogs bye brag chos/ /zhes sogs kyi don yin no/ /gnyis pa ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul la gsum ste/ dus nam byon/ gnas gang du byon/ tshul ji ltar byon pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi nang du ni/ /bcom ldan mtha' yas pas 'di gsungs/ shākya seng ges gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor pha rol cher son pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas rtsod pa'i dus su byon no/ /gnyis pa ni bla ma zhang bya ru bas gsungs pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling dbus drang por bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas/ de'i phyi bskor brgyad la pu la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du ka la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad/ de'i phyi bskor du pre la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad/ de'i phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod brgyad chags zhes bshad/ lus dkyil 'god tshul dang bstun na/ ma mo nang gi dur khrod du bsgom pa dang mthun pas shin tu legs gsungs/ rje btsun rin po ches gsung gis/ ri rab kyi rtser bde chen lha bcu gsum gyi gnas dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs mtshams rnams su yul nyer bzhi gdod ma nas gnas gsungs te/ ma mo snying kha la bkod pa dang mthun no/ /gsum pa tshul ji ltar byon pa la gsum/ gdul bya dbang phyug gi byung tshul/ 'dul byed he ru ka'i byon tshul/ des de ji ltar brtul tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed gnyis kyang brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal he ru kar dbyer med de/

kha sbyor las/ khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par sprul/ /zhes so/ /brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal he ru kas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang nyid sprul/ des drag po dbang phyug chen po sprul te/ ri rab kyi rtser drag po dbang phyug mdog nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa sku la thal bas byugs pa/ yum lha mo u ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i sprul pa la drag po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa byung ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa la la/ sku yi sprul pa tshangs pa che/ /gsung gi sprul pa dbang phyug ste/ /thugs kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug go /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang phyug gi yon tan nga rgyal dang ser sna yin la/ de'i sprul pa ser sna shas che ba'i mun pa dang / nye ba'i mun pa/ sgra gcan dang / nye ba'i sgra gcan bzhi'o/ /'phrin las phrag dog gi sprul pa la mi'am ci'i bu mo brgyad de bcu gsum ri rab kyi rtse mor byung / thugs kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug de'i sprul pa mkha' spyod kyi 'jigs byed chen po brgyad ni/ steng nam mkha'i phyogs nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i dpon po bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa byung ste thugs 'khor gyi phyogs kyi gnas bzhi bzung / de la lha'i skad du gnas zhes ming btags so/ /yang lha'i g.yog po bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas mtshams kyi gnas bzhi bzung / 'di rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi lha yin pas/ dri za'i skad du nye ba'i gnas zhes ming btags/ byang phyogs nas gnod sbyin gyi dpon po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung ste/ gsung 'khor gyi gnas shar dang byang bzung / kho rang gi skad du zhing zhes ming btags/ g.yog po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas nub dang lho bzung ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /srin po'i dpon po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas byang shar dang shar lho bzung /

kho rang gi skad du tshan+dho zhes pa'i ming btags/ g.yog po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas lho nub dang nub byang bzung / kho rang gi skad du nye ba'i tshan+dho zhes ming btags/ 'di chags can dbang phyug gi sprul pa/ sa steng nas 'ong nas sa steng du spyod par byed pa/ sa spyod kyi 'jigs byed chen po brgyad ces bya'o/ /gti mug can tshangs pa'i sprul pa sa 'og gi 'jigs byed chen po brgyad de/ rgya mtsho'i nang nas klu'i dpon po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa dang / g.yog po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas rim pa bzhin sku 'khor gyi gnas phyogs bzhi bzung / rang skad du 'dul ba dang nye ba'i 'dul ba zhes ming btags so/ /yang ri rab kyi khong seng nas lha ma yin gyi dpon po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa dang g.yog po gnyis chung ma dang bcas pa byung nas mtshams bzhi bzung / rang skad du dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod ces ming btags so/ /de dag kyang thugs kyi brgyad zhe sdang can drag po'i nyams dang ldan la/ gsung gi brgyad 'dod chags can chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sku'i brgyad ni gti mug can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa ste/ a bhi dha na las/ thugs kyi 'khor lo drag po ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo bskyed pa'i zhal/ sku yi 'khor lo zhi ba 'o/ /zhes dang / thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog gnag /rnal 'byor ma ni dmar mo ste/ /rdo rje dril bus lus la 'khyud/ /zhe sdang gis khyab mngon par mtho/ /gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar/ /rnal 'byor ma ni dkar mo ste/ /pad+ma dril bus lus la 'khyud/ /'dod chags kyis khyab mngon par mtho/ /sku yi 'khor lo dpa' bo ni/ /btso ma'i gser 'dra mkha' 'gro dkar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i drag po rnams la 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par bla ma zhang bya ru bas bshad pas/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye dgu rnams la ma rung par byas/

mi bsad pa'i sha dron mo bza'/ khrag dron mo 'thung / skra la mchod phyir thogs dang tshangs skud byas rus pa la rgyan drug byas te lus la btags so/ /de lta bu'i drag po dbang phyug rnams gcig 'og tu gcig mi 'du bar spyi'i dpon gcig dgos par 'cham ste/ ri rab kyi rtse mo na yod pa'i drag po dbang phyug chen po la dpon bcol/ yul du gdan drangs pas dbang phyug na re/ nga dus rtag tu lha mo u ma dang mnyam par sbyor dgos/ thun mtshams su nye ba'i yum bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor bar byed pas 'ong long med gsungs nas/ rdo la byas pa'i liṅga nyi shu rtsa bzhi bskur ro/ /de rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi yul du 'khyer nas sha khrag gi mchod sbyin byas te skye dgu thams cad ma rung par byas so/ /gnyis pa ni ston pa he ru kas dgongs pa sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen te/ de yang rnal 'byor ma snying po'i rgyud las/ 'dul bya'i ming ni 'dul byed la btags 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya'i ming dang kha dog dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa de kho na 'dra ba'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sprul te brtul lo/ /gsum pa ni/ longs spyod pa dang / thim pa dang / dbang du byas pa gsum gyi tshul gyis brtul te/ kha zas sha khrag dron mo rnams 'phrogs nas tshogs 'khor du byin gyis brlabs te longs spyod pas dpal ldan khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhes ming thogs so/ /rgyan cha rnams 'phrogs nas rgyan cha dang / lag cha rnams 'phrogs nas lag char longs spyod/ thim pa ni rnam par shes pa la mi bskyod pa'i zhing du thim zhing bsgral te ma 'ongs pa'i dus thal bas g.yog pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su/ thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par sangs rgyas par lung bstan no/ /dbang du bya ba ni bsad pa'i ro rnams bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas kyi gdan du bting pa'o/

/de la'ang dbang phyug yab yum bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi gdan du byas/ mun pa la sogs pa bzhi rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i gdan du/ 'jigs byed pho mo nyer bzhi thugs gsung sku'i gdan du/ mi'am ci'i bu mo brgyad ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gdan du byas te/ a bhi dha na las/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha rnams ni/ /thams cad ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /mar do ba rnams ni gsang mtha'i zab khyad dang ldan pa'i he ru ka'i byon tshul gcig dgos te/ rgyud lha gnas gsum pa zhes bya ba 'og min du byang chub sems dpa'i 'gro ba rnams la gsungs/ ri rab kyi rtser lha'i 'gro ba rnams la gsungs/ 'dzam bu'i gling du mi'i 'gro ba pa rnams la gsungs so/ /bsdu ba'i tshe 'dzam bu gling gi bde chen lha lnga ri rab kyi de la bsdu/ de 'og min du bsdu'o/ /'di ni pho nya gsum bsres mtshon pa yin pas shin tu legs gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i gdul bya 'dul byed kyi rnam 'phrul 'di ni spang bya dang gnyen po'i gleng gzhi yin pas/ spang gnyen ro gcig pa'i nyams len mtshon no/ /de yang dbang phyug yab yum gyis rtag chad kyi lta ba mtshon no/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis lta ngan drug cu rtsa gnyis mtshon/ 'khor yang sprul dang nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas ni lta ngan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshon/ skye dgu ma rung par byas pas na lta ngan de rnams las nyon mongs/ de las rigs drug gi sdug bsngal yun ring la dos drag pa myong dgos pa mtshon no/ /de thams cad kyang bsdu na drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'du/ de'ang rtag chad gnyis su 'dus te/ dbang phyug rtag lta u ma chad lta'o/ /de dag gi gnyen po la gnyis med kyi ye shes drug cu rtsa gnyis mtshon pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis so/ /de yang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems su ma 'dus pa med de/ thabs snying rje yab/ stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yum yin no/

/de dag ni drangs don gyi bshad pa yin la/ nang sbas don la sbyar te bshad na/ de lta bu'i gdul bya 'dul byed kyi rnam 'phrul 'di rnams sems la bag chags kyi tshul gyis tshang / sems la tshang tshad lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul gyis dod de/ de'ang rtsa so bdun yi ge so bdun/ rlung so bdun/ byang chub kyi sems so bdun gyi rnam par gnas/ de'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol du gdul bya dang 'dul byed kyi snang ba shar ba'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ji ltar gsungs ba'i tshul la/ rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u 'bum pa/ 'bring po tshig 'bum pa/ bsdus pa yi ge 'bum pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi bdag nyid can de rtsa rgyud gsum dang / bshad pa'i rgyud so gnyis/ yan lag gi rgyud grangs med pa gsungs so/ /zhes rje btsun gyis gsungs/ gsum pa ni rtsa rgyud 'di la rgya gar gyi 'grel pa bcu gnyis tsam yod de/ phyag na rdo rjes stod kyi 'grel pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra dbang po 'byung po'i bo dhis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bha wa bha dra'i rang bzhin bzang po 'grel pa/ kong ka na rgyal ba bzang po'i 'grel pa/ de'i 'grel bshad skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa/ de'i bshad sbyar de bzhin gshegs pa'i srung ba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ yang dag rgyal bzang gi 'grel pa/ la ba pa dang / lha sbas dang / mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta mdzes pa su ma ti kirtis blo gros grags pa mdzad pa'i 'grel pa nyung ngu'i mtshams sbyor zhes pa 'di ni rnal 'byor gsang mtha' la med mi rung gi yan lag yin no/ /mdzad pa ste 'grel pa rnam dag de tsam mo/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ gru gzings/ sdom 'byung la bal po mañju shrīs 'jam dpal mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la slob dpon brgya byin gdong gis mdzad pa/

he ru ka mngon 'byung la ku ma ra tsan+d+ras gzhon nu zla ba mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la nor bzang dang bha wa bha dras rin chen bzang po mdzad pa/ kun spyod la paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa/ bstan pa'i ye shes grags pa mṛ rtis 'grel pa/ kha sbyor la in+d+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ a bhi dha na la dz+nyā na badz+ra ye shes rdo rje dang / shu rang ka warmas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rnams yod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bzhi po ni gsang mtha' rtsa bshad kyi snying por gyur pa'i lam rim yin no/ /'di man chad bde mchog gi chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod bcas pa'i lam rim nyams len gyi gnad dang shin tu 'brel ba zhig 'dug pas bris pa yin no/ /'di nyams su len pa la dpal nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa la brten pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang / bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i cho ga gnyis gcig tu bsres pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /nag po dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas sbyin bya bzhi sbyin te/ de'ang ye shes pa 'bebs theng gsum gyi sgo nas pho nya gsum legs par 'dres pa'i dbang bskur gcig byung na gsang mtha'i dbang gi go chod de/ de las gzhan pa'i dbang gis ni 'di'i dbang gi go mi chod de/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rgyud gzhan du ni dbang bskur la/ /tshul 'di bstan par mi bya 'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang dang 'brel pa'i dam tshig thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sum cu tham pa la gnas dgos la/ thun mong ma yin pa brgyad ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u nyer drug pa las/ lha mo gzhan dang kun sbyor ma/ /'dod la chags par 'gyur 'gro ba/ /mi g.yo bdag gzhan gnyis med ma/ /gnyis su med dang thogs pa med/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa nyid/ /bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyor/

/tshangs spyod de bzhin bsam gtan gnas/ /khro med rgyun gyis kun tu spyod/ /'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin/ /zhes so/ /de rnams kyi don ni rim pa bzhin/ rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i rig ma ste/ mi bskyod pa la g.yung mo dang / rnam snang la bram ze ma la sogs pa'i lha mo spangs nas/ gzhan rigs dang mi mthun pa'i lha mo bsten na ltung ba dang po'o/ /brten pa de'ang sbyor ba 'du shes gsum ldan la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas can gyis bsten par bya yi/ tha mal gyi 'dod chags kyis bsten na gnyis par 'gyur ro/ /mi g.yo ba ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la mi g.yo bas/ bdag gzhan gnyis med du stong stong pa'i de kho na nyid dang bral bas bsten na dam tshig nyams la/ rigs mi mthun gyi phyag rgya mi bsten pa dang / tha mal 'dod chags kyis mi g.yo ba gnyis kyang bzung ngo / /bdag gzhan gnyis med pa ni/ bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i byang chub kyi sems kun nas bsten pa'o/ /gnyis su med dang thogs pa med ni/ phyag rgya bsten pa'i tshe rgyal rigs mo la sogs pa ni rigs bzang / gdol pa mo la sogs pa ni rigs ngan snyam pa'i bzang dang dgag bsgrub kyi blo spangs nas thogs med du bsten pa'o/ /dam tshig spyad pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i dus kyis dam tshig bde stong gi ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir du spyod pa'o/ /bud med dbang phyug ni ma dang sring mo la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bsten pa'o/ /tshangs spyod ni sbyor ba dbab ldog khyab gsum la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas byang sems phyi ma mi 'dzag par bsten par bya'o/ /khro med rgyun du ni phyag rgya la khong khro ba med par phan tshun byams brtse dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsten par bya ba yin no/ /dam tshig thun mong ma yin pa brgyad po 'di la gsang mtha'i rnal 'byor pas rnam pa kun du spyod dgos par bstan to/ /gzhi dam tshig de rnams la gnas/

lam nyams su len pa'i thog mar lta bas rgyud sbyangs te/ lta ba'i sgo nas 'khor gyi mtha' spros bral du gtan la phab/ de'i don la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa la lta ba zhes pa'i ming btags so/ /lta bas gtan la phab tshad bskyed rim gyi sgo nas lhar bsgom mo/ /lhar bsgom tshad rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas ye shes su bsgyur/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la brten nas sku dang ye shes zung du chud pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang du 'gro bar byed do/ /de la lta ba bsgom tshul/ 'khrul spong las/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sku dang ye shes su zung du chud pa'i ye shes yin te/ de'ang snang cha thams cad lha so so'i ngo bor rnam par dag stong cha thams cad de bzhin nyid du rnam par dag pa la dag par shes shing bsgom na dam tshig tu 'gyur ro/ /de la the tshom pas phyin ci log tu bzung na ltung ba dgu par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin nyid de ni gang du yang ma grub pa'i zung 'jug spros bral yin la/ de ltar shes na dam tshig tu 'gyur zhing / de la ming dang mtshan ma sna tshogs su bzung na rtsa ltung bcu gcig par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad zung 'jug brjod bral ngo bo'i sgo nas cir yang ma grub pa/ snang tshul gyi sgo nas cir yang snang ba/ rkyen gyi sgo nas gang 'dod du bsgyur du rung ba/ brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyun chags pa 'di ni mdo rgyud thams cad kyi rtogs bya'i lta ba yin la/ 'di la mtshan gyi rnam grangs bde gshegs snying po/ rang bzhin rnam dag gnyis med kyi ye shes/ sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang / 'khor lo bde mchog dus kyi 'khor lo/ kyai rdo rje la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gdags te/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang ltar snang /

/gang zhig drug pa zhes bya'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /gcig pu nyid ni du mas gar mdzad do/ /zhes so/ /'dis ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtogs bya'i lta ba bstan te/ zhes rje btsun gsungs/ 'di'i don la shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po yin la/ 'di'i steng na thog ma med pa nas las kyi bag chags tshad med pa gcig yod la/ de nyid kyi kun gzhi dkrugs slad 'khrul du bcug pa la brten nas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad shar te/ 'di thams cad kun gzhi bag chags kyi bsgyur ba'i gar yin la/ kun gzhi nyid kyis bris pa'i ri mo yin no/ /de yang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa/ sems 'di ni gar mkhan dang 'dra ste/ las kyis bsgyur ba'i cha lugs sna tshogs bzung nas khams gsum thams cad du gar bsgyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dper na mi gcig gis gos dang 'bag sna tshogs gyon/ yul sna tshogs su phyin nas gar sna tshogs bsgyur ba'i tshe/ yul che ge mo'i gar mkhan sngon po de zhes pa la sogs pa'i ming 'dogs pa bzhin no/ /sems 'di ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra ste/ khams gsum gyi ras gzhi la las dkar la sogs pa'i sna tshogs pa'i tshon blangs te rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi pir gyis bris pas so/ /sems ni spre'u dang 'dra ste bya rtsol mang bas so/ /sems ni phyug po dang 'dra ste las kyi bag chags sna tshogs bsog par byed pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sna tshogs su shar yang sna tshogs pa'i dus nyid nas zung 'jug brjod bral yin pa la 'gyur ba med de/ rtsa sher/ ji ltar sngar de phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes dang / kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/ /ces 'gro ba snod bcud thams cad rnam snang la sogs pa sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid yin no/ /mdor na shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad byung yang zung 'jug las byung /

thim pa'i tshe yang zung 'jug la thim pa yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ byung yang stong pa nyid las byung / /stong pa'i ngang du thams cad thim/ /zhes so/ /sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral gyis ma khyab pa'i shes bya yod na 'di'i khyab pa'i chos nyid ma yin par 'gyur zhing / des na phyi don bden grub tu 'gyur la/ de lta bu ni gtan mi srid de/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral te/ ngo bo nyid la dri mas ma gos pa/ 'khor 'das gang gi phyogs su yang ma lhung ba shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bu gcig yin te/ sdom 'byung las/ shel dang mtshungs pa dag pa'i sems/ /sems la skyon dang yon tan med/ /yul rnams dang ni 'phrad pa na/ /srid pa'i skyon gyis gos pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gang du'ang ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gang du'ang bsgyur du rung ba yin te/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /gang la stong nyid mi rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rkyen gyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i chos sna tshogs su shar te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ ye shes de nyid rnam par 'phrul/ /mi min mi min mchog mi min/ /gnod sbyin lha min grub pa dang / /mi dang yi dwags mkha' 'gro ma/ /klu dang dud 'gro gsang ba dang / /mi 'am ci dang lto phye che/ /dmyal ba la sogs 'gro ba dang / /lus ngan po yi ming can dang / /me dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /de yi sa yi khams nyid dang / /brten pa la sogs thams cad dang / /phra mo sgo nga 'dzin pa dang / /'dab ma sbur ma phra mo dang / /sa bon dang ni rdo brag ri/ /thams cad ye shes byin rlabs pas/ /'ga' yang ye shes med pa min/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ 'gro ba brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag /'di nyid las ni thams cad 'byung / /zhes so/ /yang lam gyi chos thams cad kyang 'di las 'byung ste/ kun spyod las/

'dug dang ldang ba nyid dang ni/ /'jug dang rdzogs pa nyid dag dang / /byin gyis brlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /ting 'dzin mchod pa nye bar bsdu/ /zhes dang / slob dpon bha wa bha dras/ bcom ldan 'das gcig pu nyid gar mkhan ltar bsgrub pa dang / dngos grub la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin 'dzin par mdzad/ ces so/ /'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyang 'di las 'byung ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas thub pa che/ /kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /thams cad spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos sogs/ /'di nyid las ni yang dag byung / /zhes bshad do/ /sems kun gzhi rkyen gyi dbang gis rgyud gsum du shar tshul lo/ /blo'i rtog pa la de ltar shar kyang / yin lugs rgyud gsum po thams cad brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal he ru kar dbyer mi phyed de/ khams gsum ro gcig 'gyur nas ni/ /zhes dang / mnga' bdag mai tri pas bde mchog bstod pa las kyang / dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso/ /thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ma na ka shrīs dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs las/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang gi lus la bsdus/ /lus yang sems la bsdus/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug tu shig nas bsgom par bshad de/ 'di la rje btsun rtse mos/ bde gshegs snying po las rnam rtog byung / rnam rtog snang ba sna tshogs su shar zhes bshad la/ rje btsun rin po ches/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sems la bag chags kyi tshul gyis tshang / sems la tshang tshad lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul gyis dod/ lus la dod tshang tshad kyis phyi rol snod bcud kyi snang bar shar/

phyi rol na yod tshad lus la smin/ lus la smin tshad sems la tshang / de ltar nang gi stobs kyis phyi shar/ phyi'i stobs kyis nang bslad/ phyi nang gnyis kas lus sems rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas yin pa de dri ma can du byas pa yin no zhes gsungs te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ sems can rnams ni bag chags skyen/ /phyi rol du ni sprin mthong 'gyur/ /bag chags zad pa'i dus su ni/ /sprin dang klu rnams mthong ba med/ /ces dang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ sngon gyi bag chags nang gnas pa/ /de tshe dbang po rab tu gsal/ /de yi de ni rab tu bsad/ /de rnams rtsa la rang bzhin gnas/ /zhes dang / kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud ye shes snying po las/ phyi dang phyi'i don rnams kyis nang dang nang gi don gnas par shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ phyi dang nang gnyis dbyer med gcig tu shes par bya/ dbang po 'khrul pa'ang bde ba chen por mos par gyis zhes so/ /de ltar brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag po dpal he ru kas shes bya thams cad la khyab pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa las/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing / /kun tu mig dang mgo bo'i zhal/ /kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten du/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pas brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang / g.yo ba bcud gyis sems can gnyis/ dang po khams gsum du ma 'dus pa med pa dang / sa bla'i 'jig rten dum bu brgyad du btang pa la thugs 'khor gyi gnas kyis khyab/ sa steng dum bu brgyad du btang pa la gsung 'khor gyis khyab/ sa 'og la sku 'khor sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis tsha dmyal dang grang dmyal brgyad la khyab ste/ tsha grang gnyis 'tshogs pa mtshon pas gdong brnyan dang phyed gzugs so/ /de'ang rtsa rgyud lnga bcu pa las/ mtho ris sa steng sa 'og tu/

/dpa' bo'i yan lag brtan g.yo'i bdag /pu la pu li sogs pa gang brtan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /zhes pa ltar phyi'i lus rags pa la brtan pa snod du bzhag nang rtsa la g.yo ba bcud du bzhag go /yang rtsa la brtan pa dang / de'i nang gi khams la g.yo ba/ yang khams la brtan pa dang / rlung la g.yo ba/ rlung la brtan pa dang / sems la g.yo ba'i bcud kyi sems can du bzhag pa'o/ /de dag kun la brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis khyab bo/ /brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag po dpal he ru ka rgyud gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i bdag nyid 'di rtogs bya'i lta ba yin no/ /'tshang rgya ba la 'di rtogs dgos la/ de'ang rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas rtogs bya rtogs byed kyi spros pa thams cad dang bral bas rtogs rgyu med la/ lus la lam gyis gnad du bsnun pa las byung ba'i rdzogs rim zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rtogs/ rdzogs rim 'ong ba bskyed pa'i rim pa la rag las pa yin te/ bskyed rim gyi sgo nas rang gi lus 'di 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig tu song / de la 'ja' lus kyi chas su gyur pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum ste/ de la rdzogs rim zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ des sngar gyi gnas lugs la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pas ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs so/ /de lta bu'i rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin de yang lus sems rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i rgyu rgyud kyi byin rlabs la brten nas skye/ skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lus sems tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa bsregs/ sku dang ye shes gnyis su rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas su 'gro ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs pa yis/ /dges pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /zhes dang / sdud pa lus kyang /

rtsa dang shing la me byung bas ni de nyid bsregs/ /ces so/ /rje btsun rtse mos sam+bu ṭa'i gnad kyi gsal byed las kyang / rgyu'i rgyud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba ni smin grol gyi ting nge 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ dbang bskur ba nas bzung nas bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bar ro/ /gnas pa dang g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can/ de thams cad kyang rang gi ngo bo ma grub pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis de thams cad kyi kha dog bsgyur zhes pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs te mthar dri ma dag pa na sku dang ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /dri ma spong tshul la bskyed rdzogs kyi ngang du bsgyur nas bsgom pas/ spang bya sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sku dang ye shes su gnas gyur pa yin no/ /rje btsun gyis dri ma sems kyi gnas lugs la zhugs pas sems las logs su spang rgyu med ces so/ /sa skya pa chen pos nag po sbyin sreg tu/ dri ma snyug ma sems kyi rang bzhin du thim zhing / dengs pa la dri ma spang zhes ming btags zhes so/ /mdor na gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad ro gcig pa'i bdag nyid chos sku de bzhin nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i zung 'jug 'di ni bsgom bya'i 'khor lo bde mchog yin no/ /bsgom byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa gang bsgom na/ spyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod mod/ da lan mngal sgong gi mngon par rtogs pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bsgom ste/ a bhi dha na las/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam par brtag /sgong skyes glu ni med pa yis/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mngal sgong gi mngon par rtogs pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bsgoms pa las mngal skyes gtso bor nag po pa dang / sgong skyes lū hi pa'i phyogs la sbyor mod/ mngal skyes 'di la yang lū hi pa lta bu'i bskyed chog sbyar ba gcig dang /

nag po rtsa rkyang gi mngon rtogs gnyis su yod de/ bshad sbyar las mngon rtogs mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs te/ bsnyen pa'i thad du/ gnas dang ldang bar byed pa dang / /'jug dang rdzogs pa nyid dag dang / /byin gyis rlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /ting 'dzin mchod pa nye bar bsdu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thad du/ gnas pas ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsog pa bstan/ ldang bas ni 'byung bzhi ri rab dang gzhal yas khang du ldang ba bstan/ 'jug pa ni mngon byang lnga bsgom pa la 'jug la/ rdzogs pas ni go cha yan chad bstan/ byin gyis brlab pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur ba ni dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab dang bcas pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin dang rdzogs rim bsgom pa'o/ /mchod pa ni mchod pa drug go /nye bar bsdu bas ni lha bsdus nas spyod lam la 'jug pa bstan to/ /yang tshom bu bsgrub pa'i thad du/ sgra la sogs pa gzugs las byung / /ri la sogs pa'i ji bzhin bsam/ /in+t+ra ne li'i sa gzhi la/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'jam pa la/ /ji bzhin gnas su rnam par bsam/ /zhes pa'i thad du/ sgra ni stong pa bsgom pa ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /sogs kyi bsdus pa bsod nams kyi tshogs so/ /gzugs ni yi ge'i gzugs te 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i sa bon dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa bon lta bu hūm̐ rnams so/ /yang sa bon ni stong pa nyid kyi ngang las bar srid kyi ngo bo na dang / de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las mgo bo/ de las khog pa/ de las zhabs kyu/ de las hūm̐ zhes pa cha bdun par bshad la/ 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs na 'di 'chad par snang ngo / /mar do bas pad+ma'i steng du bar snang gi na da babs/ de las zla tshes la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du hūm̐ cha bdun pa chad pa la bshad do/ /ri la sogs pa 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsgom par bstan/

in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi sogs kyis 'khor lo gsum dang de'i 'og gzhi sngon por byed pa bstan/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'jam pas ni bde chen 'khor lo/ ji bzhin gnas su zhes pas ni lha rnams kyi gdan bstan/ rnam par bsam gyis brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa dngos kyi thad du/ sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba/ /byang chub yan lag sum cu bdun/ /gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag phur bu tra/ /ā l̥ kā l̥ zhes brjod pa/ /rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs bshad pa/ /zhes pa'i thad du/ sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ni rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o/ /byang chub yan lag ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa'o/ /gos ni glang lpags dang stag lpags so/ /phyag rgya ni rgyan drug go /shes rab ni yum/ yan lag ni yab bo/ /phur bu tra ni srung 'khor ro/ /'di yan ni lus dag ā l̥ kā l̥ brjod pa ni ngag dag bye brag med par rgyu la sogs pa'i chos thams cad stong par bsgom par sems dag go /zhes pa 'di yan gyi bskyed rim bstan nas/ 'jug pa sgra la sogs pa zhes pa 'dis zab mo lus dkyil sgra tshul las bskyed pa bstan zhes gsungs/ 'o na bskyed chog de'i sgo nas bsgom bya'i don de rnams gang du bsgom zhe na/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa nas phyag 'bum pa'i bar gyi gtso bo la 'khor lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba'i rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / de bzhin du bshad rgyud rnams kyi bkral ba'i a bhi dha na gcig pu nas kyang rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis gsungs la/ de rnams gang 'dod du bsgom pas chog go /de'ang phyag gnyis pa nas phyag 'bum pa'i bar phyag ji ltar mang du song yang / zhal ni bzhi kho na yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /ji srid phyag ni 'bum pa ste/

/zhes dang / bzang po'i spyan gsum zhal bzhi mnga'/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhal bzhi mche ba gtsigs pa ste/ /ji srid phyag ni 'bum gyi bar/ /zhes so/ /zhal gyi kha dog ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal bzhi phyag drug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas sngon por bshad pa rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi zhal mdog go /drag po he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas dkar por bshad pa ste 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal mdog yin no/ /lū hi pa'i zhal ni/ a bhi dha na las/ sngon po ser po dmar po ljang / /zhes pa la brten no/ /de las zhal g.yas bskor du gsungs la don 'grel las kyang g.yas bskor du gsungs 'dug go /da lan zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di bsgom ste/ 'di rtsa ba'i lha yin la/ gzhan thams cad 'di'i sprul pa yin pas so/ /de la dang po sangs rgyas ba'i tshe'ang 'og min du longs sku zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po 'di nyid du sangs rgyas/ drag po dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'ang 'dis brtul/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud sde thams cad nas kyang zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa 'di gsungs pa'i phyir 'di kho na bsgrub bya'i gtso bor byed rigs pa yin no/ /'di yan chad kyis spyi bshad 'di ni lū nag dril gsum gang 'chad kyang thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro rgyu yin no/ /de rnams kyis bzang po dpa' ba'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ ya mtshan mtshan nyid phun tshogs tshogs kyi phyogs kun kun nas legs spras pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mtshar ba'i chos zab zab mo ma lus lus pa med pa rnams/ /phyogs gcig gcig tu legs bsdus bsdus pa'i gsung rab rab mchog zin bris rnams/ /mi mchog mchog gyur skal bzang bzang po'i las 'phro 'phro can rnams la sbyin/

/phyogs dang phyogs bral khyab pa'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /yid 'phrog yid la bde ster gsung rab mtsho/ /'dir bzhugs 'di nas zab don rin chen long / /legs bsgom legs bshad spel la don gnyis bsgrub/ /'di lta'i legs bshad rin chen gter/ /gter 'di mkhyen rab bzang po'i dpal/ /dpal ldan mgon de'i drin las byung / /byung ngo don gnyer dga' mgur rol/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don dgu pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ gos bzang rgyan bzang cha byed rab tu bzang ba la/ /yid 'ong bzhin mdzes rab mdzes gzhon nu gzhon nu mas/ /mig yang mig phra mig gi zur mda' 'phangs pa la/ /'gro kun kun nas yon por byed de de bzhin du/ /gang gi sku yi lang tsho'i dpal gyis yid rab 'phrog /'phrog byed 'joms pa'i smra ba'i seng ge khyed kyi gsung / /gsung gi sbrang rtsi snying nas mi sems mkhas pa gang / /gang zhig de ni zur phud lnga pa dge slong gzugs/ /gzugs 'chang de la phyogs dang dus kyi ma bskal zhing / /zhing 'dir grub mtha' ngan pas slad par ma gyur kun/ /kun kyang dad pas lan gcig min pa 'dud pa mthong / /mthong phyir skal bzang bdag kyang snying nas rjes yi rang / /zhes pa'i bstod tshig gi yul dam par gyur pa dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'chad thabs bshad pa dang / de las 'phros te bdag nyid chen po de'i gsan yig pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba'i mjug nas 'byung ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa la slob tshul bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'chad thabs las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ gsung rab de nyid las 'di lta bu 'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam gyi rim pa 'chad pa la/ spyi don dang /

gzhung gi don gnyis/ dang po la bde mchog la lam srol mi 'dra ba bzhi yod de/ de la yang ma rgyud spyi ltar bshad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo ltar bshad pa/ pha rgyud ltar bshad pa/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni mahā ma ya la sogs/ gnyis pa ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / 'khor lo sdom chen lta bu/ 'di la bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sgo nas 'chings ba dang / rdzogs rim yan lag drug gi khrid pas dus 'khor dang tshul mtshungs so/ /gsum pa bskyed rim gong dang 'dra zhing / rdzogs rim la rim pa lnga'i sgo nas khrid pas gsang 'dus dang tshul mtshungs pas so/ /bzhi pa la rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bkral ba la/ lū nag dril gsum las/ 'di la yang bshad bya'i rgyu ngos bzung ba/ ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul/ bshad pa las byung ba'i lam gyi srol 'dzin gnyis su gyes pa'i rnam gzhag srol de gnyis char gyi bshad pa dang / man ngag gi chu bo rnams dpal sa skya pa la babs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gnyis te/ dang po ni bde mchog nyung ngu zhes pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ he ru ka mngon 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ sam+bu ṭi/ nges brjod bla ma'o/ /de skad du yang / slob dpon mi thub zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de ltar bshad pa'i tshul la/ slob dpon nag po spyod pas rtsa rgyud kyi bskyed rim ston pa'i cha rnams rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sbyar nas bshad cing / lha mngal skyes ltar bskyed pa sbyang gzhi mngal skyes gtso bor sbyong ba'i lugs su mdzad/ lū hi pas rtsa rgyud kyi bskyed rim gyi cha a bhi dha na dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang sbyar nas bshad cing / lha sgong skyes ltar bskyed pa sbyang gzhi sgong skyes gtso bor sbyong ba'i lugs su mdzad/

dril bu pas bskyed rim gyi cha rnams gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba dang sbyar nas bshad cing / brdzus skyes sbyong ba'i lugs su mdzad pa/ 'di yang man ngag gi brdzus skyes la sbyar ba ma gtogs/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan la mngal skyes sbyong ba dang / sgong skyes sbyong ba'i lam gnyis su 'dus par bshad la/ 'on kyang gtso bor gnyis po 'di sbyong ba yin gyi gzhan rnams kyang mi sbyong ba yin no/ /'di gsum gyi rdzogs rim ni nag po pa'i rdzogs rim rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan yin la/ dpyid dang thig le ni sam+bu ṭi'i rtag pa drug pa las 'byung zhing / lū hi pa'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma ni rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las bshad/ dril bu pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ rim lnga gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa dang bstun nas bshad do/ /des na spyir lam rnams kyi nang nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam 'di zab/ de'i nang nas kyang rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bkral ba'i lam 'di zab la/ de'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu zab pa nag po pa'i lam 'di yin te/ smin byed kyi skabs su dpa' bo bskul ba dang / grol byed lam gyi skabs su pho nya gsum bsre ba dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs su dpyid thig dang / zhal sbyor gyi tshul du bsgom pa'i lam gyi rim pa tshang la ma nor ba ston pa slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes bkral ba'i lugs 'di ma gtogs gzhan rnams la med pa'i phyir/ yang na tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad gnyis las/ 'di ni jo bo nā ro ta pa man chad la gtso bor grags pa ste/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis sgra las drangs pa'i sgo nas bshad pa dang / rgyud sgrub thabs ltar bshad pa ni tshogs bshad do/ /de yang sgrub thabs ltar bshad ces pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi cha gtso bor bstan pa'o/ /yang spyi don gyi sgo nas kyai rdo rje rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'chad pa dang /

rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi 'bru bshad pa tsam la tshogs bshad dang / rgyud kyi tshig don re res kyang gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshang bar ston pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa dang / lam bsgom tshul gyi gdams pa zab mo dang bcas te 'chad pa ni slob bshad do/ /gsum pa ni lam gyi srol 'dzin gnyis su gyes pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ jo bo nā ro ta pa de nyid kyi dngos slob pham thing pa sku mched nas mal lo la brgyud pa dang / bal po bha dan ta nas spu hrang lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i tshul gnyis byung ste/ phyi ma 'di la lam rgyas pa'i 'chad tshul dang / bsdus pa'i 'chad tshul gcig ste gnyis las/ dang po nā ro chos drug gi sgo nas 'chad de/ de yang chos drug ni/ smin byed dbang gi chos/ grol byed lam gyi chos/ grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'i chos/ spyod pa bogs 'byin chen po'i chos/ rtogs pa ye shes phyag rgya chen pa'i chos/ grub pa 'bras bu'i chos te chos drug yongs rdzogs so/ /rdzogs rim nā ro'i chos drug ni ding sang gi bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis kha la 'khyer ba'i/ sgyu lus gtum mo 'od gsal gsum/ /rmi lam 'pho ba bar do gsum/ /des na sa paṇa gyis/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid/ /mi la yan chad de las med/ /ces pa'i chos drug ni snga ma nyid bya'i/ phyi ma la mi bya'o/ /bsdus pa'i 'chad tshul ni/ rim bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad de/ rim bzhi ni/ shes bya rgyud kyi rim pa/ nyams len sngags kyi rim pa/ skye ba ye shes kyi rim pa/ 'bras bu gsang ba'i rim pa ste yab la sbyar ba'o/ /yum la sbyar ba ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi phag mo ni zhal gnyis ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /bzhi pa bshad srol de gnyis kar dpal sa skya pa la babs tshul ni/ bla ma sa chen gyi mal lo tsā ba dang / spu hrang lo tsā ba gnyis char la gsan nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/

/spyi don gnyis pa gzhung gi don ni/ gong du bshad pa'i lū nag dril gsum gyi nang nas khyad par du ma'i sgo nas shin tu zab pa 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i lam nyams su len par byed pa la/ zhes pa de rnams kyis sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa las/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'chad thabs las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa de las 'phros pa'i don ni/ skal bzang las 'phro can rnams zab mo'i yangs rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'di lta bur 'jug par byed pa la yang / spyir bstan pa la slob tshul gyi rnam gzhag kyang kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyi bzhed srol dri ma med pa'i rjes su 'brang ba ni cis kyang gal che bas/ de lta bu'i bstan pa la slob tshul gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa ni rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis mang du mdzad zin yang / de dag gi snying po bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas ston pa bdag nyid chen po sa lo tsā ba de nyid kyi gsan yig pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba'i mjug nas 'byung ba de nyid 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gsung rab de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ kye ma ding sang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /thub dbang nyi mas dngos su ma khyab cing / /thub bstan bdud rtsi'i 'od kyang lhag mar gyur/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar phreng ba'ang gzhan du bzhud/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i u lu 'ug pa ka /las ngan brag rir nyon mongs tshangs bcas nas/ /log lta'i hūm̐ sgra drag po 'byin la brtson/ /'dul khrims med par rab byung mkhan slob byed/ /dam tshig ma thob sngags la khrom bshad byed/ /thos bsam byed rnams tshe 'di'i 'kheng grags 'dod/ /bsgom bsgrub byed kyang bsnyen bkur kho na'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel tshad ma la/ /blta rtog nyan bshad cha tsam mi byed par/

/dus ngan rtog pas bcos pa'i bsdus bsud la/ /gsung rab dgongs pa 'grel ba'i 'dzin stangs byed/ /lha chung re re'i mngon rtogs sngags shes sam/ /yang na don med ngan sngags kho na 'dren/ /de tsam gyis kyang rdor dril 'khur shes nas/ /dad rdzas shi rdzas byung na mgo 'phang bstod/ /nang du bsam na dbang dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rnam gzhag mi shes nyams len ji ltar byed/ /de bas dman pa'i chos gzugs 'dzin pa 'ga'/ /rab byung tshul gyis dmag dpon bshas mkhan byed/ /bsam ngan dug sbyor skye bo'i 'gab btegs byed/ /rgyu mtshan med pa 'khrug long du ma byed/ /de la smras na khong nas me lce 'bar/ /kha nas tshig ngan du ba tshab 'tshub 'thul/ /cung zad brnyed na nag chang phyogs su gtong / /dben par bzhag na gnyid dang long gtam smra/ /yang na sho rtsed don med bya bas 'da'/ /'di 'dra'i chos pa rnams kyi byed tshul la/ /mthar thug 'bras bu gang du 'gro ba soms/ /'jig rten pa rnams rang nyid che 'dod nas/ /gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyis/ /g.yog gis dpon bslu bu tshas pha ma gsod/ /ngo tsha khrel bor gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /las ngan sna tshogs spyod cing tshe snga mar/ /las bzang ma bsags tshe 'dir bde skyid med/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye bas ma thul ba/ /so so skye bos 'dul ba'i skabs yod dam/ /'di 'dra'i spyod ngan sna tshogs rab mthong nas/ /nges 'byung skyo shas snying rjes kun bslangs te/ /thub pa'i bstan la dad pas 'jug 'dod cing / /kho bo'i ngag la nyan na 'di ltar gyis/ /thog mar klog yig mkhas las dag par slob/ /de rjes mkhan slob mtshan nyid ldan pa las/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs 'dul ba'i khrims nos te/ /dgag bsgrub gnang ba'i bslab pa tshul bzhin bsrung / /tshig don 'gal 'grel 'byed phyir sgra tshad slob/ /sems bskyed cho gas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /gtso bo bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems sbyongs/

/bla ma mchog las dbang bzhis smin byas nus/ /lam zab rim gnyis bsgom la brtson pa bskyed/ /'bras bu sa dang lam rnams rim bgrod de/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob 'gyur bas/ /'khor bas 'jigs shing lam la grod bskyed na/ /spro bas 'bad rtsol rab tu bya bar rigs/ /de ltar lam la slob tshul 'di nyid ni/ /rang dgar legs legs 'dra nas bsgrigs pa min/ /shākya'i gsung dang bstan bcos tshad mar bshad/ /khyad par nged kyi bla ma sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' srol rnam dag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs te skal ba dang ldan pa rnams yang dag pa'i bstan pa la rim gyis bslab ste/ mthar thug rgyud sde kun gyi yangs rtse zab mo'i yang zab mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi nye lam la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o// //'dir smras pa/ e ma gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya/ /gang der mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'jam dpal gyi/ /rnam sprul la la ngur smṛg gos 'chang zhing / 1 /la la gos dkar lcang lo'i mdzes byas te/ /thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa la/ /sa skya pa zhes 'gro la rab grags pa/ /gang gi skyes mchog dpal ldan 'phags pa'i zhabs/ 2 /stobs ldan se chen rgyal pos legs bsten nas/ /shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bod yul chol kha gsum/ /dam chos yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ /sa skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur su/ 3 /de tshe mkha' la nyi zla rnams gnyis ltar/ /sa la mchod yon gnyis zhes cher grags shing / /rnam dag bstan pa phyogs bcur dar bas na/ /mkhas grub bye bas gangs can ljongs 'di khyab/ 4 /bdag nyid chen po de dag gshegs pa'i rjes/ /bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed srol 'dzin pa'i skyes chen du ma zhig /rim par byon nas bstan pa spel zhes thos/

5 /de tshe mdo rgyud tshad ldan gzhung lugs dang / /'gal ba'i sngon med chos ltar bcos pa 'gas/ /'phel bar gyur kyang lung rigs mkhyen pa yi/ /smra ba'i seng ge rnams kyis sun dbyung mdzad/ 6 /deng dus sngon byon rgya bod mkhas grub kyis/ /rtsod bral shing rta'i gzhung lugs rnams bor nas/ /rang bzo gsar bu'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la/ /blang dor mi shes blun po stobs ldan rnams/ 7 /gus par byed cing de yi bstan pa spel/ /de phyir rnam dag bstan pa'i rgyun nyams shing / /chos min chos ltar bcos pa 'phel dus 'dir/ /rtsod bral bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs pa yi/ 8 /skal bzang rnams kyis rang gzhung dri med la/ /thos bsam 'chad nyan bsgom bsgrub la sogs pa/ /thabs tshul dus la spel bar mdzod cig ces/ /kun la gus pa'i yid kyis bdag gsol lo/ 9 /bdag kyang sngon bsags las kyis 'phen pa 'gas/ /rnam dag bstan pa nyams pa'i dus 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ 10 /de phyir zab rgyas chos tshul ston pa la/ /'dren par 'os pa bstan pa'i mjug 'di ru/ /des na sa skya'i rjes 'brangs bstan 'dzin rnams/ /tshur spyon chos tshul rgya mtsho len par rigs/ 11 /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras pa'o/ /de rnams kyis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam pa'i chos byung tshul legs par bshad pa rin po che'i phreng ba dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba ma lus pa bstan zin to// //yang smras pa/ mkha' 'gro bye ba grangs med gshegs pa'i lam/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud/ /rab zab 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos bskor rnams/ /'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir dar ba'i tshul/ 1 /legs bshad yid bzhin rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /he ru ka dpal dur smṛg bla gos can/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gsungs las skyes pa yi/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sa skya pa des sbyar/

2 /sngon byon mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen rnams/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i do rar gshegs pa'i lam/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i nye lam 'di yin zhes/ /ma sgrib skye bo kun gyi rna bar gsal/ 3 /de 'dra'i zab chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ /sa skya'i yab chos kun gyi yang snying mchog /'bad pa chung ngu'i btsan sa zin nus pa'i/ /zab las ches zab chos tshul rgya mtsho rnams/ 4 /thos zhing rtogs pa deng sang kho bo tsam/ /'di ni rje btsun mus pa'i bka' drin te/ /shes nas dad pas rgyun du gsol 'debs kyis/ /da dung byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyobs/ 5 /'di sbyar dge ba 'di'i mtshon dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams kun tu bzang po yi/ /rnam sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho ltar sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ 6 /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs gyur cig /'dren pa gang gis thugs rjes bdag cag rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'bad med lhun grub ste/ 7 /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i tshe/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis nyer bsus te/ /dpon slob 'khor bcas bde ba can 'gro shog 8 /legs bshad 'di don 'dzin dang sems pa dang / /yi ger 'bri dang gzhan la ston byed pa/ /de dag rnams la bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /chos 'di spel ba dpal lha mo nag mo dang / zhing skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sogs bstan srung rgya mtshos mdzod/ 9 /kho bo'i rjes 'brangs blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams/ legs bshad 'di don khong du chud byas na/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho la/ /'jigs med smra ba'i spobs pa thob par 'gyur/ 10 /sa skya'i bstan pa'i snying po gsang mtha'i lam/ /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis spel ba'i tshul/ /sa skya'i bstan la phan phyir bshad pa 'dis/

/sa skya'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas gyur cig 11 /ces dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba pad+ma'i rnam sprul 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched las lugs 'di'i sgrub dkyil gyi lung dang / cho ga'i phyag khrid sogs kyi bka' drin zhib rgyas su nos shing / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan las/ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i bshad lung sogs/ mdor na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos pa'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen rigs sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon dus byon pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi rnam thar gsang mtha'i chos bskor mtha' dag dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshul rnams la dad pa bcos min skyes pa dang / da dung kho bo cag rjes 'brang dang bcas pa la brten nas rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dag pa'i kun nas blangs te/ zab mo'i yangs rtse dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas te/ rang lo bcu phrag gnyis dang nyag ma brgyad lon pa rgya gar lugs la mig dmar zhes grags zhing /

rgya nag lugs la shing pho byi ba'i lo phal ghun zhes pa'i zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ gu na rat+na ka raḥshrī wan bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka'i yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i/ gnas mchog bzhi thog bla brang chen po'i gtsug lag khang du rdzogs par sbyar ba 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab par 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi gtso byas sarba twe bh+yaḥshrī bhu ti pu ṇ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ tsa ma ra pa ti ma re se na bi dza ya bha wan+tu/ sems can thams cad kyi dpal 'byor bsod nams rgyas pa dang / 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig sha sā na twaṃ hi to bha ban+tu/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig shubhaṃ ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos byung rin chen phreng ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
